lines: Happy are they who have not walked in the counsel of
the wicked, *
nor lingered in the way of sinners,
nor sat in the seats of the scornful!
verses.text: Happy are they who have not walked in the counsel of the wicked, * nor lingered in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seats of the scornful!

lines: Their delight is in the law of the LORD, *
and they meditate on his law day and night.
verses.text: Their delight is in the law of the LORD, * and they meditate on his law day and night.

lines: They are like trees planted by streams of water,
bearing fruit in due season, with leaves that do not wither; *
everything they do shall prosper.
verses.text: They are like trees planted by streams of water, bearing fruit in due season, with leaves that do not wither; * everything they do shall prosper.

lines: It is not so with the wicked; *
they are like chaff which the wind blows away.
verses.text: It is not so with the wicked; * they are like chaff which the wind blows away.

lines: Therefore the wicked shall not stand upright when
judgment comes, *
nor the sinner in the council of the righteous.
verses.text: Therefore the wicked shall not stand upright when judgment comes, * nor the sinner in the council of the righteous.

lines: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, *
but the way of the wicked is doomed.
verses.text: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, * but the way of the wicked is doomed.

lines: Why are the nations in an uproar? *
Why do the peoples mutter empty threats?
verses.text: Why are the nations in an uproar? * Why do the peoples mutter empty threats?

lines: Why do the kings of the earth rise up in revolt,
and the princes plot together, *
against the LORD and against his Anointed?
verses.text: Why do the kings of the earth rise up in revolt, and the princes plot together, * against the LORD and against his Anointed?

lines: "Let us break their yoke," they say; *
"let us cast off their bonds from us."
verses.text: "Let us break their yoke," they say; * "let us cast off their bonds from us."

lines: He whose throne is in heaven is laughing; *
the Lord has them in derision.
verses.text: He whose throne is in heaven is laughing; * the Lord has them in derision.

lines: Then he speaks to them in his wrath, *
and his rage fills them with terror.
verses.text: Then he speaks to them in his wrath, * and his rage fills them with terror.

lines: "I myself have set my king *
upon my holy hill of Zion."
verses.text: "I myself have set my king * upon my holy hill of Zion."

lines: Let me announce the decree of the LORD: *
he said to me, "You are my Son;
this day have I begotten you.
verses.text: Let me announce the decree of the LORD: * he said to me, "You are my Son; this day have I begotten you.

lines: Ask of me, and I will give you the nations for
your inheritance *
and the ends of the earth for your possession.
verses.text: Ask of me, and I will give you the nations for your inheritance * and the ends of the earth for your possession.

lines: You shall crush them with an iron rod *
and shatter them like a piece of pottery."
verses.text: You shall crush them with an iron rod * and shatter them like a piece of pottery."

lines: And now, you kings, be wise; *
be warned, you rulers of the earth.
verses.text: And now, you kings, be wise; * be warned, you rulers of the earth.

lines: Submit to the LORD with fear, *
and with trembling bow before him;
verses.text: Submit to the LORD with fear, * and with trembling bow before him;

lines: Lest he be angry and you perish; *
for his wrath is quickly kindled.
verses.text: Lest he be angry and you perish; * for his wrath is quickly kindled.

lines: Happy are they all *
who take refuge in him!
verses.text: Happy are they all * who take refuge in him!

lines: LORD, how many adversaries I have! *
how many there are who rise up against me!
verses.text: LORD, how many adversaries I have! * how many there are who rise up against me!

lines: How many there are who say of me, *
"There is no help for him in his God."
verses.text: How many there are who say of me, * "There is no help for him in his God."

lines: But you, O LORD, are a shield about me; *
you are my glory, the one who lifts up my head.
verses.text: But you, O LORD, are a shield about me; * you are my glory, the one who lifts up my head.

lines: I call aloud upon the LORD, *
and he answers me from his holy hill;
verses.text: I call aloud upon the LORD, * and he answers me from his holy hill;

lines: I lie down and go to sleep; *
I wake again, because the LORD sustains me.
verses.text: I lie down and go to sleep; * I wake again, because the LORD sustains me.

lines: I do not fear the multitudes of people *
who set themselves against me all around.
verses.text: I do not fear the multitudes of people * who set themselves against me all around.

lines: Rise up, O LORD; set me free, O my God; *
surely, you will strike all my enemies across the face,
you will break the teeth of the wicked.
verses.text: Rise up, O LORD; set me free, O my God; * surely, you will strike all my enemies across the face, you will break the teeth of the wicked.

lines: Deliverance belongs to the LORD. *
Your blessing be upon your people!
verses.text: Deliverance belongs to the LORD. * Your blessing be upon your people!

lines: Answer me when I call, O God, defender of my cause; *
you set me free when I am hard-pressed;
have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
verses.text: Answer me when I call, O God, defender of my cause; * you set me free when I am hard-pressed; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

lines: "You mortals, how long will you dishonor my glory; *
how long will you worship dumb idols
and run after false gods?"
verses.text: "You mortals, how long will you dishonor my glory; * how long will you worship dumb idols and run after false gods?"

lines: Know that the LORD does wonders for the faithful; *
when I call upon the LORD, he will hear me.
verses.text: Know that the LORD does wonders for the faithful; * when I call upon the LORD, he will hear me.

lines: Tremble, then, and do not sin; *
speak to your heart in silence upon your bed.
verses.text: Tremble, then, and do not sin; * speak to your heart in silence upon your bed.

lines: Offer the appointed sacrifices *
and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.text: Offer the appointed sacrifices * and put your trust in the LORD.

lines: Many are saying,
"Oh, that we might see better times!" *
Lift up the light of your countenance upon us, O LORD.
verses.text: Many are saying, "Oh, that we might see better times!" * Lift up the light of your countenance upon us, O LORD.

lines: You have put gladness in my heart, *
more than when grain and wine and oil increase.
verses.text: You have put gladness in my heart, * more than when grain and wine and oil increase.

lines: I lie down in peace; at once I fall asleep; *
for only you, LORD, make me dwell in safety.
verses.text: I lie down in peace; at once I fall asleep; * for only you, LORD, make me dwell in safety.

lines: Give ear to my words, O LORD; *
consider my meditation.
verses.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD; * consider my meditation.

lines: Hearken to my cry for help, my King and my God, *
for I make my prayer to you.
verses.text: Hearken to my cry for help, my King and my God, * for I make my prayer to you.

lines: In the morning, LORD, you hear my voice; *
early in the morning I make my appeal and watch for you.
verses.text: In the morning, LORD, you hear my voice; * early in the morning I make my appeal and watch for you.

lines: For you are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness, *
and evil cannot dwell with you.
verses.text: For you are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness, * and evil cannot dwell with you.

lines: Braggarts cannot stand in your sight; *
you hate all those who work wickedness.
verses.text: Braggarts cannot stand in your sight; * you hate all those who work wickedness.

lines: You destroy those who speak lies; *
the bloodthirsty and deceitful, O LORD, you abhor.
verses.text: You destroy those who speak lies; * the bloodthirsty and deceitful, O LORD, you abhor.

lines: But as for me, through the greatness of your mercy I will
go into your house; *
I will bow down toward your holy temple in awe of you.
verses.text: But as for me, through the greatness of your mercy I will go into your house; * I will bow down toward your holy temple in awe of you.

lines: Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness,
because of those who lie in wait for me; *
make your way straight before me.
verses.text: Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness, because of those who lie in wait for me; * make your way straight before me.

lines: For there is no truth in their mouth; *
there is destruction in their heart;
verses.text: For there is no truth in their mouth; * there is destruction in their heart;

lines: Their throat is an open grave; *
they flatter with their tongue.
verses.text: Their throat is an open grave; * they flatter with their tongue.

lines: Declare them guilty, O God; *
let them fall, because of their schemes.
verses.text: Declare them guilty, O God; * let them fall, because of their schemes.

lines: Because of their many transgressions cast them out, *
for they have rebelled against you.
verses.text: Because of their many transgressions cast them out, * for they have rebelled against you.

lines: But all who take refuge in you will be glad; *
they will sing out their joy for ever.
verses.text: But all who take refuge in you will be glad; * they will sing out their joy for ever.

lines: You will shelter them, *
so that those who love your Name may exult in you.
verses.text: You will shelter them, * so that those who love your Name may exult in you.

lines: For you, O LORD, will bless the righteous; *
you will defend them with your favor as with a shield.
verses.text: For you, O LORD, will bless the righteous; * you will defend them with your favor as with a shield.

lines: LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger; *
do not punish me in your wrath.
verses.text: LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger; * do not punish me in your wrath.

lines: Have pity on me, LORD, for I am weak; *
heal me, LORD, for my bones are racked.
verses.text: Have pity on me, LORD, for I am weak; * heal me, LORD, for my bones are racked.

lines: My spirit shakes with terror; *
how long, O LORD, how long?
verses.text: My spirit shakes with terror; * how long, O LORD, how long?

lines: Turn, O LORD, and deliver me; *
save me for your mercy's sake.
verses.text: Turn, O LORD, and deliver me; * save me for your mercy's sake.

lines: For in death no one remembers you; *
and who will give you thanks in the grave?
verses.text: For in death no one remembers you; * and who will give you thanks in the grave?

lines: I grow weary because of my groaning; *
every night I drench my bed
and flood my couch with tears.
verses.text: I grow weary because of my groaning; * every night I drench my bed and flood my couch with tears.

lines: My eyes are wasted with grief *
and worn away because of all my enemies.
verses.text: My eyes are wasted with grief * and worn away because of all my enemies.

lines: Depart from me, all evildoers, *
for the LORD has heard the sound of my weeping.
verses.text: Depart from me, all evildoers, * for the LORD has heard the sound of my weeping.

lines: The LORD has heard my supplication; *
the LORD accepts my prayer.
verses.text: The LORD has heard my supplication; * the LORD accepts my prayer.

lines: All my enemies shall be confounded and quake with fear; *
they shall turn back and suddenly be put to shame.
verses.text: All my enemies shall be confounded and quake with fear; * they shall turn back and suddenly be put to shame.

lines: O LORD my God, I take refuge in you; *
save and deliver me from all who pursue me;
verses.text: O LORD my God, I take refuge in you; * save and deliver me from all who pursue me;

lines: Lest like a lion they tear me in pieces *
and snatch me away with none to deliver me.
verses.text: Lest like a lion they tear me in pieces * and snatch me away with none to deliver me.

lines: O LORD my God, if I have done these things: *
if there is any wickedness in my hands,
verses.text: O LORD my God, if I have done these things: * if there is any wickedness in my hands,

lines: If I have repaid my friend with evil, *
or plundered him who without cause is my enemy;
verses.text: If I have repaid my friend with evil, * or plundered him who without cause is my enemy;

lines: Then let my enemy pursue and overtake me, *
trample my life into the ground,
and lay my honor in the dust.
verses.text: Then let my enemy pursue and overtake me, * trample my life into the ground, and lay my honor in the dust.

lines: Stand up, O LORD, in your wrath; *
rise up against the fury of my enemies.
verses.text: Stand up, O LORD, in your wrath; * rise up against the fury of my enemies.

lines: Awake, O my God, decree justice; *
let the assembly of the peoples gather round you.
verses.text: Awake, O my God, decree justice; * let the assembly of the peoples gather round you.

lines: Be seated on your lofty throne, O Most High; *
O LORD, judge the nations.
verses.text: Be seated on your lofty throne, O Most High; * O LORD, judge the nations.

lines: Give judgment for me according to my
righteousness, O LORD, *
and according to my innocence, O Most High.
verses.text: Give judgment for me according to my righteousness, O LORD, * and according to my innocence, O Most High.

lines: Let the malice of the wicked come to an end,
but establish the righteous; *
for you test the mind and heart, O righteous God.
verses.text: Let the malice of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; * for you test the mind and heart, O righteous God.

lines: God is my shield and defense; *
he is the savior of the true in heart.
verses.text: God is my shield and defense; * he is the savior of the true in heart.

lines: God is a righteous judge; *
God sits in judgment every day.
verses.text: God is a righteous judge; * God sits in judgment every day.

lines: If they will not repent, God will whet his sword; *
he will bend his bow and make it ready.
verses.text: If they will not repent, God will whet his sword; * he will bend his bow and make it ready.

lines: He has prepared his weapons of death; *
he makes his arrows shafts of fire.
verses.text: He has prepared his weapons of death; * he makes his arrows shafts of fire.

lines: Look at those who are in labor with wickedness, *
who conceive evil, and give birth to a lie.
verses.text: Look at those who are in labor with wickedness, * who conceive evil, and give birth to a lie.

lines: They dig a pit and make it deep *
and fall into the hole that they have made.
verses.text: They dig a pit and make it deep * and fall into the hole that they have made.

lines: Their malice turns back upon their own head; *
their violence falls on their own scalp.
verses.text: Their malice turns back upon their own head; * their violence falls on their own scalp.

lines: I will bear witness that the LORD is righteous; *
I will praise the Name of the LORD Most High.
verses.text: I will bear witness that the LORD is righteous; * I will praise the Name of the LORD Most High.

lines: O LORD our Governor, *
how exalted is your Name in all the world!
verses.text: O LORD our Governor, * how exalted is your Name in all the world!

lines: Out of the mouths of infants and children *
your majesty is praised above the heavens.
verses.text: Out of the mouths of infants and children * your majesty is praised above the heavens.

lines: You have set up a stronghold against your adversaries, *
to quell the enemy and the avenger.
verses.text: You have set up a stronghold against your adversaries, * to quell the enemy and the avenger.

lines: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, *
the moon and the stars you have set in their courses,
verses.text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, * the moon and the stars you have set in their courses,

lines: What is man that you should be mindful of him? *
the son of man that you should seek him out?
verses.text: What is man that you should be mindful of him? * the son of man that you should seek him out?

lines: You have made him but little lower than the angels; *
you adorn him with glory and honor;
verses.text: You have made him but little lower than the angels; * you adorn him with glory and honor;

lines: You give him mastery over the works of your hands; *
you put all things under his feet:
verses.text: You give him mastery over the works of your hands; * you put all things under his feet:

lines: All sheep and oxen, *
even the wild beasts of the field,
verses.text: All sheep and oxen, * even the wild beasts of the field,

lines: The birds of the air, the fish of the sea, *
and whatsoever walks in the paths of the sea.
verses.text: The birds of the air, the fish of the sea, * and whatsoever walks in the paths of the sea.

lines: O LORD our Governor, *
how exalted is your Name in all the world!
verses.text: O LORD our Governor, * how exalted is your Name in all the world!

lines: I will give thanks to you, O LORD, with my whole heart; *
I will tell of all your marvelous works.
verses.text: I will give thanks to you, O LORD, with my whole heart; * I will tell of all your marvelous works.

lines: I will be glad and rejoice in you; *
I will sing to your Name, O Most High.
verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in you; * I will sing to your Name, O Most High.

lines: When my enemies are driven back, *
they will stumble and perish at your presence.
verses.text: When my enemies are driven back, * they will stumble and perish at your presence.

lines: For you have maintained my right and my cause; *
you sit upon your throne judging right.
verses.text: For you have maintained my right and my cause; * you sit upon your throne judging right.

lines: You have rebuked the ungodly and destroyed the wicked; *
you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.
verses.text: You have rebuked the ungodly and destroyed the wicked; * you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

lines: As for the enemy, they are finished, in perpetual ruin, *
their cities plowed under, the memory of them perished;
verses.text: As for the enemy, they are finished, in perpetual ruin, * their cities plowed under, the memory of them perished;

lines: But the LORD is enthroned for ever; *
he has set up his throne for judgment.
verses.text: But the LORD is enthroned for ever; * he has set up his throne for judgment.

lines: It is he who rules the world with righteousness; *
he judges the peoples with equity.
verses.text: It is he who rules the world with righteousness; * he judges the peoples with equity.

lines: The LORD will be a refuge for the oppressed, *
a refuge in time of trouble.
verses.text: The LORD will be a refuge for the oppressed, * a refuge in time of trouble.

lines: Those who know your Name will put their trust in you, *
for you never forsake those who seek you, O LORD.
verses.text: Those who know your Name will put their trust in you, * for you never forsake those who seek you, O LORD.

lines: Sing praise to the LORD who dwells in Zion; *
proclaim to the peoples the things he has done.
verses.text: Sing praise to the LORD who dwells in Zion; * proclaim to the peoples the things he has done.

lines: The Avenger of blood will remember them; *
he will not forget the cry of the afflicted.
verses.text: The Avenger of blood will remember them; * he will not forget the cry of the afflicted.

lines: Have pity on me, O LORD; *
see the misery I suffer from those who hate me,
O you who lift me up from the gate of death;
verses.text: Have pity on me, O LORD; * see the misery I suffer from those who hate me, O you who lift me up from the gate of death;

lines: So that I may tell of all your praises
and rejoice in your salvation *
in the gates of the city of Zion.
verses.text: So that I may tell of all your praises and rejoice in your salvation * in the gates of the city of Zion.

lines: The ungodly have fallen into the pit they dug, *
and in the snare they set is their own foot caught.
verses.text: The ungodly have fallen into the pit they dug, * and in the snare they set is their own foot caught.

lines: The LORD is known by his acts of justice; *
the wicked are trapped in the works of their own hands.
verses.text: The LORD is known by his acts of justice; * the wicked are trapped in the works of their own hands.

lines: The wicked shall be given over to the grave, *
and also all the people that forget God.
verses.text: The wicked shall be given over to the grave, * and also all the people that forget God.

lines: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, *
and the hope of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.text: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, * and the hope of the poor shall not perish for ever.

lines: Rise up, O LORD, let not the ungodly have the upper hand; *
let them be judged before you.
verses.text: Rise up, O LORD, let not the ungodly have the upper hand; * let them be judged before you.

lines: Put fear upon them, O LORD; *
let the ungodly know they are but mortal.
verses.text: Put fear upon them, O LORD; * let the ungodly know they are but mortal.

lines: Why do you stand so far off, O LORD, *
and hide yourself in time of trouble?
verses.text: Why do you stand so far off, O LORD, * and hide yourself in time of trouble?

lines: The wicked arrogantly persecute the poor, *
but they are trapped in the schemes they have devised.
verses.text: The wicked arrogantly persecute the poor, * but they are trapped in the schemes they have devised.

lines: The wicked boast of their heart's desire; *
the covetous curse and revile the LORD.
verses.text: The wicked boast of their heart's desire; * the covetous curse and revile the LORD.

lines: The wicked are so proud that they care not for God; *
their only thought is, "God does not matter."
verses.text: The wicked are so proud that they care not for God; * their only thought is, "God does not matter."

lines: Their ways are devious at all times;
your judgments are far above out of their sight; *
they defy all their enemies.
verses.text: Their ways are devious at all times; your judgments are far above out of their sight; * they defy all their enemies.

lines: They say in their heart, "I shall not be shaken; *
no harm shall happen to me ever."
verses.text: They say in their heart, "I shall not be shaken; * no harm shall happen to me ever."

lines: Their mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression; *
under their tongue are mischief and wrong.
verses.text: Their mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression; * under their tongue are mischief and wrong.

lines: They lurk in ambush in public squares
and in secret places they murder the innocent; *
they spy out the helpless.
verses.text: They lurk in ambush in public squares and in secret places they murder the innocent; * they spy out the helpless.

lines: They lie in wait, like a lion in a covert;
they lie in wait to seize upon the lowly; *
they seize the lowly and drag them away in their net.
verses.text: They lie in wait, like a lion in a covert; they lie in wait to seize upon the lowly; * they seize the lowly and drag them away in their net.

lines: The innocent are broken and humbled before them; *
the helpless fall before their power.
verses.text: The innocent are broken and humbled before them; * the helpless fall before their power.

lines: They say in their heart, "God has forgotten; *
he hides his face; he will never notice."
verses.text: They say in their heart, "God has forgotten; * he hides his face; he will never notice."

lines: Rise up, O LORD;
lift up your hand, O God; *
do not forget the afflicted.
verses.text: Rise up, O LORD; lift up your hand, O God; * do not forget the afflicted.

lines: Why should the wicked revile God? *
why should they say in their heart, "You do not care"?
verses.text: Why should the wicked revile God? * why should they say in their heart, "You do not care"?

lines: Surely, you behold trouble and misery; *
you see it and take it into your own hand.
verses.text: Surely, you behold trouble and misery; * you see it and take it into your own hand.

lines: The helpless commit themselves to you, *
for you are the helper of orphans.
verses.text: The helpless commit themselves to you, * for you are the helper of orphans.

lines: Break the power of the wicked and evil; *
search out their wickedness until you find none.
verses.text: Break the power of the wicked and evil; * search out their wickedness until you find none.

lines: The LORD is King for ever and ever; *
the ungodly shall perish from his land.
verses.text: The LORD is King for ever and ever; * the ungodly shall perish from his land.

lines: The LORD will hear the desire of the humble; *
you will strengthen their heart and your ears shall hear;
verses.text: The LORD will hear the desire of the humble; * you will strengthen their heart and your ears shall hear;

lines: To give justice to the orphan and oppressed, *
so that mere mortals may strike terror no more.
verses.text: To give justice to the orphan and oppressed, * so that mere mortals may strike terror no more.

lines: In the LORD have I taken refuge; *
how then can you say to me,
"Fly away like a bird to the hilltop;
verses.text: In the LORD have I taken refuge; * how then can you say to me, "Fly away like a bird to the hilltop;

lines: For see how the wicked bend the bow
and fit their arrows to the string, *
to shoot from ambush at the true of heart.
verses.text: For see how the wicked bend the bow and fit their arrows to the string, * to shoot from ambush at the true of heart.

lines: When the foundations are being destroyed, *
what can the righteous do?"
verses.text: When the foundations are being destroyed, * what can the righteous do?"

lines: The LORD is in his holy temple; *
the LORD'S throne is in heaven.
verses.text: The LORD is in his holy temple; * the LORD'S throne is in heaven.

lines: His eyes behold the inhabited world; *
his piercing eye weighs our worth.
verses.text: His eyes behold the inhabited world; * his piercing eye weighs our worth.

lines: The LORD weighs the righteous as well as the wicked, *
but those who delight in violence he abhors.
verses.text: The LORD weighs the righteous as well as the wicked, * but those who delight in violence he abhors.

lines: Upon the wicked he shall rain coals of fire and
burning sulphur; *
a scorching wind shall be their lot.
verses.text: Upon the wicked he shall rain coals of fire and burning sulphur; * a scorching wind shall be their lot.

lines: For the LORD is righteous;
he delights in righteous deeds; *
and the just shall see his face.
verses.text: For the LORD is righteous; he delights in righteous deeds; * and the just shall see his face.

lines: Help me, LORD, for there is no godly one left; *
the faithful have vanished from among us.
verses.text: Help me, LORD, for there is no godly one left; * the faithful have vanished from among us.

lines: Everyone speaks falsely with his neighbor; *
with a smooth tongue they speak from a double heart.
verses.text: Everyone speaks falsely with his neighbor; * with a smooth tongue they speak from a double heart.

lines: Oh, that the LORD would cut off all smooth tongues, *
and close the lips that utter proud boasts!
verses.text: Oh, that the LORD would cut off all smooth tongues, * and close the lips that utter proud boasts!

lines: Those who say, "With our tongue will we prevail; *
our lips are our own; who is lord over us?"
verses.text: Those who say, "With our tongue will we prevail; * our lips are our own; who is lord over us?"

lines: "Because the needy are oppressed,
and the poor cry out in misery, *
I will rise up," says the LORD,
"and give them the help they long for."
verses.text: "Because the needy are oppressed, and the poor cry out in misery, * I will rise up," says the LORD, "and give them the help they long for."

lines: The words of the LORD are pure words, *
like silver refined from ore
and purified seven times in the fire.
verses.text: The words of the LORD are pure words, * like silver refined from ore and purified seven times in the fire.

lines: O LORD, watch over us *
and save us from this generation for ever.
verses.text: O LORD, watch over us * and save us from this generation for ever.

lines: The wicked prowl on every side, *
and that which is worthless is highly prized by everyone.
verses.text: The wicked prowl on every side, * and that which is worthless is highly prized by everyone.

lines: How long, O LORD?
will you forget me for ever? *
how long will you hide your face from me?
verses.text: How long, O LORD? will you forget me for ever? * how long will you hide your face from me?

lines: How long shall I have perplexity in my mind,
and grief in my heart, day after day? *
how long shall my enemy triumph over me?
verses.text: How long shall I have perplexity in my mind, and grief in my heart, day after day? * how long shall my enemy triumph over me?

lines: Look upon me and answer me, O LORD my God; *
give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
verses.text: Look upon me and answer me, O LORD my God; * give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

lines: Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed over him," *
and my foes rejoice that I have fallen.
verses.text: Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed over him," * and my foes rejoice that I have fallen.

lines: But I put my trust in your mercy; *
my heart is joyful because of your saving help.
verses.text: But I put my trust in your mercy; * my heart is joyful because of your saving help.

lines: I will sing to the LORD, for he has dealt with me richly; *
I will praise the Name of the Lord Most High.
verses.text: I will sing to the LORD, for he has dealt with me richly; * I will praise the Name of the Lord Most High.

lines: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." *
All are corrupt and commit abominable acts;
there is none who does any good.
verses.text: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." * All are corrupt and commit abominable acts; there is none who does any good.

lines: The LORD looks down from heaven upon us all, *
to see if there is any who is wise,
if there is one who seeks after God.
verses.text: The LORD looks down from heaven upon us all, * to see if there is any who is wise, if there is one who seeks after God.

lines: Every one has proved faithless;
all alike have turned bad; *
there is none who does good; no, not one.
verses.text: Every one has proved faithless; all alike have turned bad; * there is none who does good; no, not one.

lines: Have they no knowledge, all those evildoers *
who eat up my people like bread
and do not call upon the LORD?
verses.text: Have they no knowledge, all those evildoers * who eat up my people like bread and do not call upon the LORD?

lines: See how they tremble with fear, *
because God is in the company of the righteous.
verses.text: See how they tremble with fear, * because God is in the company of the righteous.

lines: Their aim is to confound the plans of the afflicted, *
but the LORD is their refuge.
verses.text: Their aim is to confound the plans of the afflicted, * but the LORD is their refuge.

lines: Oh, that Israel's deliverance would come out of Zion! *
when the LORD restores the fortunes of his people,
Jacob will rejoice and Israel be glad.
verses.text: Oh, that Israel's deliverance would come out of Zion! * when the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, Jacob will rejoice and Israel be glad.

lines: LORD, who may dwell in your tabernacle? *
who may abide upon your holy hill?
verses.text: LORD, who may dwell in your tabernacle? * who may abide upon your holy hill?

lines: Whoever leads a blameless life and does what is right, *
who speaks the truth from his heart.
verses.text: Whoever leads a blameless life and does what is right, * who speaks the truth from his heart.

lines: There is no guile upon his tongue;
he does no evil to his friend; *
he does not heap contempt upon his neighbor.
verses.text: There is no guile upon his tongue; he does no evil to his friend; * he does not heap contempt upon his neighbor.

lines: In his sight the wicked is rejected, *
but he honors those who fear the LORD.
verses.text: In his sight the wicked is rejected, * but he honors those who fear the LORD.

lines: He has sworn to do no wrong *
and does not take back his word.
verses.text: He has sworn to do no wrong * and does not take back his word.

lines: He does not give his money in hope of gain, *
nor does he take a bribe against the innocent.
verses.text: He does not give his money in hope of gain, * nor does he take a bribe against the innocent.

lines: Whoever does these things *
shall never be overthrown.
verses.text: Whoever does these things * shall never be overthrown.

lines: Protect me, O God, for I take refuge in you; *
I have said to the LORD, "You are my Lord,
my good above all other."
verses.text: Protect me, O God, for I take refuge in you; * I have said to the LORD, "You are my Lord, my good above all other."

lines: All my delight is upon the godly that are in the land, *
upon those who are noble among the people.
verses.text: All my delight is upon the godly that are in the land, * upon those who are noble among the people.

lines: But those who run after other gods *
shall have their troubles multiplied.
verses.text: But those who run after other gods * shall have their troubles multiplied.

lines: Their libations of blood I will not offer, *
nor take the names of their gods upon my lips.
verses.text: Their libations of blood I will not offer, * nor take the names of their gods upon my lips.

lines: O LORD, you are my portion and my cup; *
it is you who uphold my lot.
verses.text: O LORD, you are my portion and my cup; * it is you who uphold my lot.

lines: My boundaries enclose a pleasant land; *
indeed, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.text: My boundaries enclose a pleasant land; * indeed, I have a goodly heritage.

lines: I will bless the LORD who gives me counsel; *
my heart teaches me, night after night.
verses.text: I will bless the LORD who gives me counsel; * my heart teaches me, night after night.

lines: I have set the LORD always before me; *
because he is at my right hand I shall not fall.
verses.text: I have set the LORD always before me; * because he is at my right hand I shall not fall.

lines: My heart, therefore, is glad, and my spirit rejoices; *
my body also shall rest in hope.
verses.text: My heart, therefore, is glad, and my spirit rejoices; * my body also shall rest in hope.

lines: For you will not abandon me to the grave, *
nor let your holy one see the Pit.
verses.text: For you will not abandon me to the grave, * nor let your holy one see the Pit.

lines: You will show me the path of life; *
in your presence there is fullness of joy,
and in your right hand are pleasures for evermore.
verses.text: You will show me the path of life; * in your presence there is fullness of joy, and in your right hand are pleasures for evermore.

lines: Hear my plea of innocence, O LORD;
give heed to my cry; *
listen to my prayer, which does not come from lying lips.
verses.text: Hear my plea of innocence, O LORD; give heed to my cry; * listen to my prayer, which does not come from lying lips.

lines: Let my vindication come forth from your presence; *
let your eyes be fixed on justice.
verses.text: Let my vindication come forth from your presence; * let your eyes be fixed on justice.

lines: Weigh my heart, summon me by night, *
melt me down; you will find no impurity in me.
verses.text: Weigh my heart, summon me by night, * melt me down; you will find no impurity in me.

lines: I give no offense with my mouth as others do; *
I have heeded the words of your lips.
verses.text: I give no offense with my mouth as others do; * I have heeded the words of your lips.

lines: My footsteps hold fast to the ways of your law; *
in your paths my feet shall not stumble.
verses.text: My footsteps hold fast to the ways of your law; * in your paths my feet shall not stumble.

lines: I call upon you, O God, for you will answer me; *
incline your ear to me and hear my words.
verses.text: I call upon you, O God, for you will answer me; * incline your ear to me and hear my words.

lines: Show me your marvelous loving-kindness, *
O Savior of those who take refuge at your right hand
from those who rise up against them.
verses.text: Show me your marvelous loving-kindness, * O Savior of those who take refuge at your right hand from those who rise up against them.

lines: Keep me as the apple of your eye; *
hide me under the shadow of your wings,
verses.text: Keep me as the apple of your eye; * hide me under the shadow of your wings,

lines: From the wicked who assault me, *
from my deadly enemies who surround me.
verses.text: From the wicked who assault me, * from my deadly enemies who surround me.

lines: They have closed their heart to pity, *
and their mouth speaks proud things.
verses.text: They have closed their heart to pity, * and their mouth speaks proud things.

lines: They press me hard,
now they surround me, *
watching how they may cast me to the ground,
verses.text: They press me hard, now they surround me, * watching how they may cast me to the ground,

lines: Like a lion, greedy for its prey, *
and like a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.text: Like a lion, greedy for its prey, * and like a young lion lurking in secret places.

lines: Arise, O LORD; confront them and bring them down; *
deliver me from the wicked by your sword.
verses.text: Arise, O LORD; confront them and bring them down; * deliver me from the wicked by your sword.

lines: Deliver me, O LORD, by your hand *
from those whose portion in life is this world;
verses.text: Deliver me, O LORD, by your hand * from those whose portion in life is this world;

lines: Whose bellies you fill with your treasure, *
who are well supplied with children
and leave their wealth to their little ones.
verses.text: Whose bellies you fill with your treasure, * who are well supplied with children and leave their wealth to their little ones.

lines: But at my vindication I shall see your face; *
when I awake, I shall be satisfied, beholding
your likeness.
verses.text: But at my vindication I shall see your face; * when I awake, I shall be satisfied, beholding your likeness.

lines: I love you, O LORD my strength, *
O LORD my stronghold, my crag, and my haven.
verses.text: I love you, O LORD my strength, * O LORD my stronghold, my crag, and my haven.

lines: My God, my rock in whom I put my trust, *
my shield, the horn of my salvation, and my refuge;
you are worthy of praise.
verses.text: My God, my rock in whom I put my trust, * my shield, the horn of my salvation, and my refuge; you are worthy of praise.

lines: I will call upon the LORD, *
and so shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.text: I will call upon the LORD, * and so shall I be saved from my enemies.

lines: The breakers of death rolled over me, *
and the torrents of oblivion made me afraid.
verses.text: The breakers of death rolled over me, * and the torrents of oblivion made me afraid.

lines: The cords of hell entangled me, *
and the snares of death were set for me.
verses.text: The cords of hell entangled me, * and the snares of death were set for me.

lines: I called upon the LORD in my distress *
and cried out to my God for help.
verses.text: I called upon the LORD in my distress * and cried out to my God for help.

lines: He heard my voice from his heavenly dwelling; *
my cry of anguish came to his ears.
verses.text: He heard my voice from his heavenly dwelling; * my cry of anguish came to his ears.

lines: The earth reeled and rocked; *
the roots of the mountains shook;
they reeled because of his anger.
verses.text: The earth reeled and rocked; * the roots of the mountains shook; they reeled because of his anger.

lines: Smoke rose from his nostrils
and a consuming fire out of his mouth; *
hot burning coals blazed forth from him.
verses.text: Smoke rose from his nostrils and a consuming fire out of his mouth; * hot burning coals blazed forth from him.

lines: He parted the heavens and came down *
with a storm cloud under his feet.
verses.text: He parted the heavens and came down * with a storm cloud under his feet.

lines: He mounted on cherubim and flew; *
he swooped on the wings of the wind.
verses.text: He mounted on cherubim and flew; * he swooped on the wings of the wind.

lines: He wrapped darkness about him; *
he made dark waters and thick clouds his pavilion.
verses.text: He wrapped darkness about him; * he made dark waters and thick clouds his pavilion.

lines: From the brightness of his presence, through the clouds, *
burst hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.text: From the brightness of his presence, through the clouds, * burst hailstones and coals of fire.

lines: The LORD thundered out of heaven; *
the Most High uttered his voice.
verses.text: The LORD thundered out of heaven; * the Most High uttered his voice.

lines: He loosed his arrows and scattered them; *
he hurled thunderbolts and routed them.
verses.text: He loosed his arrows and scattered them; * he hurled thunderbolts and routed them.

lines: The beds of the seas were uncovered,
and the foundations of the world laid bare, *
at your battle cry, O LORD,
at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
verses.text: The beds of the seas were uncovered, and the foundations of the world laid bare, * at your battle cry, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

lines: He reached down from on high and grasped me; *
he drew me out of great waters.
verses.text: He reached down from on high and grasped me; * he drew me out of great waters.

lines: He delivered me from my strong enemies
and from those who hated me; *
for they were too mighty for me.
verses.text: He delivered me from my strong enemies and from those who hated me; * for they were too mighty for me.

lines: They confronted me in the day of my disaster; *
but the LORD was my support.
verses.text: They confronted me in the day of my disaster; * but the LORD was my support.

lines: He brought me out into an open place; *
he rescued me because he delighted in me.
verses.text: He brought me out into an open place; * he rescued me because he delighted in me.

lines: The LORD rewarded me because of my righteous dealing; *
because my hands were clean he rewarded me;
verses.text: The LORD rewarded me because of my righteous dealing; * because my hands were clean he rewarded me;

lines: For I have kept the ways of the LORD *
and have not offended against my God;
verses.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD * and have not offended against my God;

lines: For all his judgments are before my eyes, *
and his decrees I have not put away from me;
verses.text: For all his judgments are before my eyes, * and his decrees I have not put away from me;

lines: For I have been blameless with him *
and have kept myself from iniquity;
verses.text: For I have been blameless with him * and have kept myself from iniquity;

lines: Therefore the LORD rewarded me according to my
righteous dealing, *
because of the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
verses.text: Therefore the LORD rewarded me according to my righteous dealing, * because of the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

lines: With the faithful you show yourself faithful, O God; *
with the forthright you show yourself forthright.
verses.text: With the faithful you show yourself faithful, O God; * with the forthright you show yourself forthright.

lines: With the pure you show yourself pure, *
but with the crooked you are wily.
verses.text: With the pure you show yourself pure, * but with the crooked you are wily.

lines: You will save a lowly people, *
but you will humble the haughty eyes.
verses.text: You will save a lowly people, * but you will humble the haughty eyes.

lines: You, O LORD, are my lamp; *
my God, you make my darkness bright.
verses.text: You, O LORD, are my lamp; * my God, you make my darkness bright.

lines: With you I will break down an enclosure; *
with the help of my God I will scale any wall.
verses.text: With you I will break down an enclosure; * with the help of my God I will scale any wall.

lines: As for God, his ways are perfect;
the words of the LORD are tried in the fire; *
he is a shield to all who trust in him.
verses.text: As for God, his ways are perfect; the words of the LORD are tried in the fire; * he is a shield to all who trust in him.

lines: For who is God, but the LORD? *
who is the Rock, except our God?
verses.text: For who is God, but the LORD? * who is the Rock, except our God?

lines: It is God who girds me about with strength *
and makes my way secure.
verses.text: It is God who girds me about with strength * and makes my way secure.

lines: He makes me sure-footed like a deer *
and lets me stand firm on the heights.
verses.text: He makes me sure-footed like a deer * and lets me stand firm on the heights.

lines: He trains my hands for battle *
and my arms for bending even a bow of bronze.
verses.text: He trains my hands for battle * and my arms for bending even a bow of bronze.

lines: You have given me your shield of victory; *
your right hand also sustains me;
your loving care makes me great.
verses.text: You have given me your shield of victory; * your right hand also sustains me; your loving care makes me great.

lines: You lengthen my stride beneath me, *
and my ankles do not give way.
verses.text: You lengthen my stride beneath me, * and my ankles do not give way.

lines: I pursue my enemies and overtake them; *
I will not turn back till I have destroyed them.
verses.text: I pursue my enemies and overtake them; * I will not turn back till I have destroyed them.

lines: I strike them down, and they cannot rise; *
they fall defeated at my feet.
verses.text: I strike them down, and they cannot rise; * they fall defeated at my feet.

lines: You have girded me with strength for the battle; *
you have cast down my adversaries beneath me;
you have put my enemies to flight.
verses.text: You have girded me with strength for the battle; * you have cast down my adversaries beneath me; you have put my enemies to flight.

lines: I destroy those who hate me;
they cry out, but there is none to help them; *
they cry to the LORD, but he does not answer.
verses.text: I destroy those who hate me; they cry out, but there is none to help them; * they cry to the LORD, but he does not answer.

lines: I beat them small like dust before the wind; *
I trample them like mud in the streets.
verses.text: I beat them small like dust before the wind; * I trample them like mud in the streets.

lines: You deliver me from the strife of the peoples; *
you put me at the head of the nations.
verses.text: You deliver me from the strife of the peoples; * you put me at the head of the nations.

lines: A people I have not known shall serve me;
no sooner shall they hear than they shall obey me; *
strangers will cringe before me.
verses.text: A people I have not known shall serve me; no sooner shall they hear than they shall obey me; * strangers will cringe before me.

lines: The foreign peoples will lose heart; *
they shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
verses.text: The foreign peoples will lose heart; * they shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

lines: The LORD lives!   Blessed is my Rock! *
Exalted is the God of my salvation!
verses.text: The LORD lives! Blessed is my Rock! * Exalted is the God of my salvation!

lines: He is the God who gave me victory *
and cast down the peoples beneath me.
verses.text: He is the God who gave me victory * and cast down the peoples beneath me.

lines: You rescued me from the fury of my enemies;
you exalted me above those who rose against me; *
you saved me from my deadly foe.
verses.text: You rescued me from the fury of my enemies; you exalted me above those who rose against me; * you saved me from my deadly foe.

lines: Therefore will I extol you among the nations, O LORD, *
and sing praises to your Name.
verses.text: Therefore will I extol you among the nations, O LORD, * and sing praises to your Name.

lines: He multiplies the victories of his king; *
he shows loving-kindness to his anointed,
to David and his descendants for ever.
verses.text: He multiplies the victories of his king; * he shows loving-kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants for ever.

lines: The heavens declare the glory of God, *
and the firmament shows his handiwork.
verses.text: The heavens declare the glory of God, * and the firmament shows his handiwork.

lines: One day tells its tale to another, *
and one night imparts knowledge to another.
verses.text: One day tells its tale to another, * and one night imparts knowledge to another.

lines: Although they have no words or language, *
and their voices are not heard,
verses.text: Although they have no words or language, * and their voices are not heard,

lines: Their sound has gone out into all lands, *
and their message to the ends of the world.
verses.text: Their sound has gone out into all lands, * and their message to the ends of the world.

lines: In the deep has he set a pavilion for the sun; *
it comes forth like a bridegroom out of his chamber;
it rejoices like a champion to run its course.
verses.text: In the deep has he set a pavilion for the sun; * it comes forth like a bridegroom out of his chamber; it rejoices like a champion to run its course.

lines: It goes forth from the uttermost edge of the heavens
and runs about to the end of it again; *
nothing is hidden from its burning heat.
verses.text: It goes forth from the uttermost edge of the heavens and runs about to the end of it again; * nothing is hidden from its burning heat.

lines: The law of the LORD is perfect
and revives the soul; *
the testimony of the LORD is sure
and gives wisdom to the innocent.
verses.text: The law of the LORD is perfect and revives the soul; * the testimony of the LORD is sure and gives wisdom to the innocent.

lines: The statutes of the LORD are just
and rejoice the heart; *
the commandment of the LORD is clear
and gives light to the eyes.
verses.text: The statutes of the LORD are just and rejoice the heart; * the commandment of the LORD is clear and gives light to the eyes.

lines: The fear of the LORD is clean
and endures for ever; *
the judgments of the LORD are true
and righteous altogether.
verses.text: The fear of the LORD is clean and endures for ever; * the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

lines: More to be desired are they than gold,
more than much fine gold, *
sweeter far than honey,
than honey in the comb.
verses.text: More to be desired are they than gold, more than much fine gold, * sweeter far than honey, than honey in the comb.

lines: By them also is your servant enlightened, *
and in keeping them there is great reward.
verses.text: By them also is your servant enlightened, * and in keeping them there is great reward.

lines: Who can tell how often he offends? *
cleanse me from my secret faults.
verses.text: Who can tell how often he offends? * cleanse me from my secret faults.

lines: Above all, keep your servant from presumptuous sins;
let them not get dominion over me; *
then shall I be whole and sound,
and innocent of a great offense.
verses.text: Above all, keep your servant from presumptuous sins; let them not get dominion over me; * then shall I be whole and sound, and innocent of a great offense.

lines: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my
heart be acceptable in your sight, *
O LORD, my strength and my redeemer.
verses.text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, * O LORD, my strength and my redeemer.

lines: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble, *
the Name of the God of Jacob defend you;
verses.text: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble, * the Name of the God of Jacob defend you;

lines: Send you help from his holy place *
and strengthen you out of Zion;
verses.text: Send you help from his holy place * and strengthen you out of Zion;

lines: Remember all your offerings *
and accept your burnt sacrifice;
verses.text: Remember all your offerings * and accept your burnt sacrifice;

lines: Grant you your heart's desire *
and prosper all your plans.
verses.text: Grant you your heart's desire * and prosper all your plans.

lines: We will shout for joy at your victory
and triumph in the Name of our God; *
may the LORD grant all your requests.
verses.text: We will shout for joy at your victory and triumph in the Name of our God; * may the LORD grant all your requests.

lines: Now I know that the LORD gives victory to his anointed; *
he will answer him out of his holy heaven,
with the victorious strength of his right hand.
verses.text: Now I know that the LORD gives victory to his anointed; * he will answer him out of his holy heaven, with the victorious strength of his right hand.

lines: Some put their trust in chariots and some in horses, *
but we will call upon the Name of the LORD our God.
verses.text: Some put their trust in chariots and some in horses, * but we will call upon the Name of the LORD our God.

lines: They collapse and fall down, *
but we will arise and stand upright.
verses.text: They collapse and fall down, * but we will arise and stand upright.

lines: O LORD, give victory to the king *
and answer us when we call.
verses.text: O LORD, give victory to the king * and answer us when we call.

lines: The king rejoices in your strength, O LORD; *
how greatly he exults in your victory!
verses.text: The king rejoices in your strength, O LORD; * how greatly he exults in your victory!

lines: You have given him his heart's desire; *
you have not denied him the request of his lips.
verses.text: You have given him his heart's desire; * you have not denied him the request of his lips.

lines: For you meet him with blessings of prosperity, *
and set a crown of fine gold upon his head.
verses.text: For you meet him with blessings of prosperity, * and set a crown of fine gold upon his head.

lines: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him: *
length of days, for ever and ever.
verses.text: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him: * length of days, for ever and ever.

lines: His honor is great, because of your victory; *
splendor and majesty have you bestowed upon him.
verses.text: His honor is great, because of your victory; * splendor and majesty have you bestowed upon him.

lines: For you will give him everlasting felicity *
and will make him glad with the joy of your presence.
verses.text: For you will give him everlasting felicity * and will make him glad with the joy of your presence.

lines: For the king puts his trust in the LORD; *
because of the loving-kindness of the Most High, he
will not fall.
verses.text: For the king puts his trust in the LORD; * because of the loving-kindness of the Most High, he will not fall.

lines: Your hand will lay hold upon all your enemies; *
your right hand will seize all those who hate you.
verses.text: Your hand will lay hold upon all your enemies; * your right hand will seize all those who hate you.

lines: You will make them like a fiery furnace *
at the time of your appearing, O LORD;
verses.text: You will make them like a fiery furnace * at the time of your appearing, O LORD;

lines: You will swallow them up in your wrath, *
and fire shall consume them.
verses.text: You will swallow them up in your wrath, * and fire shall consume them.

lines: You will destroy their offspring from the land *
and their descendants from among the peoples of the earth.
verses.text: You will destroy their offspring from the land * and their descendants from among the peoples of the earth.

lines: Though they intend evil against you
and devise wicked schemes, *
yet they shall not prevail.
verses.text: Though they intend evil against you and devise wicked schemes, * yet they shall not prevail.

lines: For you will put them to flight *
and aim your arrows at them.
verses.text: For you will put them to flight * and aim your arrows at them.

lines: Be exalted, O LORD, in your might; *
we will sing and praise your power.
verses.text: Be exalted, O LORD, in your might; * we will sing and praise your power.

lines: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? *
and are so far from my cry
and from the words of my distress?
verses.text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? * and are so far from my cry and from the words of my distress?

lines: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but you do not answer; *
by night as well, but I find no rest.
verses.text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but you do not answer; * by night as well, but I find no rest.

lines: Yet you are the Holy One, *
enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
verses.text: Yet you are the Holy One, * enthroned upon the praises of Israel.

lines: Our forefathers put their trust in you; *
they trusted, and you delivered them.
verses.text: Our forefathers put their trust in you; * they trusted, and you delivered them.

lines: They cried out to you and were delivered; *
they trusted in you and were not put to shame.
verses.text: They cried out to you and were delivered; * they trusted in you and were not put to shame.

lines: But as for me, I am a worm and no man, *
scorned by all and despised by the people.
verses.text: But as for me, I am a worm and no man, * scorned by all and despised by the people.

lines: All who see me laugh me to scorn; *
they curl their lips and wag their heads, saying,
verses.text: All who see me laugh me to scorn; * they curl their lips and wag their heads, saying,

lines: "He trusted in the LORD; let him deliver him; *
let him rescue him, if he delights in him."
verses.text: "He trusted in the LORD; let him deliver him; * let him rescue him, if he delights in him."

lines: Yet you are he who took me out of the womb, *
and kept me safe upon my mother's breast.
verses.text: Yet you are he who took me out of the womb, * and kept me safe upon my mother's breast.

lines: I have been entrusted to you ever since I was born; *
you were my God when I was still in my
mother's womb.
verses.text: I have been entrusted to you ever since I was born; * you were my God when I was still in my mother's womb.

lines: Be not far from me, for trouble is near, *
and there is none to help.
verses.text: Be not far from me, for trouble is near, * and there is none to help.

lines: Many young bulls encircle me; *
strong bulls of Bashan surround me.
verses.text: Many young bulls encircle me; * strong bulls of Bashan surround me.

lines: They open wide their jaws at me, *
like a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.text: They open wide their jaws at me, * like a ravening and a roaring lion.

lines: I am poured out like water;
all my bones are out of joint; *
my heart within my breast is melting wax.
verses.text: I am poured out like water; all my bones are out of joint; * my heart within my breast is melting wax.

lines: My mouth is dried out like a pot-sherd;
my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; *
and you have laid me in the dust of the grave.
verses.text: My mouth is dried out like a pot-sherd; my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; * and you have laid me in the dust of the grave.

lines: Packs of dogs close me in,
and gangs of evildoers circle around me; *
they pierce my hands and my feet;
I can count all my bones.
verses.text: Packs of dogs close me in, and gangs of evildoers circle around me; * they pierce my hands and my feet; I can count all my bones.

lines: They stare and gloat over me; *
they divide my garments among them;
they cast lots for my clothing.
verses.text: They stare and gloat over me; * they divide my garments among them; they cast lots for my clothing.

lines: Be not far away, O LORD; *
you are my strength; hasten to help me.
verses.text: Be not far away, O LORD; * you are my strength; hasten to help me.

lines: Save me from the sword, *
my life from the power of the dog.
verses.text: Save me from the sword, * my life from the power of the dog.

lines: Save me from the lion's mouth, *
my wretched body from the horns of wild bulls.
verses.text: Save me from the lion's mouth, * my wretched body from the horns of wild bulls.

lines: I will declare your Name to my brethren; *
in the midst of the congregation I will praise you.
verses.text: I will declare your Name to my brethren; * in the midst of the congregation I will praise you.

lines: Praise the LORD, you that fear him; *
stand in awe of him, O offspring of Israel;
all you of Jacob's line, give glory.
verses.text: Praise the LORD, you that fear him; * stand in awe of him, O offspring of Israel; all you of Jacob's line, give glory.

lines: For he does not despise nor abhor the poor in their poverty;
neither does he hide his face from them; *
but when they cry to him he hears them.
verses.text: For he does not despise nor abhor the poor in their poverty; neither does he hide his face from them; * but when they cry to him he hears them.

lines: My praise is of him in the great assembly; *
I will perform my vows in the presence of those who
worship him.
verses.text: My praise is of him in the great assembly; * I will perform my vows in the presence of those who worship him.

lines: The poor shall eat and be satisfied,
and those who seek the LORD shall praise him: *
"May your heart live for ever!"
verses.text: The poor shall eat and be satisfied, and those who seek the LORD shall praise him: * "May your heart live for ever!"

lines: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to
the LORD, *
and all the families of the nations bow before him.
verses.text: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD, * and all the families of the nations bow before him.

lines: For kingship belongs to the LORD; *
he rules over the nations.
verses.text: For kingship belongs to the LORD; * he rules over the nations.

lines: To him alone all who sleep in the earth bow down
in worship; *
all who go down to the dust fall before him.
verses.text: To him alone all who sleep in the earth bow down in worship; * all who go down to the dust fall before him.

lines: My soul shall live for him;
my descendants shall serve him; *
they shall be known as the LORD'S for ever.
verses.text: My soul shall live for him; my descendants shall serve him; * they shall be known as the LORD'S for ever.

lines: They shall come and make known to a people yet unborn *
the saving deeds that he has done.
verses.text: They shall come and make known to a people yet unborn * the saving deeds that he has done.

lines: The LORD is my shepherd; *
I shall not be in want.
verses.text: The LORD is my shepherd; * I shall not be in want.

lines: He makes me lie down in green pastures *
and leads me beside still waters.
verses.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures * and leads me beside still waters.

lines: He revives my soul *
and guides me along right pathways for his Name's sake.
verses.text: He revives my soul * and guides me along right pathways for his Name's sake.

lines: Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I shall fear no evil; *
for you are with me;
your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.text: Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I shall fear no evil; * for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

lines: You spread a table before me in the presence of those
who trouble me; *
you have anointed my head with oil,
and my cup is running over.
verses.text: You spread a table before me in the presence of those who trouble me; * you have anointed my head with oil, and my cup is running over.

lines: Surely your goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days
of my life, *
and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.text: Surely your goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, * and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

lines: The earth is the LORD'S and all that is in it, *
the world and all who dwell therein.
verses.text: The earth is the LORD'S and all that is in it, * the world and all who dwell therein.

lines: For it is he who founded it upon the seas *
and made it firm upon the rivers of the deep.
verses.text: For it is he who founded it upon the seas * and made it firm upon the rivers of the deep.

lines: "Who can ascend the hill of the LORD? *
and who can stand in his holy place?"
verses.text: "Who can ascend the hill of the LORD? * and who can stand in his holy place?"

lines: "Those who have clean hands and a pure heart, *
who have not pledged themselves to falsehood,
nor sworn by what is a fraud.
verses.text: "Those who have clean hands and a pure heart, * who have not pledged themselves to falsehood, nor sworn by what is a fraud.

lines: They shall receive a blessing from the LORD *
and a just reward from the God of their salvation."
verses.text: They shall receive a blessing from the LORD * and a just reward from the God of their salvation."

lines: Such is the generation of those who seek him, *
of those who seek your face, O God of Jacob.
verses.text: Such is the generation of those who seek him, * of those who seek your face, O God of Jacob.

lines: Lift up your heads, O gates;
lift them high, O everlasting doors; *
and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates; lift them high, O everlasting doors; * and the King of glory shall come in.

lines: "Who is this King of glory?" *
"The LORD, strong and mighty,
the LORD, mighty in battle."
verses.text: "Who is this King of glory?" * "The LORD, strong and mighty, the LORD, mighty in battle."

lines: Lift up your heads, O gates;
lift them high, O everlasting doors; *
and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates; lift them high, O everlasting doors; * and the King of glory shall come in.

lines: "Who is he, this King of glory?" *
"The LORD of hosts,
he is the King of glory."
verses.text: "Who is he, this King of glory?" * "The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory."

lines: To you, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
my God, I put my trust in you; *
let me not be humiliated,
nor let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.text: To you, O LORD, I lift up my soul; my God, I put my trust in you; * let me not be humiliated, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

lines: Let none who look to you be put to shame; *
let the treacherous be disappointed in their schemes.
verses.text: Let none who look to you be put to shame; * let the treacherous be disappointed in their schemes.

lines: Show me your ways, O LORD, *
and teach me your paths.
verses.text: Show me your ways, O LORD, * and teach me your paths.

lines: Lead me in your truth and teach me, *
for you are the God of my salvation;
in you have I trusted all the day long.
verses.text: Lead me in your truth and teach me, * for you are the God of my salvation; in you have I trusted all the day long.

lines: Remember, O LORD, your compassion and love, *
for they are from everlasting.
verses.text: Remember, O LORD, your compassion and love, * for they are from everlasting.

lines: Remember not the sins of my youth and my transgressions; *
remember me according to your love
and for the sake of your goodness, O LORD.
verses.text: Remember not the sins of my youth and my transgressions; * remember me according to your love and for the sake of your goodness, O LORD.

lines: Gracious and upright is the LORD; *
therefore he teaches sinners in his way.
verses.text: Gracious and upright is the LORD; * therefore he teaches sinners in his way.

lines: He guides the humble in doing right *
and teaches his way to the lowly.
verses.text: He guides the humble in doing right * and teaches his way to the lowly.

lines: All the paths of the LORD are love and faithfulness *
to those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.text: All the paths of the LORD are love and faithfulness * to those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.

lines: For your Name's sake, O LORD, *
forgive my sin, for it is great.
verses.text: For your Name's sake, O LORD, * forgive my sin, for it is great.

lines: Who are they who fear the LORD? *
he will teach them the way that they should choose.
verses.text: Who are they who fear the LORD? * he will teach them the way that they should choose.

lines: They shall dwell in prosperity, *
and their offspring shall inherit the land.
verses.text: They shall dwell in prosperity, * and their offspring shall inherit the land.

lines: The LORD is a friend to those who fear him *
and will show them his covenant.
verses.text: The LORD is a friend to those who fear him * and will show them his covenant.

lines: My eyes are ever looking to the LORD, *
for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.text: My eyes are ever looking to the LORD, * for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

lines: Turn to me and have pity on me, *
for I am left alone and in misery.
verses.text: Turn to me and have pity on me, * for I am left alone and in misery.

lines: The sorrows of my heart have increased; *
bring me out of my troubles.
verses.text: The sorrows of my heart have increased; * bring me out of my troubles.

lines: Look upon my adversity and misery *
and forgive me all my sin.
verses.text: Look upon my adversity and misery * and forgive me all my sin.

lines: Look upon my enemies, for they are many, *
and they bear a violent hatred against me.
verses.text: Look upon my enemies, for they are many, * and they bear a violent hatred against me.

lines: Protect my life and deliver me; *
let me not be put to shame, for I have trusted in you.
verses.text: Protect my life and deliver me; * let me not be put to shame, for I have trusted in you.

lines: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, *
for my hope has been in you.
verses.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, * for my hope has been in you.

lines: Deliver Israel, O God, *
out of all his troubles.
verses.text: Deliver Israel, O God, * out of all his troubles.

lines: Give judgment for me, O LORD,
for I have lived with integrity; *
I have trusted in the Lord and have not faltered.
verses.text: Give judgment for me, O LORD, for I have lived with integrity; * I have trusted in the Lord and have not faltered.

lines: Test me, O LORD, and try me; *
examine my heart and my mind.
verses.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; * examine my heart and my mind.

lines: For your love is before my eyes; *
I have walked faithfully with you.
verses.text: For your love is before my eyes; * I have walked faithfully with you.

lines: I have not sat with the worthless, *
nor do I consort with the deceitful.
verses.text: I have not sat with the worthless, * nor do I consort with the deceitful.

lines: I have hated the company of evildoers; *
I will not sit down with the wicked.
verses.text: I have hated the company of evildoers; * I will not sit down with the wicked.

lines: I will wash my hands in innocence, O LORD, *
that I may go in procession round your altar,
verses.text: I will wash my hands in innocence, O LORD, * that I may go in procession round your altar,

lines: Singing aloud a song of thanksgiving *
and recounting all your wonderful deeds.
verses.text: Singing aloud a song of thanksgiving * and recounting all your wonderful deeds.

lines: LORD, I love the house in which you dwell *
and the place where your glory abides.
verses.text: LORD, I love the house in which you dwell * and the place where your glory abides.

lines: Do not sweep me away with sinners, *
nor my life with those who thirst for blood,
verses.text: Do not sweep me away with sinners, * nor my life with those who thirst for blood,

lines: Whose hands are full of evil plots, *
and their right hand full of bribes.
verses.text: Whose hands are full of evil plots, * and their right hand full of bribes.

lines: As for me, I will live with integrity; *
redeem me, O LORD, and have pity on me.
verses.text: As for me, I will live with integrity; * redeem me, O LORD, and have pity on me.

lines: My foot stands on level ground; *
in the full assembly I will bless the LORD.
verses.text: My foot stands on level ground; * in the full assembly I will bless the LORD.

lines: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
whom then shall I fear? *
the LORD is the strength of my life;
of whom then shall I be afraid?
verses.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom then shall I fear? * the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom then shall I be afraid?

lines: When evildoers came upon me to eat up my flesh, *
it was they, my foes and my adversaries, who
stumbled and fell.
verses.text: When evildoers came upon me to eat up my flesh, * it was they, my foes and my adversaries, who stumbled and fell.

lines: Though an army should encamp against me, *
yet my heart shall not be afraid;
verses.text: Though an army should encamp against me, * yet my heart shall not be afraid;

lines: And though war should rise up against me, *
yet will I put my trust in him.
verses.text: And though war should rise up against me, * yet will I put my trust in him.

lines: One thing have I asked of the LORD;
one thing I seek; *
that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days
of my life;
verses.text: One thing have I asked of the LORD; one thing I seek; * that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life;

lines: To behold the fair beauty of the LORD *
and to seek him in his temple.
verses.text: To behold the fair beauty of the LORD * and to seek him in his temple.

lines: For in the day of trouble he shall keep me safe
in his shelter; *
he shall hide me in the secrecy of his dwelling
and set me high upon a rock.
verses.text: For in the day of trouble he shall keep me safe in his shelter; * he shall hide me in the secrecy of his dwelling and set me high upon a rock.

lines: Even now he lifts up my head *
above my enemies round about me.
verses.text: Even now he lifts up my head * above my enemies round about me.

lines: Therefore I will offer in his dwelling an oblation
with sounds of great gladness; *
I will sing and make music to the LORD.
verses.text: Therefore I will offer in his dwelling an oblation with sounds of great gladness; * I will sing and make music to the LORD.

lines: Hearken to my voice, O LORD, when I call; *
have mercy on me and answer me.
verses.text: Hearken to my voice, O LORD, when I call; * have mercy on me and answer me.

lines: You speak in my heart and say, "Seek my face." *
Your face, LORD, will I seek.
verses.text: You speak in my heart and say, "Seek my face." * Your face, LORD, will I seek.

lines: Hide not your face from me, *
nor turn away your servant in displeasure.
verses.text: Hide not your face from me, * nor turn away your servant in displeasure.

lines: You have been my helper;
cast me not away; *
do not forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.text: You have been my helper; cast me not away; * do not forsake me, O God of my salvation.

lines: Though my father and my mother forsake me, *
the LORD will sustain me.
verses.text: Though my father and my mother forsake me, * the LORD will sustain me.

lines: Show me your way, O LORD; *
lead me on a level path, because of my enemies.
verses.text: Show me your way, O LORD; * lead me on a level path, because of my enemies.

lines: Deliver me not into the hand of my adversaries, *
for false witnesses have risen up against me,
and also those who speak malice.
verses.text: Deliver me not into the hand of my adversaries, * for false witnesses have risen up against me, and also those who speak malice.

lines: What if I had not believed
that I should see the goodness of the LORD *
in the land of the living!
verses.text: What if I had not believed that I should see the goodness of the LORD * in the land of the living!

lines: O tarry and await the LORD'S pleasure;
be strong, and he shall comfort your heart; *
wait patiently for the LORD.
verses.text: O tarry and await the LORD'S pleasure; be strong, and he shall comfort your heart; * wait patiently for the LORD.

lines: O LORD, I call to you;
my Rock, do not be deaf to my cry; *
lest, if you do not hear me,
I become like those who go down to the Pit.
verses.text: O LORD, I call to you; my Rock, do not be deaf to my cry; * lest, if you do not hear me, I become like those who go down to the Pit.

lines: Hear the voice of my prayer when I cry out to you, *
when I lift up my hands to your holy of holies.
verses.text: Hear the voice of my prayer when I cry out to you, * when I lift up my hands to your holy of holies.

lines: Do not snatch me away with the wicked or with the
evildoers, *
who speak peaceably with their neighbors,
while strife is in their hearts.
verses.text: Do not snatch me away with the wicked or with the evildoers, * who speak peaceably with their neighbors, while strife is in their hearts.

lines: Repay them according to their deeds, *
and according to the wickedness of their actions.
verses.text: Repay them according to their deeds, * and according to the wickedness of their actions.

lines: According to the work of their hands repay them, *
and give them their just deserts.
verses.text: According to the work of their hands repay them, * and give them their just deserts.

lines: They have no understanding of the LORD'S doings,
nor of the works of his hands; *
therefore he will break them down and not
build them up.
verses.text: They have no understanding of the LORD'S doings, nor of the works of his hands; * therefore he will break them down and not build them up.

lines: Blessed is the LORD! *
for he has heard the voice of my prayer.
verses.text: Blessed is the LORD! * for he has heard the voice of my prayer.

lines: The LORD is my strength and my shield; *
my heart trusts in him, and I have been helped;
verses.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; * my heart trusts in him, and I have been helped;

lines: Therefore my heart dances for joy, *
and in my song will I praise him.
verses.text: Therefore my heart dances for joy, * and in my song will I praise him.

lines: The LORD is the strength of his people, *
a safe refuge for his anointed.
verses.text: The LORD is the strength of his people, * a safe refuge for his anointed.

lines: Save your people and bless your inheritance; *
shepherd them and carry them for ever.
verses.text: Save your people and bless your inheritance; * shepherd them and carry them for ever.

lines: Ascribe to the LORD, you gods, *
ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD, you gods, * ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

lines: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his Name; *
worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his Name; * worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

lines: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters;
the God of glory thunders; *
the LORD is upon the mighty waters.
verses.text: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters; the God of glory thunders; * the LORD is upon the mighty waters.

lines: The voice of the LORD is a powerful voice; *
the voice of the LORD is a voice of splendor.
verses.text: The voice of the LORD is a powerful voice; * the voice of the LORD is a voice of splendor.

lines: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedar trees; *
the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon;
verses.text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedar trees; * the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon;

lines: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, *
and Mount Hermon like a young wild ox.
verses.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, * and Mount Hermon like a young wild ox.

lines: The voice of the LORD splits the flames of fire;
the voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; *
the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
