verses.text: The voice of the LORD splits the flames of fire; the voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; * the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

lines: The voice of the LORD makes the oak trees writhe *
and strips the forests bare.
verses.text: The voice of the LORD makes the oak trees writhe * and strips the forests bare.

lines: And in the temple of the LORD *
all are crying, "Glory!"
verses.text: And in the temple of the LORD * all are crying, "Glory!"

lines: The LORD sits enthroned above the flood; *
the LORD sits enthroned as King for evermore.
verses.text: The LORD sits enthroned above the flood; * the LORD sits enthroned as King for evermore.

lines: The LORD shall give strength to his people; *
the LORD shall give his people the blessing of peace.
verses.text: The LORD shall give strength to his people; * the LORD shall give his people the blessing of peace.

lines: I will exalt you, O LORD,
because you have lifted me up *
and have not let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.text: I will exalt you, O LORD, because you have lifted me up * and have not let my enemies triumph over me.

lines: O LORD my God, I cried out to you, *
and you restored me to health.
verses.text: O LORD my God, I cried out to you, * and you restored me to health.

lines: You brought me up, O LORD, from the dead; *
you restored my life as I was going down to the grave.
verses.text: You brought me up, O LORD, from the dead; * you restored my life as I was going down to the grave.

lines: Sing to the LORD, you servants of his; *
give thanks for the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD, you servants of his; * give thanks for the remembrance of his holiness.

lines: For his wrath endures but the twinkling of an eye, *
his favor for a lifetime.
verses.text: For his wrath endures but the twinkling of an eye, * his favor for a lifetime.

lines: Weeping may spend the night, *
but joy comes in the morning.
verses.text: Weeping may spend the night, * but joy comes in the morning.

lines: While I felt secure, I said,
"I shall never be disturbed. *
You, LORD, with your favor, made me as strong as
the mountains."
verses.text: While I felt secure, I said, "I shall never be disturbed. * You, LORD, with your favor, made me as strong as the mountains."

lines: Then you hid your face, *
and I was filled with fear.
verses.text: Then you hid your face, * and I was filled with fear.

lines: I cried to you, O LORD; *
I pleaded with the Lord, saying,
verses.text: I cried to you, O LORD; * I pleaded with the Lord, saying,

lines: "What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to the Pit? *
will the dust praise you or declare your faithfulness?
verses.text: "What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to the Pit? * will the dust praise you or declare your faithfulness?

lines: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me; *
O LORD, be my helper."
verses.text: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me; * O LORD, be my helper."

lines: You have turned my wailing into dancing; *
you have put off my sack-cloth and clothed me with joy.
verses.text: You have turned my wailing into dancing; * you have put off my sack-cloth and clothed me with joy.

lines: Therefore my heart sings to you without ceasing; *
O LORD my God, I will give you thanks for ever.
verses.text: Therefore my heart sings to you without ceasing; * O LORD my God, I will give you thanks for ever.

lines: In you, O LORD, have I taken refuge;
let me never be put to shame; *
deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.text: In you, O LORD, have I taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; * deliver me in your righteousness.

lines: Incline your ear to me; *
make haste to deliver me.
verses.text: Incline your ear to me; * make haste to deliver me.

lines: Be my strong rock, a castle to keep me safe,
for you are my crag and my stronghold; *
for the sake of your Name, lead me and guide me.
verses.text: Be my strong rock, a castle to keep me safe, for you are my crag and my stronghold; * for the sake of your Name, lead me and guide me.

lines: Take me out of the net that they have secretly set for me, *
for you are my tower of strength.
verses.text: Take me out of the net that they have secretly set for me, * for you are my tower of strength.

lines: Into your hands I commend my spirit, *
for you have redeemed me,
O LORD, O God of truth.
verses.text: Into your hands I commend my spirit, * for you have redeemed me, O LORD, O God of truth.

lines: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, *
and I put my trust in the LORD.
verses.text: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, * and I put my trust in the LORD.

lines: I will rejoice and be glad because of your mercy; *
for you have seen my affliction;
you know my distress.
verses.text: I will rejoice and be glad because of your mercy; * for you have seen my affliction; you know my distress.

lines: You have not shut me up in the power of the enemy; *
you have set my feet in an open place.
verses.text: You have not shut me up in the power of the enemy; * you have set my feet in an open place.

lines: Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am in trouble; *
my eye is consumed with sorrow,
and also my throat and my belly.
verses.text: Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am in trouble; * my eye is consumed with sorrow, and also my throat and my belly.

lines: For my life is wasted with grief,
and my years with sighing; *
my strength fails me because of affliction,
and my bones are consumed.
verses.text: For my life is wasted with grief, and my years with sighing; * my strength fails me because of affliction, and my bones are consumed.

lines: I have become a reproach to all my enemies and
even to my neighbors,
a dismay to those of my acquaintance; *
when they see me in the street they avoid me.
verses.text: I have become a reproach to all my enemies and even to my neighbors, a dismay to those of my acquaintance; * when they see me in the street they avoid me.

lines: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; *
I am as useless as a broken pot.
verses.text: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; * I am as useless as a broken pot.

lines: For I have heard the whispering of the crowd;
fear is all around; *
they put their heads together against me;
they plot to take my life.
verses.text: For I have heard the whispering of the crowd; fear is all around; * they put their heads together against me; they plot to take my life.

lines: But as for me, I have trusted in you, O LORD. *
I have said, "You are my God.
verses.text: But as for me, I have trusted in you, O LORD. * I have said, "You are my God.

lines: My times are in your hand; *
rescue me from the hand of my enemies,
and from those who persecute me.
verses.text: My times are in your hand; * rescue me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

lines: Make your face to shine upon your servant, *
and in your loving-kindness save me."
verses.text: Make your face to shine upon your servant, * and in your loving-kindness save me."

lines: LORD, let me not be ashamed for having called upon you; *
rather, let the wicked be put to shame;
let them be silent in the grave.
verses.text: LORD, let me not be ashamed for having called upon you; * rather, let the wicked be put to shame; let them be silent in the grave.

lines: Let the lying lips be silenced which speak against
the righteous, *
haughtily, disdainfully, and with contempt.
verses.text: Let the lying lips be silenced which speak against the righteous, * haughtily, disdainfully, and with contempt.

lines: How great is your goodness, O LORD!
which you have laid up for those who fear you; *
which you have done in the sight of all
for those who put their trust in you.
verses.text: How great is your goodness, O LORD! which you have laid up for those who fear you; * which you have done in the sight of all for those who put their trust in you.

lines: You hide them in the covert of your presence from those
who slander them; *
you keep them in your shelter from the strife of tongues.
verses.text: You hide them in the covert of your presence from those who slander them; * you keep them in your shelter from the strife of tongues.

lines: Blessed be the LORD! *
for he has shown me the wonders of his love in a
besieged city.
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD! * for he has shown me the wonders of his love in a besieged city.

lines: Yet I said in my alarm,
I have been cut off from the sight of your eyes." *
Nevertheless, you heard the sound of my entreaty
when I cried out to you.
verses.text: Yet I said in my alarm, I have been cut off from the sight of your eyes." * Nevertheless, you heard the sound of my entreaty when I cried out to you.

lines: Love the LORD, all you who worship him; *
the LORD protects the faithful,
but repays to the full those who act haughtily.
verses.text: Love the LORD, all you who worship him; * the LORD protects the faithful, but repays to the full those who act haughtily.

lines: Be strong and let your heart take courage, *
all you who wait for the LORD.
verses.text: Be strong and let your heart take courage, * all you who wait for the LORD.

lines: Happy are they whose transgressions are forgiven, *
and whose sin is put away!
verses.text: Happy are they whose transgressions are forgiven, * and whose sin is put away!

lines: Happy are they to whom the LORD imputes no guilt, *
and in whose spirit there is no guile!
verses.text: Happy are they to whom the LORD imputes no guilt, * and in whose spirit there is no guile!

lines: While I held my tongue, my bones withered away, *
because of my groaning all day long.
verses.text: While I held my tongue, my bones withered away, * because of my groaning all day long.

lines: For your hand was heavy upon me day and night; *
my moisture was dried up as in the heat of summer.
verses.text: For your hand was heavy upon me day and night; * my moisture was dried up as in the heat of summer.

lines: Then I acknowledged my sin to you, *
and did not conceal my guilt.
verses.text: Then I acknowledged my sin to you, * and did not conceal my guilt.

lines: I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the LORD." *
Then you forgave me the guilt of my sin.
verses.text: I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the LORD." * Then you forgave me the guilt of my sin.

lines: Therefore all the faithful will make their prayers to you in
time of trouble; *
when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach them.
verses.text: Therefore all the faithful will make their prayers to you in time of trouble; * when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach them.

lines: You are my hiding-place;
you preserve me from trouble; *
you surround me with shouts of deliverance.
verses.text: You are my hiding-place; you preserve me from trouble; * you surround me with shouts of deliverance.

lines: "I will instruct you and teach you in the way that you
should go; *
I will guide you with my eye.
verses.text: "I will instruct you and teach you in the way that you should go; * I will guide you with my eye.

lines: Do not be like horse or mule, which have no understanding; *
who must be fitted with bit and bridle,
or else they will not stay near you."
verses.text: Do not be like horse or mule, which have no understanding; * who must be fitted with bit and bridle, or else they will not stay near you."

lines: Great are the tribulations of the wicked; *
but mercy embraces those who trust in the LORD.
verses.text: Great are the tribulations of the wicked; * but mercy embraces those who trust in the LORD.

lines: Be glad, you righteous, and rejoice in the LORD; *
shout for joy, all who are true of heart.
verses.text: Be glad, you righteous, and rejoice in the LORD; * shout for joy, all who are true of heart.

lines: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous; *
it is good for the just to sing praises.
verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous; * it is good for the just to sing praises.

lines: Praise the LORD with the harp; *
play to him upon the psaltery and lyre.
verses.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; * play to him upon the psaltery and lyre.

lines: Sing for him a new song; *
sound a fanfare with all your skill upon the trumpet.
verses.text: Sing for him a new song; * sound a fanfare with all your skill upon the trumpet.

lines: For the word of the LORD is right, *
and all his works are sure.
verses.text: For the word of the LORD is right, * and all his works are sure.

lines: He loves righteousness and justice; *
the loving-kindness of the LORD fills the whole earth.
verses.text: He loves righteousness and justice; * the loving-kindness of the LORD fills the whole earth.

lines: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made, *
by the breath of his mouth all the heavenly hosts.
verses.text: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made, * by the breath of his mouth all the heavenly hosts.

lines: He gathers up the waters of the ocean as in a water-skin *
and stores up the depths of the sea.
verses.text: He gathers up the waters of the ocean as in a water-skin * and stores up the depths of the sea.

lines: Let all the earth fear the LORD; *
let all who dwell in the world stand in awe of him.
verses.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD; * let all who dwell in the world stand in awe of him.

lines: For he spoke, and it came to pass; *
he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.text: For he spoke, and it came to pass; * he commanded, and it stood fast.

lines: The LORD brings the will of the nations to naught; *
he thwarts the designs of the peoples.
verses.text: The LORD brings the will of the nations to naught; * he thwarts the designs of the peoples.

lines: But the LORD'S will stands fast for ever, *
and the designs of his heart from age to age.
verses.text: But the LORD'S will stands fast for ever, * and the designs of his heart from age to age.

lines: Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD! *
happy the people he has chosen to be his own!
verses.text: Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD! * happy the people he has chosen to be his own!

lines: The LORD looks down from heaven, *
and beholds all the people in the world.
verses.text: The LORD looks down from heaven, * and beholds all the people in the world.

lines: From where he sits enthroned he turns his gaze *
on all who dwell on the earth.
verses.text: From where he sits enthroned he turns his gaze * on all who dwell on the earth.

lines: He fashions all the hearts of them *
and understands all their works.
verses.text: He fashions all the hearts of them * and understands all their works.

lines: There is no king that can be saved by a mighty army; *
a strong man is not delivered by his great strength.
verses.text: There is no king that can be saved by a mighty army; * a strong man is not delivered by his great strength.

lines: The horse is a vain hope for deliverance; *
for all its strength it cannot save.
verses.text: The horse is a vain hope for deliverance; * for all its strength it cannot save.

lines: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon those who fear him, *
on those who wait upon his love,
verses.text: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon those who fear him, * on those who wait upon his love,

lines: To pluck their lives from death, *
and to feed them in time of famine.
verses.text: To pluck their lives from death, * and to feed them in time of famine.

lines: Our soul waits for the LORD; *
he is our help and our shield.
verses.text: Our soul waits for the LORD; * he is our help and our shield.

lines: Indeed, our heart rejoices in him, *
for in his holy Name we put our trust.
verses.text: Indeed, our heart rejoices in him, * for in his holy Name we put our trust.

lines: Let your loving-kindness, O LORD, be upon us, *
as we have put our trust in you.
verses.text: Let your loving-kindness, O LORD, be upon us, * as we have put our trust in you.

lines: I will bless the LORD at all times; *
his praise shall ever be in my mouth.
verses.text: I will bless the LORD at all times; * his praise shall ever be in my mouth.

lines: I will glory in the LORD; *
let the humble hear and rejoice.
verses.text: I will glory in the LORD; * let the humble hear and rejoice.

lines: Proclaim with me the greatness of the LORD; *
let us exalt his Name together.
verses.text: Proclaim with me the greatness of the LORD; * let us exalt his Name together.

lines: I sought the LORD, and he answered me *
and delivered me out of all my terror.
verses.text: I sought the LORD, and he answered me * and delivered me out of all my terror.

lines: Look upon him and be radiant, *
and let not your faces be ashamed.
verses.text: Look upon him and be radiant, * and let not your faces be ashamed.

lines: I called in my affliction and the LORD heard me *
and saved me from all my troubles.
verses.text: I called in my affliction and the LORD heard me * and saved me from all my troubles.

lines: The angel of the LORD encompasses those who fear him, *
and he will deliver them.
verses.text: The angel of the LORD encompasses those who fear him, * and he will deliver them.

lines: Taste and see that the LORD is good; *
happy are they who trust in him!
verses.text: Taste and see that the LORD is good; * happy are they who trust in him!

lines: Fear the LORD, you that are his saints, *
for those who fear him lack nothing.
verses.text: Fear the LORD, you that are his saints, * for those who fear him lack nothing.

lines: The young lions lack and suffer hunger, *
but those who seek the LORD lack nothing that is good.
verses.text: The young lions lack and suffer hunger, * but those who seek the LORD lack nothing that is good.

lines: Come, children, and listen to me; *
I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.text: Come, children, and listen to me; * I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

lines: Who among you loves life *
and desires long life to enjoy prosperity?
verses.text: Who among you loves life * and desires long life to enjoy prosperity?

lines: Keep your tongue from evil-speaking *
and your lips from lying words.
verses.text: Keep your tongue from evil-speaking * and your lips from lying words.

lines: Turn from evil and do good; *
seek peace and pursue it.
verses.text: Turn from evil and do good; * seek peace and pursue it.

lines: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, *
and his ears are open to their cry.
verses.text: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, * and his ears are open to their cry.

lines: The face of the LORD is against those who do evil, *
to root out the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.text: The face of the LORD is against those who do evil, * to root out the remembrance of them from the earth.

lines: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears them *
and delivers them from all their troubles.
verses.text: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears them * and delivers them from all their troubles.

lines: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted *
and will save those whose spirits are crushed.
verses.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted * and will save those whose spirits are crushed.

lines: Many are the troubles of the righteous, *
but the LORD will deliver him out of them all.
verses.text: Many are the troubles of the righteous, * but the LORD will deliver him out of them all.

lines: He will keep safe all his bones; *
not one of them shall be broken.
verses.text: He will keep safe all his bones; * not one of them shall be broken.

lines: Evil shall slay the wicked, *
and those who hate the righteous will be punished.
verses.text: Evil shall slay the wicked, * and those who hate the righteous will be punished.

lines: The LORD ransoms the life of his servants, *
and none will be punished who trust in him.
verses.text: The LORD ransoms the life of his servants, * and none will be punished who trust in him.

lines: Fight those who fight me, O LORD; *
attack those who are attacking me.
verses.text: Fight those who fight me, O LORD; * attack those who are attacking me.

lines: Take up shield and armor *
and rise up to help me.
verses.text: Take up shield and armor * and rise up to help me.

lines: Draw the sword and bar the way against those
who pursue me; *
say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
verses.text: Draw the sword and bar the way against those who pursue me; * say to my soul, "I am your salvation."

lines: Let those who seek after my life be shamed and humbled; *
let those who plot my ruin fall back and be dismayed.
verses.text: Let those who seek after my life be shamed and humbled; * let those who plot my ruin fall back and be dismayed.

lines: Let them be like chaff before the wind, *
and let the angel of the LORD drive them away.
verses.text: Let them be like chaff before the wind, * and let the angel of the LORD drive them away.

lines: Let their way be dark and slippery, *
and let the angel of the LORD pursue them.
verses.text: Let their way be dark and slippery, * and let the angel of the LORD pursue them.

lines: For they have secretly spread a net for me without a cause; *
without a cause they have dug a pit to take me alive.
verses.text: For they have secretly spread a net for me without a cause; * without a cause they have dug a pit to take me alive.

lines: Let ruin come upon them unawares; *
let them be caught in the net they hid;
let them fall into the pit they dug.
verses.text: Let ruin come upon them unawares; * let them be caught in the net they hid; let them fall into the pit they dug.

lines: Then I will be joyful in the LORD; *
I will glory in his victory.
verses.text: Then I will be joyful in the LORD; * I will glory in his victory.

lines: My very bones will say, "LORD, who is like you? *
You deliver the poor from those who are too strong for them,
the poor and needy from those who rob them."
verses.text: My very bones will say, "LORD, who is like you? * You deliver the poor from those who are too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."

lines: Malicious witnesses rise up against me; *
they charge me with matters I know nothing about.
verses.text: Malicious witnesses rise up against me; * they charge me with matters I know nothing about.

lines: They pay me evil in exchange for good; *
my soul is full of despair.
verses.text: They pay me evil in exchange for good; * my soul is full of despair.

lines: But when they were sick I dressed in sack-cloth *
and humbled myself by fasting.
verses.text: But when they were sick I dressed in sack-cloth * and humbled myself by fasting.

lines: I prayed with my whole heart,
as one would for a friend or a brother; *
I behaved like one who mourns for his mother,
bowed down and grieving.
verses.text: I prayed with my whole heart, as one would for a friend or a brother; * I behaved like one who mourns for his mother, bowed down and grieving.

lines: But when I stumbled, they were glad and gathered together;
they gathered against me; *
strangers whom I did not know tore me to pieces and
would not stop.
verses.text: But when I stumbled, they were glad and gathered together; they gathered against me; * strangers whom I did not know tore me to pieces and would not stop.

lines: They put me to the test and mocked me; *
they gnashed at me with their teeth.
verses.text: They put me to the test and mocked me; * they gnashed at me with their teeth.

lines: O Lord, how long will you look on? *
rescue me from the roaring beasts,
and my life from the young lions.
verses.text: O Lord, how long will you look on? * rescue me from the roaring beasts, and my life from the young lions.

lines: I will give you thanks in the great congregation; *
I will praise you in the mighty throng.
verses.text: I will give you thanks in the great congregation; * I will praise you in the mighty throng.

lines: Do not let my treacherous foes rejoice over me, *
nor let those who hate me without a cause
wink at each other.
verses.text: Do not let my treacherous foes rejoice over me, * nor let those who hate me without a cause wink at each other.

lines: For they do not plan for peace, *
but invent deceitful schemes against the
quiet in the land.
verses.text: For they do not plan for peace, * but invent deceitful schemes against the quiet in the land.

lines: They opened their mouths at me and said, *
"Aha! we saw it with our own eyes."
verses.text: They opened their mouths at me and said, * "Aha! we saw it with our own eyes."

lines: You saw it, O LORD; do not be silent; *
O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.text: You saw it, O LORD; do not be silent; * O Lord, be not far from me.

lines: Awake, arise, to my cause! *
to my defense, my God and my Lord!
verses.text: Awake, arise, to my cause! * to my defense, my God and my Lord!

lines: Give me justice, O LORD my God,
according to your righteousness; *
do not let them triumph over me.
verses.text: Give me justice, O LORD my God, according to your righteousness; * do not let them triumph over me.

lines: Do not let them say in their hearts,
"Aha! just what we want!" *
Do not let them say, "We have swallowed him up."
verses.text: Do not let them say in their hearts, "Aha! just what we want!" * Do not let them say, "We have swallowed him up."

lines: Let all who rejoice at my ruin be ashamed and disgraced; *
let those who boast against me be clothed with
dismay and shame.
verses.text: Let all who rejoice at my ruin be ashamed and disgraced; * let those who boast against me be clothed with dismay and shame.

lines: Let those who favor my cause sing out with joy and be glad; *
let them say always, "Great is the LORD,
who desires the prosperity of his servant."
verses.text: Let those who favor my cause sing out with joy and be glad; * let them say always, "Great is the LORD, who desires the prosperity of his servant."

lines: And my tongue shall be talking of your righteousness *
and of your praise all the day long.
verses.text: And my tongue shall be talking of your righteousness * and of your praise all the day long.

lines: There is a voice of rebellion deep in the heart of the wicked; *
there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.text: There is a voice of rebellion deep in the heart of the wicked; * there is no fear of God before his eyes.

lines: He flatters himself in his own eyes *
that his hateful sin will not be found out.
verses.text: He flatters himself in his own eyes * that his hateful sin will not be found out.

lines: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; *
he has left off acting wisely and doing good.
verses.text: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; * he has left off acting wisely and doing good.

lines: He thinks up wickedness upon his bed
and has set himself in no good way; *
he does not abhor that which is evil.
verses.text: He thinks up wickedness upon his bed and has set himself in no good way; * he does not abhor that which is evil.

lines: Your love, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, *
and your faithfulness to the clouds.
verses.text: Your love, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, * and your faithfulness to the clouds.

lines: Your righteousness is like the strong mountains,
your justice like the great deep; *
you save both man and beast, O LORD.
verses.text: Your righteousness is like the strong mountains, your justice like the great deep; * you save both man and beast, O LORD.

lines: How priceless is your love, O God! *
your people take refuge under the
shadow of your wings.
verses.text: How priceless is your love, O God! * your people take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

lines: They feast upon the abundance of your house; *
you give them drink from the river of your delights.
verses.text: They feast upon the abundance of your house; * you give them drink from the river of your delights.

lines: For with you is the well of life, *
and in your light we see light.
verses.text: For with you is the well of life, * and in your light we see light.

lines: Continue your loving-kindness to those who know you, *
and your favor to those who are true of heart.
verses.text: Continue your loving-kindness to those who know you, * and your favor to those who are true of heart.

lines: Let not the foot of the proud come near me, *
nor the hand of the wicked push me aside.
verses.text: Let not the foot of the proud come near me, * nor the hand of the wicked push me aside.

lines: See how they are fallen, those who work wickedness! *
they are cast down and shall not be able to rise.
verses.text: See how they are fallen, those who work wickedness! * they are cast down and shall not be able to rise.

lines: Do not fret yourself because of evildoers; *
do not be jealous of those who do wrong.
verses.text: Do not fret yourself because of evildoers; * do not be jealous of those who do wrong.

lines: For they shall soon wither like the grass, *
and like the green grass fade away.
verses.text: For they shall soon wither like the grass, * and like the green grass fade away.

lines: Put your trust in the LORD and do good; *
dwell in the land and feed on its riches.
verses.text: Put your trust in the LORD and do good; * dwell in the land and feed on its riches.

lines: Take delight in the LORD, *
and he shall give you your heart's desire.
verses.text: Take delight in the LORD, * and he shall give you your heart's desire.

lines: Commit your way to the LORD and put your trust in him, *
and he will bring it to pass.
verses.text: Commit your way to the LORD and put your trust in him, * and he will bring it to pass.

lines: He will make your righteousness as clear as the light *
and your just dealing as the noonday.
verses.text: He will make your righteousness as clear as the light * and your just dealing as the noonday.

lines: Be still before the LORD *
and wait patiently for him.
verses.text: Be still before the LORD * and wait patiently for him.

lines: Do not fret yourself over the one who prospers, *
the one who succeeds in evil schemes.
verses.text: Do not fret yourself over the one who prospers, * the one who succeeds in evil schemes.

lines: Refrain from anger, leave rage alone; *
do not fret yourself; it leads only to evil.
verses.text: Refrain from anger, leave rage alone; * do not fret yourself; it leads only to evil.

lines: For evildoers shall be cut off, *
but those who wait upon the LORD shall possess the land.
verses.text: For evildoers shall be cut off, * but those who wait upon the LORD shall possess the land.

lines: In a little while the wicked shall be no more; *
you shall search out their place, but they will not be there.
verses.text: In a little while the wicked shall be no more; * you shall search out their place, but they will not be there.

lines: But the lowly shall possess the land; *
they will delight in abundance of peace.
verses.text: But the lowly shall possess the land; * they will delight in abundance of peace.

lines: The wicked plot against the righteous *
and gnash at them with their teeth.
verses.text: The wicked plot against the righteous * and gnash at them with their teeth.

lines: The Lord laughs at the wicked, *
because he sees that their day will come.
verses.text: The Lord laughs at the wicked, * because he sees that their day will come.

lines: The wicked draw their sword and bend their bow
to strike down the poor and needy, *
to slaughter those who are upright in their ways.
verses.text: The wicked draw their sword and bend their bow to strike down the poor and needy, * to slaughter those who are upright in their ways.

lines: Their sword shall go through their own heart, *
and their bow shall be broken.
verses.text: Their sword shall go through their own heart, * and their bow shall be broken.

lines: The little that the righteous has *
is better than great riches of the wicked.
verses.text: The little that the righteous has * is better than great riches of the wicked.

lines: For the power of the wicked shall be broken, *
but the LORD upholds the righteous.
verses.text: For the power of the wicked shall be broken, * but the LORD upholds the righteous.

lines: The LORD cares for the lives of the godly, *
and their inheritance shall last for ever.
verses.text: The LORD cares for the lives of the godly, * and their inheritance shall last for ever.

lines: They shall not be ashamed in bad times, *
and in days of famine they shall have enough.
verses.text: They shall not be ashamed in bad times, * and in days of famine they shall have enough.

lines: As for the wicked, they shall perish, *
and the enemies of the LORD, like the glory of
the meadows, shall vanish;
they shall vanish like smoke.
verses.text: As for the wicked, they shall perish, * and the enemies of the LORD, like the glory of the meadows, shall vanish; they shall vanish like smoke.

lines: The wicked borrow and do not repay, *
but the righteous are generous in giving.
verses.text: The wicked borrow and do not repay, * but the righteous are generous in giving.

lines: Those who are blessed by God shall possess the land, *
but those who are cursed by him shall be destroyed.
verses.text: Those who are blessed by God shall possess the land, * but those who are cursed by him shall be destroyed.

lines: Our steps are directed by the LORD; *
he strengthens those in whose way he delights.
verses.text: Our steps are directed by the LORD; * he strengthens those in whose way he delights.

lines: If they stumble, they shall not fall headlong, *
for the LORD holds them by the hand.
verses.text: If they stumble, they shall not fall headlong, * for the LORD holds them by the hand.

lines: I have been young and now I am old, *
but never have I seen the righteous forsaken,
or their children begging bread.
verses.text: I have been young and now I am old, * but never have I seen the righteous forsaken, or their children begging bread.

lines: The righteous are always generous in their lending, *
and their children shall be a blessing.
verses.text: The righteous are always generous in their lending, * and their children shall be a blessing.

lines: Turn from evil, and do good, *
and dwell in the land for ever.
verses.text: Turn from evil, and do good, * and dwell in the land for ever.

lines: For the LORD loves justice; *
he does not forsake his faithful ones.
verses.text: For the LORD loves justice; * he does not forsake his faithful ones.

lines: They shall be kept safe for ever, *
but the offspring of the wicked shall be destroyed.
verses.text: They shall be kept safe for ever, * but the offspring of the wicked shall be destroyed.

lines: The righteous shall possess the land *
and dwell in it for ever.
verses.text: The righteous shall possess the land * and dwell in it for ever.

lines: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, *
and their tongue speaks what is right.
verses.text: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, * and their tongue speaks what is right.

lines: The law of their God is in their heart, *
and their footsteps shall not falter.
verses.text: The law of their God is in their heart, * and their footsteps shall not falter.

lines: The wicked spy on the righteous *
and seek occasion to kill them.
verses.text: The wicked spy on the righteous * and seek occasion to kill them.

lines: The LORD will not abandon them to their hand, *
nor let them be found guilty when brought to trial.
verses.text: The LORD will not abandon them to their hand, * nor let them be found guilty when brought to trial.

lines: Wait upon the LORD and keep his way; *
he will raise you up to possess the land,
and when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
verses.text: Wait upon the LORD and keep his way; * he will raise you up to possess the land, and when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

lines: I have seen the wicked in their arrogance, *
flourishing like a tree in full leaf.
verses.text: I have seen the wicked in their arrogance, * flourishing like a tree in full leaf.

lines: I went by, and behold, they were not there; *
I searched for them, but they could not be found.
verses.text: I went by, and behold, they were not there; * I searched for them, but they could not be found.

lines: Mark those who are honest;
observe the upright; *
for there is a future for the peaceable.
verses.text: Mark those who are honest; observe the upright; * for there is a future for the peaceable.

lines: Transgressors shall be destroyed, one and all; *
the future of the wicked is cut off.
verses.text: Transgressors shall be destroyed, one and all; * the future of the wicked is cut off.

lines: But the deliverance of the righteous comes from the LORD; *
he is their stronghold in time of trouble.
verses.text: But the deliverance of the righteous comes from the LORD; * he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

lines: The LORD will help them and rescue them; *
he will rescue them from the wicked and deliver them,
because they seek refuge in him.
verses.text: The LORD will help them and rescue them; * he will rescue them from the wicked and deliver them, because they seek refuge in him.

lines: O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger; *
do not punish me in your wrath.
verses.text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger; * do not punish me in your wrath.

lines: For your arrows have already pierced me, *
and your hand presses hard upon me.
verses.text: For your arrows have already pierced me, * and your hand presses hard upon me.

lines: There is no health in my flesh,
because of your indignation; *
there is no soundness in my body, because of my sin.
verses.text: There is no health in my flesh, because of your indignation; * there is no soundness in my body, because of my sin.

lines: For my iniquities overwhelm me; *
like a heavy burden they are too much for me to bear.
verses.text: For my iniquities overwhelm me; * like a heavy burden they are too much for me to bear.

lines: My wounds stink and fester *
by reason of my foolishness.
verses.text: My wounds stink and fester * by reason of my foolishness.

lines: I am utterly bowed down and prostrate; *
I go about in mourning all the day long.
verses.text: I am utterly bowed down and prostrate; * I go about in mourning all the day long.

lines: My loins are filled with searing pain; *
there is no health in my body.
verses.text: My loins are filled with searing pain; * there is no health in my body.

lines: I am utterly numb and crushed; *
I wail, because of the groaning of my heart.
verses.text: I am utterly numb and crushed; * I wail, because of the groaning of my heart.

lines: O Lord, you know all my desires, *
and my sighing is not hidden from you.
verses.text: O Lord, you know all my desires, * and my sighing is not hidden from you.

lines: My heart is pounding, my strength has failed me, *
and the brightness of my eyes is gone from me.
verses.text: My heart is pounding, my strength has failed me, * and the brightness of my eyes is gone from me.

lines: My friends and companions draw back from my affliction; *
my neighbors stand afar off.
verses.text: My friends and companions draw back from my affliction; * my neighbors stand afar off.

lines: Those who seek after my life lay snares for me; *
those who strive to hurt me speak of my ruin
and plot treachery all the day long.
verses.text: Those who seek after my life lay snares for me; * those who strive to hurt me speak of my ruin and plot treachery all the day long.

lines: But I am like the deaf who do not hear, *
like those who are mute and who do not open their mouth.
verses.text: But I am like the deaf who do not hear, * like those who are mute and who do not open their mouth.

lines: I have become like one who does not hear *
and from whose mouth comes no defense.
verses.text: I have become like one who does not hear * and from whose mouth comes no defense.

lines: For in you, O LORD, have I fixed my hope; *
you will answer me, O Lord my God.
verses.text: For in you, O LORD, have I fixed my hope; * you will answer me, O Lord my God.

lines: For I said, "Do not let them rejoice at my expense, *
those who gloat over me when my foot slips."
verses.text: For I said, "Do not let them rejoice at my expense, * those who gloat over me when my foot slips."

lines: Truly, I am on the verge of falling, *
and my pain is always with me.
verses.text: Truly, I am on the verge of falling, * and my pain is always with me.

lines: I will confess my iniquity *
and be sorry for my sin.
verses.text: I will confess my iniquity * and be sorry for my sin.

lines: Those who are my enemies without cause are mighty, *
and many in number are those who wrongfully hate me.
verses.text: Those who are my enemies without cause are mighty, * and many in number are those who wrongfully hate me.

lines: Those who repay evil for good slander me, *
because I follow the course that is right.
verses.text: Those who repay evil for good slander me, * because I follow the course that is right.

lines: O LORD, do not forsake me; *
be not far from me, O my God.
verses.text: O LORD, do not forsake me; * be not far from me, O my God.

lines: Make haste to help me, *
O Lord of my salvation.
verses.text: Make haste to help me, * O Lord of my salvation.

lines: I said, "I will keep watch upon my ways, *
so that I do not offend with my tongue.
verses.text: I said, "I will keep watch upon my ways, * so that I do not offend with my tongue.

lines: I will put a muzzle on my mouth *
while the wicked are in my presence."
verses.text: I will put a muzzle on my mouth * while the wicked are in my presence."

lines: So I held my tongue and said nothing; *
I refrained from rash words;
but my pain became unbearable.
verses.text: So I held my tongue and said nothing; * I refrained from rash words; but my pain became unbearable.

lines: My heart was hot within me;
while I pondered, the fire burst into flame; *
I spoke out with my tongue:
verses.text: My heart was hot within me; while I pondered, the fire burst into flame; * I spoke out with my tongue:

lines: LORD, let me know my end and the number of my days, *
so that I may know how short my life is.
verses.text: LORD, let me know my end and the number of my days, * so that I may know how short my life is.

lines: You have given me a mere handful of days,
and my lifetime is as nothing in your sight; *
truly, even those who stand erect are but a puff of wind.
verses.text: You have given me a mere handful of days, and my lifetime is as nothing in your sight; * truly, even those who stand erect are but a puff of wind.

lines: We walk about like a shadow,
and in vain we are in turmoil; *
we heap up riches and cannot tell who will gather them.
verses.text: We walk about like a shadow, and in vain we are in turmoil; * we heap up riches and cannot tell who will gather them.

lines: And now, what is my hope? *
O Lord, my hope is in you.
verses.text: And now, what is my hope? * O Lord, my hope is in you.

lines: Deliver me from all my transgressions *
and do not make me the taunt of the fool.
verses.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions * and do not make me the taunt of the fool.

lines: I fell silent and did not open my mouth, *
for surely it was you that did it.
verses.text: I fell silent and did not open my mouth, * for surely it was you that did it.

lines: Take your affliction from me; *
I am worn down by the blows of your hand.
verses.text: Take your affliction from me; * I am worn down by the blows of your hand.

lines: With rebukes for sin you punish us;
like a moth you eat away all that is dear to us; *
truly, everyone is but a puff of wind.
verses.text: With rebukes for sin you punish us; like a moth you eat away all that is dear to us; * truly, everyone is but a puff of wind.

lines: Hear my prayer, O LORD,
and give ear to my cry; *
hold not your peace at my tears.
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry; * hold not your peace at my tears.

lines: For I am but a sojourner with you, *
a wayfarer, as all my forebears were.
verses.text: For I am but a sojourner with you, * a wayfarer, as all my forebears were.

lines: Turn your gaze from me, that I may be glad again, *
before I go my way and am no more.
verses.text: Turn your gaze from me, that I may be glad again, * before I go my way and am no more.

lines: I waited patiently upon the LORD; *
he stooped to me and heard my cry.
verses.text: I waited patiently upon the LORD; * he stooped to me and heard my cry.

lines: He lifted me out of the desolate pit, out of the mire and clay; *
he set my feet upon a high cliff and made my footing sure.
verses.text: He lifted me out of the desolate pit, out of the mire and clay; * he set my feet upon a high cliff and made my footing sure.

lines: He put a new song in my mouth,
a song of praise to our God; *
many shall see, and stand in awe,
and put their trust in the LORD.
verses.text: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God; * many shall see, and stand in awe, and put their trust in the LORD.

lines: Happy are they who trust in the LORD! *
they do not resort to evil spirits or turn to false gods.
verses.text: Happy are they who trust in the LORD! * they do not resort to evil spirits or turn to false gods.

lines: Great things are they that you have done, O LORD my God!
how great your wonders and your plans for us! *
there is none who can be compared with you.
verses.text: Great things are they that you have done, O LORD my God! how great your wonders and your plans for us! * there is none who can be compared with you.

lines: Oh, that I could make them known and tell them! *
but they are more than I can count.
verses.text: Oh, that I could make them known and tell them! * but they are more than I can count.

lines: In sacrifice and offering you take no pleasure *
(you have given me ears to hear you);
verses.text: In sacrifice and offering you take no pleasure * (you have given me ears to hear you);

lines: Burnt-offering and sin-offering you have not required, *
and so I said, "Behold, I come.
verses.text: Burnt-offering and sin-offering you have not required, * and so I said, "Behold, I come.

lines: In the roll of the book it is written concerning me: *
'I love to do your will, O my God;
your law is deep in my heart.'"
verses.text: In the roll of the book it is written concerning me: * 'I love to do your will, O my God; your law is deep in my heart.'"

lines: I proclaimed righteousness in the great congregation; *
behold, I did not restrain my lips;
and that, O LORD, you know.
verses.text: I proclaimed righteousness in the great congregation; * behold, I did not restrain my lips; and that, O LORD, you know.

lines: Your righteousness have I not hidden in my heart;
I have spoken of your faithfulness and your deliverance; *
I have not concealed your love and faithfulness from the
great congregation.
verses.text: Your righteousness have I not hidden in my heart; I have spoken of your faithfulness and your deliverance; * I have not concealed your love and faithfulness from the great congregation.

lines: You are the LORD;
do not withhold your compassion from me; *
let your love and your faithfulness keep me safe for ever,
verses.text: You are the LORD; do not withhold your compassion from me; * let your love and your faithfulness keep me safe for ever,

lines: For innumerable troubles have crowded upon me;
my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see; *
they are more in number than the hairs of my head,
and my heart fails me.
verses.text: For innumerable troubles have crowded upon me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see; * they are more in number than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.

lines: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; *
O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; * O LORD, make haste to help me.

lines: Let them be ashamed and altogether dismayed
who seek after my life to destroy it; *
let them draw back and be disgraced
who take pleasure in my misfortune.
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and altogether dismayed who seek after my life to destroy it; * let them draw back and be disgraced who take pleasure in my misfortune.

lines: Let those who say "Aha!" and gloat over me be confounded, *
because they are ashamed.
verses.text: Let those who say "Aha!" and gloat over me be confounded, * because they are ashamed.

lines: Let all who seek you rejoice in you and be glad; *
let those who love your salvation continually say,
Great is the LORD!"
verses.text: Let all who seek you rejoice in you and be glad; * let those who love your salvation continually say, Great is the LORD!"

lines: Though I am poor and afflicted, *
the Lord will have regard for me.
verses.text: Though I am poor and afflicted, * the Lord will have regard for me.

lines: You are my helper and my deliverer; *
do not tarry, O my God.
verses.text: You are my helper and my deliverer; * do not tarry, O my God.

lines: Happy are they who consider the poor and needy! *
the LORD will deliver them in the time of trouble.
verses.text: Happy are they who consider the poor and needy! * the LORD will deliver them in the time of trouble.

lines: The LORD preserves them and keeps them alive,
so that they may be happy in the land; *
he does not hand them over to the will of their enemies.
verses.text: The LORD preserves them and keeps them alive, so that they may be happy in the land; * he does not hand them over to the will of their enemies.

lines: The LORD sustains them on their sickbed *
and ministers to them in their illness.
verses.text: The LORD sustains them on their sickbed * and ministers to them in their illness.

lines: I said, "LORD, be merciful to me; *
heal me, for I have sinned against you."
verses.text: I said, "LORD, be merciful to me; * heal me, for I have sinned against you."

lines: My enemies are saying wicked things about me: *
When will he die, and his name perish?"
verses.text: My enemies are saying wicked things about me: * When will he die, and his name perish?"

lines: Even if they come to see me, they speak empty words; *
their heart collects false rumors;
they go outside and spread them.
verses.text: Even if they come to see me, they speak empty words; * their heart collects false rumors; they go outside and spread them.

lines: All my enemies whisper together about me *
and devise evil against me.
verses.text: All my enemies whisper together about me * and devise evil against me.

lines: "A deadly thing," they say, "has fastened on him; *
he has taken to his bed and will never get up again."
verses.text: "A deadly thing," they say, "has fastened on him; * he has taken to his bed and will never get up again."

lines: Even my best friend, whom I trusted,
who broke bread with me, *
has lifted up his heel and turned against me.
verses.text: Even my best friend, whom I trusted, who broke bread with me, * has lifted up his heel and turned against me.

lines: But you, O LORD, be merciful to me and raise me up, *
and I shall repay them.
verses.text: But you, O LORD, be merciful to me and raise me up, * and I shall repay them.

lines: By this I know you are pleased with me, *
that my enemy does not triumph over me.
verses.text: By this I know you are pleased with me, * that my enemy does not triumph over me.

lines: In my integrity you hold me fast, *
and shall set me before your face for ever.
verses.text: In my integrity you hold me fast, * and shall set me before your face for ever.

lines: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, *
from age to age. Amen. Amen.
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, * from age to age. Amen. Amen.

lines: As the deer longs for the water-brooks, *
so longs my soul for you, O God.
verses.text: As the deer longs for the water-brooks, * so longs my soul for you, O God.

lines: My soul is athirst for God, athirst for the living God; *
when shall I come to appear before the presence of God?
verses.text: My soul is athirst for God, athirst for the living God; * when shall I come to appear before the presence of God?

lines: My tears have been my food day and night, *
while all day long they say to me,
"Where now is your God?"
verses.text: My tears have been my food day and night, * while all day long they say to me, "Where now is your God?"

lines: I pour out my soul when I think on these things; *
how I went with the multitude and led them into the
house of God,
verses.text: I pour out my soul when I think on these things; * how I went with the multitude and led them into the house of God,

lines: With the voice of praise and thanksgiving, *
among those who keep holy-day.
verses.text: With the voice of praise and thanksgiving, * among those who keep holy-day.

lines: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul? *
and why are you so disquieted within me?
verses.text: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul? * and why are you so disquieted within me?

lines: Put your trust in God; *
for I will yet give thanks to him,
who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.text: Put your trust in God; * for I will yet give thanks to him, who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

lines: My soul is heavy within me; *
therefore I will remember you from the land of Jordan,
and from the peak of Mizar among the heights of Hermon.
verses.text: My soul is heavy within me; * therefore I will remember you from the land of Jordan, and from the peak of Mizar among the heights of Hermon.

lines: One deep calls to another in the noise of your cataracts; *
all your rapids and floods have gone over me.
verses.text: One deep calls to another in the noise of your cataracts; * all your rapids and floods have gone over me.

lines: The LORD grants his loving-kindness in the daytime; *
in the night season his song is with me,
a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.text: The LORD grants his loving-kindness in the daytime; * in the night season his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.

lines: I will say to the God of my strength,
"Why have you forgotten me? *
and why do I go so heavily while the enemy
oppresses me?"
verses.text: I will say to the God of my strength, "Why have you forgotten me? * and why do I go so heavily while the enemy oppresses me?"

lines: While my bones are being broken, *
my enemies mock me to my face;
verses.text: While my bones are being broken, * my enemies mock me to my face;

lines: All day long they mock me *
and say to me, "Where now is your God?"
verses.text: All day long they mock me * and say to me, "Where now is your God?"

lines: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul? *
and why are you so disquieted within me?
verses.text: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul? * and why are you so disquieted within me?

lines: Put your trust in God; *
for I will yet give thanks to him,
who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.text: Put your trust in God; * for I will yet give thanks to him, who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

lines: Give judgment for me, O God,
and defend my cause against an ungodly people; *
deliver me from the deceitful and the wicked.
verses.text: Give judgment for me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly people; * deliver me from the deceitful and the wicked.

lines: For you are the God of my strength;
why have you put me from you? *
and why do I go so heavily while the enemy
oppresses me?
verses.text: For you are the God of my strength; why have you put me from you? * and why do I go so heavily while the enemy oppresses me?

lines: Send out your light and your truth, that they may lead me, *
and bring me to your holy hill
and to your dwelling;
verses.text: Send out your light and your truth, that they may lead me, * and bring me to your holy hill and to your dwelling;

lines: That I may go to the altar of God,
to the God of my joy and gladness; *
and on the harp I will give thanks to you, O God my God.
verses.text: That I may go to the altar of God, to the God of my joy and gladness; * and on the harp I will give thanks to you, O God my God.

lines: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul? *
and why are you so disquieted within me?
verses.text: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul? * and why are you so disquieted within me?

lines: Put your trust in God; *
for I will yet give thanks to him,
who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.text: Put your trust in God; * for I will yet give thanks to him, who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

lines: We have heard with our ears, O God,
our forefathers have told us, *
the deeds you did in their days,
in the days of old.
verses.text: We have heard with our ears, O God, our forefathers have told us, * the deeds you did in their days, in the days of old.

lines: How with your hand you drove the peoples out
and planted our forefathers in the land; *
how you destroyed nations and made your people flourish.
verses.text: How with your hand you drove the peoples out and planted our forefathers in the land; * how you destroyed nations and made your people flourish.

lines: For they did not take the land by their sword,
nor did their arm win the victory for them; *
but your right hand, your arm, and the
light of your countenance,
because you favored them.
verses.text: For they did not take the land by their sword, nor did their arm win the victory for them; * but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your countenance, because you favored them.

lines: You are my King and my God; *
you command victories for Jacob.
verses.text: You are my King and my God; * you command victories for Jacob.

lines: Through you we pushed back our adversaries; *
through your Name we trampled on those who
rose up against us.
verses.text: Through you we pushed back our adversaries; * through your Name we trampled on those who rose up against us.

lines: For I do not rely on my bow, *
and my sword does not give me the victory.
verses.text: For I do not rely on my bow, * and my sword does not give me the victory.

lines: Surely, you gave us victory over our adversaries *
and put those who hate us to shame.
verses.text: Surely, you gave us victory over our adversaries * and put those who hate us to shame.

lines: Every day we gloried in God, *
and we will praise your Name for ever.
verses.text: Every day we gloried in God, * and we will praise your Name for ever.

lines: Nevertheless, you have rejected and humbled us *
and do not go forth with our armies.
verses.text: Nevertheless, you have rejected and humbled us * and do not go forth with our armies.

lines: You have made us fall back before our adversary, *
and our enemies have plundered us.
verses.text: You have made us fall back before our adversary, * and our enemies have plundered us.

lines: You have made us like sheep to be eaten *
and have scattered us among the nations.
verses.text: You have made us like sheep to be eaten * and have scattered us among the nations.

lines: You are selling your people for a trifle *
and are making no profit on the sale of them.
verses.text: You are selling your people for a trifle * and are making no profit on the sale of them.

lines: You have made us the scorn of our neighbors, *
a mockery and derision to those around us.
verses.text: You have made us the scorn of our neighbors, * a mockery and derision to those around us.

lines: You have made us a byword among the nations, *
a laughing-stock among the peoples.
verses.text: You have made us a byword among the nations, * a laughing-stock among the peoples.

lines: My humiliation is daily before me, *
and shame has covered my face;
verses.text: My humiliation is daily before me, * and shame has covered my face;

lines: Because of the taunts of the mockers and blasphemers, *
because of the enemy and avenger.
verses.text: Because of the taunts of the mockers and blasphemers, * because of the enemy and avenger.

lines: All this has come upon us; *
yet we have not forgotten you,
nor have we betrayed your covenant.
verses.text: All this has come upon us; * yet we have not forgotten you, nor have we betrayed your covenant.

lines: Our heart never turned back, *
nor did our footsteps stray from your path;
verses.text: Our heart never turned back, * nor did our footsteps stray from your path;

lines: Though you thrust us down into a place of misery, *
and covered us over with deep darkness.
verses.text: Though you thrust us down into a place of misery, * and covered us over with deep darkness.

lines: If we have forgotten the Name of our God, *
or stretched out our hands to some strange god,
verses.text: If we have forgotten the Name of our God, * or stretched out our hands to some strange god,

lines: Will not God find it out? *
for he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.text: Will not God find it out? * for he knows the secrets of the heart.

lines: Indeed, for your sake we are killed all the day long; *
we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.text: Indeed, for your sake we are killed all the day long; * we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

lines: Awake, O Lord! why are you sleeping? *
Arise! do not reject us for ever.
verses.text: Awake, O Lord! why are you sleeping? * Arise! do not reject us for ever.

lines: Why have you hidden your face *
and forgotten our affliction and oppression?
verses.text: Why have you hidden your face * and forgotten our affliction and oppression?

lines: We sink down into the dust; *
our body cleaves to the ground.
verses.text: We sink down into the dust; * our body cleaves to the ground.

lines: Rise up, and help us, *
and save us, for the sake of your steadfast love.
verses.text: Rise up, and help us, * and save us, for the sake of your steadfast love.

lines: My heart is stirring with a noble song;
let me recite what I have fashioned for the king; *
my tongue shall be the pen of a skilled writer.
verses.text: My heart is stirring with a noble song; let me recite what I have fashioned for the king; * my tongue shall be the pen of a skilled writer.

lines: You are the fairest of men; *
grace flows from your lips,
because God has blessed you for ever.
verses.text: You are the fairest of men; * grace flows from your lips, because God has blessed you for ever.

lines: Strap your sword upon your thigh, O mighty warrior, *
in your pride and in your majesty.
verses.text: Strap your sword upon your thigh, O mighty warrior, * in your pride and in your majesty.

lines: Ride out and conquer in the cause of truth *
and for the sake of justice.
verses.text: Ride out and conquer in the cause of truth * and for the sake of justice.

lines: Your right hand will show you marvelous things; *
your arrows are very sharp, O mighty warrior.
verses.text: Your right hand will show you marvelous things; * your arrows are very sharp, O mighty warrior.

lines: The peoples are falling at your feet, *
and the king's enemies are losing heart.
verses.text: The peoples are falling at your feet, * and the king's enemies are losing heart.

lines: Your throne, O God, endures for ever and ever, *
a scepter of righteousness is the scepter of your kingdom;
you love righteousness and hate iniquity.
verses.text: Your throne, O God, endures for ever and ever, * a scepter of righteousness is the scepter of your kingdom; you love righteousness and hate iniquity.

lines: Therefore God, your God, has anointed you *
with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
verses.text: Therefore God, your God, has anointed you * with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

lines: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh, aloes, and cassia, *
and the music of strings from ivory palaces makes you glad.
verses.text: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh, aloes, and cassia, * and the music of strings from ivory palaces makes you glad.

lines: Kings' daughters stand among the ladies of the court; *
on your right hand is the queen,
adorned with the gold of Ophir.
verses.text: Kings' daughters stand among the ladies of the court; * on your right hand is the queen, adorned with the gold of Ophir.

lines: "Hear, O daughter; consider and listen closely; *
forget your people and your father's house.
verses.text: "Hear, O daughter; consider and listen closely; * forget your people and your father's house.

lines: The king will have pleasure in your beauty; *
he is your master; therefore do him honor.
verses.text: The king will have pleasure in your beauty; * he is your master; therefore do him honor.

lines: The people of Tyre are here with a gift; *
the rich among the people seek your favor."
verses.text: The people of Tyre are here with a gift; * the rich among the people seek your favor."

lines: All glorious is the princess as she enters; *
her gown is cloth-of-gold.
verses.text: All glorious is the princess as she enters; * her gown is cloth-of-gold.

lines: In embroidered apparel she is brought to the king; *
after her the bridesmaids follow in procession.
verses.text: In embroidered apparel she is brought to the king; * after her the bridesmaids follow in procession.

lines: With joy and gladness they are brought, *
and enter into the palace of the king.
verses.text: With joy and gladness they are brought, * and enter into the palace of the king.

lines: "In place of fathers, O king, you shall have sons; *
you shall make them princes over all the earth.
verses.text: "In place of fathers, O king, you shall have sons; * you shall make them princes over all the earth.

lines: I will make your name to be remembered
from one generation to another; *
therefore nations will praise you for ever and ever."
verses.text: I will make your name to be remembered from one generation to another; * therefore nations will praise you for ever and ever."

lines: God is our refuge and strength, *
a very present help in trouble.
verses.text: God is our refuge and strength, * a very present help in trouble.

lines: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth be moved, *
and though the mountains be toppled into the
depths of the sea;
verses.text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth be moved, * and though the mountains be toppled into the depths of the sea;

lines: Though its waters rage and foam, *
and though the mountains tremble at its tumult.
verses.text: Though its waters rage and foam, * and though the mountains tremble at its tumult.

lines: The LORD of hosts is with us; *
the God of Jacob is our stronghold.
verses.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; * the God of Jacob is our stronghold.

lines: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, *
the holy habitation of the Most High.
verses.text: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, * the holy habitation of the Most High.

lines: God is in the midst of her;
she shall not be overthrown; *
God shall help her at the break of day.
verses.text: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be overthrown; * God shall help her at the break of day.

lines: The nations make much ado, and the kingdoms are shaken; *
God has spoken, and the earth shall melt away.
verses.text: The nations make much ado, and the kingdoms are shaken; * God has spoken, and the earth shall melt away.

lines: The LORD of hosts is with us; *
the God of Jacob is our stronghold.
verses.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; * the God of Jacob is our stronghold.

lines: Come now and look upon the works of the LORD, *
what awesome things he has done on earth.
verses.text: Come now and look upon the works of the LORD, * what awesome things he has done on earth.

lines: It is he who makes war to cease in all the world; *
he breaks the bow, and shatters the spear,
and burns the shields with fire.
verses.text: It is he who makes war to cease in all the world; * he breaks the bow, and shatters the spear, and burns the shields with fire.

lines: "Be still, then, and know that I am God; *
I will be exalted among the nations;
I will be exalted in the earth."
verses.text: "Be still, then, and know that I am God; * I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted in the earth."

lines: The LORD of hosts is with us; *
the God of Jacob is our stronghold.
verses.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; * the God of Jacob is our stronghold.

lines: Clap your hands, all you peoples; *
shout to God with a cry of joy.
verses.text: Clap your hands, all you peoples; * shout to God with a cry of joy.

lines: For the LORD Most High is to be feared; *
he is the great King over all the earth.
verses.text: For the LORD Most High is to be feared; * he is the great King over all the earth.

lines: He subdues the peoples under us, *
and the nations under our feet.
verses.text: He subdues the peoples under us, * and the nations under our feet.

lines: He chooses our inheritance for us, *
the pride of Jacob whom he loves.
verses.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, * the pride of Jacob whom he loves.

lines: God has gone up with a shout, *
the LORD with the sound of the ram's-horn.
verses.text: God has gone up with a shout, * the LORD with the sound of the ram's-horn.

lines: Sing praises to God, sing praises; *
sing praises to our King, sing praises.
verses.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises; * sing praises to our King, sing praises.

lines: For God is King of all the earth; *
sing praises with all your skill.
verses.text: For God is King of all the earth; * sing praises with all your skill.

lines: God reigns over the nations; *
God sits upon his holy throne.
verses.text: God reigns over the nations; * God sits upon his holy throne.

lines: The nobles of the peoples have gathered together *
with the people of the God of Abraham.
verses.text: The nobles of the peoples have gathered together * with the people of the God of Abraham.

lines: The rulers of the earth belong to God, *
and he is highly exalted.
verses.text: The rulers of the earth belong to God, * and he is highly exalted.

lines: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; *
in the city of our God is his holy hill.
verses.text: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; * in the city of our God is his holy hill.

lines: Beautiful and lofty, the joy of all the earth, is the
hill of Zion, *
the very center of the world and the city of the great King.
verses.text: Beautiful and lofty, the joy of all the earth, is the hill of Zion, * the very center of the world and the city of the great King.

lines: God is in her citadels; *
he is known to be her sure refuge.
verses.text: God is in her citadels; * he is known to be her sure refuge.

lines: Behold, the kings of the earth assembled *
and marched forward together.
verses.text: Behold, the kings of the earth assembled * and marched forward together.

lines: They looked and were astounded; *
they retreated and fled in terror.
verses.text: They looked and were astounded; * they retreated and fled in terror.

lines: Trembling seized them there; *
they writhed like a woman in childbirth,
like ships of the sea when the east wind shatters them.
verses.text: Trembling seized them there; * they writhed like a woman in childbirth, like ships of the sea when the east wind shatters them.

lines: As we have heard, so have we seen,
in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God; *
God has established her for ever.
verses.text: As we have heard, so have we seen, in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God; * God has established her for ever.

lines: We have waited in silence on your loving-kindness, O God, *
in the midst of your temple.
verses.text: We have waited in silence on your loving-kindness, O God, * in the midst of your temple.

lines: Your praise, like your Name, O God, reaches to
the world's end; *
your right hand is full of justice.
verses.text: Your praise, like your Name, O God, reaches to the world's end; * your right hand is full of justice.

lines: Let Mount Zion be glad
and the cities of Judah rejoice, *
because of your judgments.
verses.text: Let Mount Zion be glad and the cities of Judah rejoice, * because of your judgments.

lines: Make the circuit of Zion;
walk round about her; *
count the number of her towers.
verses.text: Make the circuit of Zion; walk round about her; * count the number of her towers.

lines: Consider well her bulwarks;
examine her strongholds; *
that you may tell those who come after.
verses.text: Consider well her bulwarks; examine her strongholds; * that you may tell those who come after.

lines: This God is our God for ever and ever; *
he shall be our guide for evermore.
verses.text: This God is our God for ever and ever; * he shall be our guide for evermore.

lines: Hear this, all you peoples;
hearken, all you who dwell in the world, *
you of high degree and low, rich and poor together.
verses.text: Hear this, all you peoples; hearken, all you who dwell in the world, * you of high degree and low, rich and poor together.

lines: My mouth shall speak of wisdom, *
and my heart shall meditate on understanding.
verses.text: My mouth shall speak of wisdom, * and my heart shall meditate on understanding.

lines: I will incline my ear to a proverb *
and set forth my riddle upon the harp.
verses.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb * and set forth my riddle upon the harp.

lines: Why should I be afraid in evil days, *
when the wickedness of those at my heels surrounds me,
verses.text: Why should I be afraid in evil days, * when the wickedness of those at my heels surrounds me,

lines: The wickedness of those who put their trust in their goods, *
and boast of their great riches?
verses.text: The wickedness of those who put their trust in their goods, * and boast of their great riches?

lines: We can never ransom ourselves, *
or deliver to God the price of our life;
verses.text: We can never ransom ourselves, * or deliver to God the price of our life;

lines: For the ransom of our life is so great, *
that we should never have enough to pay it,
verses.text: For the ransom of our life is so great, * that we should never have enough to pay it,

lines: In order to live for ever and ever, *
and never see the grave.
verses.text: In order to live for ever and ever, * and never see the grave.

lines: For we see that the wise die also;
like the dull and stupid they perish *
and leave their wealth to those who come after them.
verses.text: For we see that the wise die also; like the dull and stupid they perish * and leave their wealth to those who come after them.

lines: Their graves shall be their homes for ever,
their dwelling places from generation to generation, *
though they call the lands after their own names.
verses.text: Their graves shall be their homes for ever, their dwelling places from generation to generation, * though they call the lands after their own names.

lines: Even though honored, they cannot live for ever; *
they are like the beasts that perish.
verses.text: Even though honored, they cannot live for ever; * they are like the beasts that perish.

lines: Such is the way of those who foolishly trust in themselves, *
and the end of those who delight in their own words.
verses.text: Such is the way of those who foolishly trust in themselves, * and the end of those who delight in their own words.

lines: Like a flock of sheep they are destined to die;
Death is their shepherd; *
they go down straightway to the grave.
verses.text: Like a flock of sheep they are destined to die; Death is their shepherd; * they go down straightway to the grave.

lines: Their form shall waste away, *
and the land of the dead shall be their home.
verses.text: Their form shall waste away, * and the land of the dead shall be their home.

lines: But God will ransom my life; *
he will snatch me from the grasp of death.
verses.text: But God will ransom my life; * he will snatch me from the grasp of death.

lines: Do not be envious when some become rich, *
or when the grandeur of their house increases;
verses.text: Do not be envious when some become rich, * or when the grandeur of their house increases;

lines: For they will carry nothing away at their death, *
nor will their grandeur follow them.
verses.text: For they will carry nothing away at their death, * nor will their grandeur follow them.

lines: Though they thought highly of themselves while they lived, *
and were praised for their success,
verses.text: Though they thought highly of themselves while they lived, * and were praised for their success,

lines: They shall join the company of their forebears, *
who will never see the light again.
verses.text: They shall join the company of their forebears, * who will never see the light again.

lines: Those who are honored, but have no understanding, *
are like the beasts that perish.
verses.text: Those who are honored, but have no understanding, * are like the beasts that perish.

lines: The LORD, the God of gods, has spoken; *
he has called the earth from the rising of the sun to
its setting.
verses.text: The LORD, the God of gods, has spoken; * he has called the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.

lines: Out of Zion, perfect in its beauty, *
God reveals himself in glory.
verses.text: Out of Zion, perfect in its beauty, * God reveals himself in glory.

lines: Our God will come and will not keep silence; *
before him there is a consuming flame,
and round about him a raging storm.
verses.text: Our God will come and will not keep silence; * before him there is a consuming flame, and round about him a raging storm.

lines: He calls the heavens and the earth from above *
to witness the judgment of his people.
verses.text: He calls the heavens and the earth from above * to witness the judgment of his people.

lines: "Gather before me my loyal followers, *
those who have made a covenant with me
and sealed it with sacrifice."
verses.text: "Gather before me my loyal followers, * those who have made a covenant with me and sealed it with sacrifice."

lines: Let the heavens declare the rightness of his cause; *
for God himself is judge.
verses.text: Let the heavens declare the rightness of his cause; * for God himself is judge.

lines: Hear, O my people, and I will speak:
"O Israel, I will bear witness against you; *
for I am God, your God.
verses.text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak: "O Israel, I will bear witness against you; * for I am God, your God.

lines: I do not accuse you because of your sacrifices; *
your offerings are always before me.
verses.text: I do not accuse you because of your sacrifices; * your offerings are always before me.

lines: I will take no bull-calf from your stalls, *
nor he-goats out of your pens;
verses.text: I will take no bull-calf from your stalls, * nor he-goats out of your pens;

lines: For all the beasts of the forest are mine, *
the herds in their thousands upon the hills.
verses.text: For all the beasts of the forest are mine, * the herds in their thousands upon the hills.

lines: I know every bird in the sky, *
and the creatures of the fields are in my sight.
verses.text: I know every bird in the sky, * and the creatures of the fields are in my sight.

lines: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, *
for the whole world is mine and all that is in it.
verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, * for the whole world is mine and all that is in it.

lines: Do you think I eat the flesh of bulls, *
or drink the blood of goats?
verses.text: Do you think I eat the flesh of bulls, * or drink the blood of goats?

lines: Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving *
and make good your vows to the Most High.
verses.text: Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving * and make good your vows to the Most High.

lines: Call upon me in the day of trouble; *
I will deliver you, and you shall honor me."
verses.text: Call upon me in the day of trouble; * I will deliver you, and you shall honor me."

lines: But to the wicked God says: *
Why do you recite my statutes,
and take my covenant upon your lips;
verses.text: But to the wicked God says: * Why do you recite my statutes, and take my covenant upon your lips;

lines: Since you refuse discipline, *
and toss my words behind your back?
verses.text: Since you refuse discipline, * and toss my words behind your back?

lines: When you see a thief, you make him your friend, *
and you cast in your lot with adulterers.
verses.text: When you see a thief, you make him your friend, * and you cast in your lot with adulterers.
