lines: You have loosed your lips for evil, *
and harnessed your tongue to a lie.
verses.text: You have loosed your lips for evil, * and harnessed your tongue to a lie.

lines: You are always speaking evil of your brother *
and slandering your own mother's son.
verses.text: You are always speaking evil of your brother * and slandering your own mother's son.

lines: These things you have done, and I kept still, *
and you thought that I am like you."
verses.text: These things you have done, and I kept still, * and you thought that I am like you."

lines: "I have made my accusation; *
I have put my case in order before your eyes.
verses.text: "I have made my accusation; * I have put my case in order before your eyes.

lines: Consider this well, you who forget God, *
lest I rend you and there be none to deliver you.
verses.text: Consider this well, you who forget God, * lest I rend you and there be none to deliver you.

lines: Whoever offers me the sacrifice of thanksgiving
honors me; *
but to those who keep in my way will I show
the salvation of God."
verses.text: Whoever offers me the sacrifice of thanksgiving honors me; * but to those who keep in my way will I show the salvation of God."

lines: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your
loving-kindness; *
in your great compassion blot out my offenses.
verses.text: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your loving-kindness; * in your great compassion blot out my offenses.

lines: Wash me through and through from my wickedness *
and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.text: Wash me through and through from my wickedness * and cleanse me from my sin.

lines: For I know my transgressions, *
and my sin is ever before me.
verses.text: For I know my transgressions, * and my sin is ever before me.

lines: Against you only have I sinned *
and done what is evil in your sight.
verses.text: Against you only have I sinned * and done what is evil in your sight.

lines: And so you are justified when you speak *
and upright in your judgment.
verses.text: And so you are justified when you speak * and upright in your judgment.

lines: Indeed, I have been wicked from my birth, *
a sinner from my mother's womb.
verses.text: Indeed, I have been wicked from my birth, * a sinner from my mother's womb.

lines: For behold, you look for truth deep within me, *
and will make me understand wisdom secretly.
verses.text: For behold, you look for truth deep within me, * and will make me understand wisdom secretly.

lines: Purge me from my sin, and I shall be pure; *
wash me, and I shall be clean indeed.
verses.text: Purge me from my sin, and I shall be pure; * wash me, and I shall be clean indeed.

lines: Make me hear of joy and gladness, *
that the body you have broken may rejoice.
verses.text: Make me hear of joy and gladness, * that the body you have broken may rejoice.

lines: Hide your face from my sins *
and blot out all my iniquities.
verses.text: Hide your face from my sins * and blot out all my iniquities.

lines: Create in me a clean heart, O God, *
and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, * and renew a right spirit within me.

lines: Cast me not away from your presence *
and take not your holy Spirit from me.
verses.text: Cast me not away from your presence * and take not your holy Spirit from me.

lines: Give me the joy of your saving help again *
and sustain me with your bountiful Spirit.
verses.text: Give me the joy of your saving help again * and sustain me with your bountiful Spirit.

lines: I shall teach your ways to the wicked, *
and sinners shall return to you.
verses.text: I shall teach your ways to the wicked, * and sinners shall return to you.

lines: Deliver me from death, O God, *
and my tongue shall sing of your righteousness,
O God of my salvation.
verses.text: Deliver me from death, O God, * and my tongue shall sing of your righteousness, O God of my salvation.

lines: Open my lips, O Lord, *
and my mouth shall proclaim your praise.
verses.text: Open my lips, O Lord, * and my mouth shall proclaim your praise.

lines: Had you desired it, I would have offered sacrifice, *
but you take no delight in burnt-offerings.
verses.text: Had you desired it, I would have offered sacrifice, * but you take no delight in burnt-offerings.

lines: The sacrifice of God is a troubled spirit; *
a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
verses.text: The sacrifice of God is a troubled spirit; * a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

lines: Be favorable and gracious to Zion, *
and rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Be favorable and gracious to Zion, * and rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

lines: Then you will be pleased with the appointed sacrifices,
with burnt-offerings and oblations; *
then shall they offer young bullocks upon your altar.
verses.text: Then you will be pleased with the appointed sacrifices, with burnt-offerings and oblations; * then shall they offer young bullocks upon your altar.

lines: You tyrant, why do you boast of wickedness *
against the godly all day long?
verses.text: You tyrant, why do you boast of wickedness * against the godly all day long?

lines: You plot ruin;
your tongue is like a sharpened razor, *
O worker of deception.
verses.text: You plot ruin; your tongue is like a sharpened razor, * O worker of deception.

lines: You love evil more than good *
and lying more than speaking the truth.
verses.text: You love evil more than good * and lying more than speaking the truth.

lines: You love all words that hurt, *
O you deceitful tongue.
verses.text: You love all words that hurt, * O you deceitful tongue.

lines: Oh, that God would demolish you utterly, *
topple you, and snatch you from your dwelling,
and root you out of the land of the living!
verses.text: Oh, that God would demolish you utterly, * topple you, and snatch you from your dwelling, and root you out of the land of the living!

lines: The righteous shall see and tremble, *
and they shall laugh at him, saying,
verses.text: The righteous shall see and tremble, * and they shall laugh at him, saying,

lines: "This is the one who did not take God for a refuge, *
but trusted in great wealth
and relied upon wickedness."
verses.text: "This is the one who did not take God for a refuge, * but trusted in great wealth and relied upon wickedness."

lines: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; *
I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.text: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; * I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

lines: I will give you thanks for what you have done *
and declare the goodness of your Name in the presence
of the godly.
verses.text: I will give you thanks for what you have done * and declare the goodness of your Name in the presence of the godly.

lines: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." *
All are corrupt and commit abominable acts;
there is none who does any good.
verses.text: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." * All are corrupt and commit abominable acts; there is none who does any good.

lines: God looks down from heaven upon us all, *
to see if there is any who is wise,
if there is one who seeks after God.
verses.text: God looks down from heaven upon us all, * to see if there is any who is wise, if there is one who seeks after God.

lines: Every one has proved faithless;
all alike have turned bad; *
there is none who does good; no, not one.
verses.text: Every one has proved faithless; all alike have turned bad; * there is none who does good; no, not one.

lines: Have they no knowledge, those evildoers *
who eat up my people like bread
and do not call upon God?
verses.text: Have they no knowledge, those evildoers * who eat up my people like bread and do not call upon God?

lines: See how greatly they tremble,
such trembling as never was; *
for God has scattered the bones of the enemy;
they are put to shame, because God has rejected them.
verses.text: See how greatly they tremble, such trembling as never was; * for God has scattered the bones of the enemy; they are put to shame, because God has rejected them.

lines: Oh, that Israel's deliverance would come out of Zion! *
when God restores the fortunes of his people
Jacob will rejoice and Israel be glad.
verses.text: Oh, that Israel's deliverance would come out of Zion! * when God restores the fortunes of his people Jacob will rejoice and Israel be glad.

lines: Save me, O God, by your Name; *
in your might, defend my cause.
verses.text: Save me, O God, by your Name; * in your might, defend my cause.

lines: Hear my prayer, O God; *
give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O God; * give ear to the words of my mouth.

lines: For the arrogant have risen up against me,
and the ruthless have sought my life, *
those who have no regard for God.
verses.text: For the arrogant have risen up against me, and the ruthless have sought my life, * those who have no regard for God.

lines: Behold, God is my helper; *
it is the Lord who sustains my life.
verses.text: Behold, God is my helper; * it is the Lord who sustains my life.

lines: Render evil to those who spy on me; *
in your faithfulness, destroy them.
verses.text: Render evil to those who spy on me; * in your faithfulness, destroy them.

lines: I will offer you a freewill sacrifice *
and praise your Name, O LORD, for it is good.
verses.text: I will offer you a freewill sacrifice * and praise your Name, O LORD, for it is good.

lines: For you have rescued me from every trouble, *
and my eye has seen the ruin of my foes.
verses.text: For you have rescued me from every trouble, * and my eye has seen the ruin of my foes.

lines: Hear my prayer, O God; *
do not hide yourself from my petition.
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O God; * do not hide yourself from my petition.

lines: Listen to me and answer me; *
I have no peace, because of my cares.
verses.text: Listen to me and answer me; * I have no peace, because of my cares.

lines: I am shaken by the noise of the enemy *
and by the pressure of the wicked;
verses.text: I am shaken by the noise of the enemy * and by the pressure of the wicked;

lines: For they have cast an evil spell upon me *
and are set against me in fury.
verses.text: For they have cast an evil spell upon me * and are set against me in fury.

lines: My heart quakes within me, *
and the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
verses.text: My heart quakes within me, * and the terrors of death have fallen upon me.

lines: Fear and trembling have come over me, *
and horror overwhelms me.
verses.text: Fear and trembling have come over me, * and horror overwhelms me.

lines: And I said, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! *
I would fly away and be at rest.
verses.text: And I said, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! * I would fly away and be at rest.

lines: I would flee to a far-off place *
and make my lodging in the wilderness.
verses.text: I would flee to a far-off place * and make my lodging in the wilderness.

lines: I would hasten to escape *
from the stormy wind and tempest."
verses.text: I would hasten to escape * from the stormy wind and tempest."

lines: Swallow them up, O Lord;
confound their speech; *
for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.text: Swallow them up, O Lord; confound their speech; * for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

lines: Day and night the watchmen make their rounds
upon her walls, *
but trouble and misery are in the midst of her.
verses.text: Day and night the watchmen make their rounds upon her walls, * but trouble and misery are in the midst of her.

lines: There is corruption at her heart; *
her streets are never free of oppression and deceit.
verses.text: There is corruption at her heart; * her streets are never free of oppression and deceit.

lines: For had it been an adversary who taunted me,
then I could have borne it; *
or had it been an enemy who vaunted himself against me,
then I could have hidden from him.
verses.text: For had it been an adversary who taunted me, then I could have borne it; * or had it been an enemy who vaunted himself against me, then I could have hidden from him.

lines: But it was you, a man after my own heart, *
my companion, my own familiar friend.
verses.text: But it was you, a man after my own heart, * my companion, my own familiar friend.

lines: We took sweet counsel together, *
and walked with the throng in the house of God.
verses.text: We took sweet counsel together, * and walked with the throng in the house of God.

lines: Let death come upon them suddenly;
let them go down alive to the grave; *
for wickedness is in their dwellings, in their very midst.
verses.text: Let death come upon them suddenly; let them go down alive to the grave; * for wickedness is in their dwellings, in their very midst.

lines: But I will call upon God, *
and the LORD will deliver me.
verses.text: But I will call upon God, * and the LORD will deliver me.

lines: In the evening, in the morning, and at noonday,
I will complain and lament, *
and he will hear my voice.
verses.text: In the evening, in the morning, and at noonday, I will complain and lament, * and he will hear my voice.

lines: He will bring me safely back from the battle
waged against me; *
for there are many who fight me.
verses.text: He will bring me safely back from the battle waged against me; * for there are many who fight me.

lines: God, who is enthroned of old, will hear me and
bring them down; *
they never change; they do not fear God.
verses.text: God, who is enthroned of old, will hear me and bring them down; * they never change; they do not fear God.

lines: My companion stretched forth his hand against his comrade; *
he has broken his covenant.
verses.text: My companion stretched forth his hand against his comrade; * he has broken his covenant.

lines: His speech is softer than butter, *
but war is in his heart.
verses.text: His speech is softer than butter, * but war is in his heart.

lines: His words are smoother than oil, *
but they are drawn swords.
verses.text: His words are smoother than oil, * but they are drawn swords.

lines: Cast your burden upon the LORD,
and he will sustain you; *
he will never let the righteous stumble.
verses.text: Cast your burden upon the LORD, and he will sustain you; * he will never let the righteous stumble.

lines: For you will bring the bloodthirsty and deceitful *
down to the pit of destruction, O God.
verses.text: For you will bring the bloodthirsty and deceitful * down to the pit of destruction, O God.

lines: They shall not live out half their days, *
but I will put my trust in you.
verses.text: They shall not live out half their days, * but I will put my trust in you.

lines: Have mercy on me, O God,
for my enemies are hounding me; *
all day long they assault and oppress me.
verses.text: Have mercy on me, O God, for my enemies are hounding me; * all day long they assault and oppress me.

lines: They hound me all the day long; *
truly there are many who fight against me, O Most High.
verses.text: They hound me all the day long; * truly there are many who fight against me, O Most High.

lines: Whenever I am afraid, *
I will put my trust in you.
verses.text: Whenever I am afraid, * I will put my trust in you.

lines: In God, whose word I praise,
in God I trust and will not be afraid, *
for what can flesh do to me?
verses.text: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust and will not be afraid, * for what can flesh do to me?

lines: All day long they damage my cause; *
their only thought is to do me evil.
verses.text: All day long they damage my cause; * their only thought is to do me evil.

lines: They band together; they lie in wait; *
they spy upon my footsteps;
because they seek my life.
verses.text: They band together; they lie in wait; * they spy upon my footsteps; because they seek my life.

lines: Shall they escape despite their wickedness? *
O God, in your anger, cast down the peoples.
verses.text: Shall they escape despite their wickedness? * O God, in your anger, cast down the peoples.

lines: You have noted my lamentation;
put my tears into your bottle; *
are they not recorded in your book?
verses.text: You have noted my lamentation; put my tears into your bottle; * are they not recorded in your book?

lines: Whenever I call upon you, my enemies will be put to flight; *
this I know, for God is on my side.
verses.text: Whenever I call upon you, my enemies will be put to flight; * this I know, for God is on my side.

lines: In God the LORD, whose word I praise,
in God I trust and will not be afraid, *
for what can mortals do to me?
verses.text: In God the LORD, whose word I praise, in God I trust and will not be afraid, * for what can mortals do to me?

lines: I am bound by the vow I made to you, O God; *
I will present to you thank-offerings;
verses.text: I am bound by the vow I made to you, O God; * I will present to you thank-offerings;

lines: For you have rescued my soul from death and my feet
from stumbling, *
that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
verses.text: For you have rescued my soul from death and my feet from stumbling, * that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

lines: Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful,
for I have taken refuge in you; *
in the shadow of your wings will I take refuge
until this time of trouble has gone by.
verses.text: Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful, for I have taken refuge in you; * in the shadow of your wings will I take refuge until this time of trouble has gone by.

lines: I will call upon the Most High God, *
the God who maintains my cause.
verses.text: I will call upon the Most High God, * the God who maintains my cause.

lines: He will send from heaven and save me;
he will confound those who trample upon me; *
God will send forth his love and his faithfulness.
verses.text: He will send from heaven and save me; he will confound those who trample upon me; * God will send forth his love and his faithfulness.

lines: I lie in the midst of lions that devour the people; *
their teeth are spears and arrows,
their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.text: I lie in the midst of lions that devour the people; * their teeth are spears and arrows, their tongue a sharp sword.

lines: They have laid a net for my feet,
and I am bowed low; *
they have dug a pit before me,
but have fallen into it themselves.
verses.text: They have laid a net for my feet, and I am bowed low; * they have dug a pit before me, but have fallen into it themselves.

lines: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God, *
and your glory over all the earth.
verses.text: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God, * and your glory over all the earth.

lines: My heart is firmly fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; *
I will sing and make melody.
verses.text: My heart is firmly fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; * I will sing and make melody.

lines: Wake up, my spirit;
awake, lute and harp; *
I myself will waken the dawn.
verses.text: Wake up, my spirit; awake, lute and harp; * I myself will waken the dawn.

lines: I will confess you among the peoples, O LORD; *
I will sing praise to you among the nations.
verses.text: I will confess you among the peoples, O LORD; * I will sing praise to you among the nations.

lines: For your loving-kindness is greater than the heavens, *
and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.text: For your loving-kindness is greater than the heavens, * and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

lines: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God, *
and your glory over all the earth.
verses.text: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God, * and your glory over all the earth.

lines: Do you indeed decree righteousness, you rulers? *
do you judge the peoples with equity?
verses.text: Do you indeed decree righteousness, you rulers? * do you judge the peoples with equity?

lines: No; you devise evil in your hearts, *
and your hands deal out violence in the land.
verses.text: No; you devise evil in your hearts, * and your hands deal out violence in the land.

lines: The wicked are perverse from the womb; *
liars go astray from their birth.
verses.text: The wicked are perverse from the womb; * liars go astray from their birth.

lines: They are as venomous as a serpent, *
they are like the deaf adder which stops its ears,
verses.text: They are as venomous as a serpent, * they are like the deaf adder which stops its ears,

lines: Which does not heed the voice of the charmer, *
no matter how skillful his charming.
verses.text: Which does not heed the voice of the charmer, * no matter how skillful his charming.

lines: O God, break their teeth in their mouths; *
pull the fangs of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.text: O God, break their teeth in their mouths; * pull the fangs of the young lions, O LORD.

lines: Let them vanish like water that runs off; *
let them wither like trodden grass.
verses.text: Let them vanish like water that runs off; * let them wither like trodden grass.

lines: Let them be like the snail that melts away, *
like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.
verses.text: Let them be like the snail that melts away, * like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.

lines: Before they bear fruit, let them be cut down like a brier; *
like thorns and thistles let them be swept away.
verses.text: Before they bear fruit, let them be cut down like a brier; * like thorns and thistles let them be swept away.

lines: The righteous will be glad when they see the vengeance; *
they will bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.text: The righteous will be glad when they see the vengeance; * they will bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.

lines: And they will say,
"Surely, there is a reward for the righteous; *
surely, there is a God who rules in the earth."
verses.text: And they will say, "Surely, there is a reward for the righteous; * surely, there is a God who rules in the earth."

lines: Rescue me from my enemies, O God; *
protect me from those who rise up against me.
verses.text: Rescue me from my enemies, O God; * protect me from those who rise up against me.

lines: Rescue me from evildoers *
and save me from those who thirst for my blood.
verses.text: Rescue me from evildoers * and save me from those who thirst for my blood.

lines: See how they lie in wait for my life,
how the mighty gather together against me; *
not for any offense or fault of mine, O LORD.
verses.text: See how they lie in wait for my life, how the mighty gather together against me; * not for any offense or fault of mine, O LORD.

lines: Not because of any guilt of mine *
they run and prepare themselves for battle.
verses.text: Not because of any guilt of mine * they run and prepare themselves for battle.

lines: Rouse yourself, come to my side, and see; *
for you, LORD God of hosts, are Israel's God.
verses.text: Rouse yourself, come to my side, and see; * for you, LORD God of hosts, are Israel's God.

lines: Awake, and punish all the ungodly; *
show no mercy to those who are faithless and evil.
verses.text: Awake, and punish all the ungodly; * show no mercy to those who are faithless and evil.

lines: They go to and fro in the evening; *
they snarl like dogs and run about the city.
verses.text: They go to and fro in the evening; * they snarl like dogs and run about the city.

lines: Behold, they boast with their mouths,
and taunts are on their lips; *
"For who," they say, "will hear us?"
verses.text: Behold, they boast with their mouths, and taunts are on their lips; * "For who," they say, "will hear us?"

lines: But you, O LORD, you laugh at them; *
you laugh all the ungodly to scorn.
verses.text: But you, O LORD, you laugh at them; * you laugh all the ungodly to scorn.

lines: My eyes are fixed on you, O my Strength; *
for you, O God, are my stronghold.
verses.text: My eyes are fixed on you, O my Strength; * for you, O God, are my stronghold.

lines: My merciful God comes to meet me; *
God will let me look in triumph on my enemies.
verses.text: My merciful God comes to meet me; * God will let me look in triumph on my enemies.

lines: Slay them, O God, lest my people forget; *
send them reeling by your might
and put them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.text: Slay them, O God, lest my people forget; * send them reeling by your might and put them down, O Lord our shield.

lines: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips,
for the cursing and lies that they utter, *
let them be caught in their pride.
verses.text: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, for the cursing and lies that they utter, * let them be caught in their pride.

lines: Make an end of them in your wrath; *
make an end of them, and they shall be no more.
verses.text: Make an end of them in your wrath; * make an end of them, and they shall be no more.

lines: Let everyone know that God rules in Jacob, *
and to the ends of the earth.
verses.text: Let everyone know that God rules in Jacob, * and to the ends of the earth.

lines: They go to and fro in the evening; *
they snarl like dogs and run about the city.
verses.text: They go to and fro in the evening; * they snarl like dogs and run about the city.

lines: They forage for food, *
and if they are not filled, they howl.
verses.text: They forage for food, * and if they are not filled, they howl.

lines: For my part, I will sing of your strength; *
I will celebrate your love in the morning;
verses.text: For my part, I will sing of your strength; * I will celebrate your love in the morning;

lines: For you have become my stronghold, *
a refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.text: For you have become my stronghold, * a refuge in the day of my trouble.

lines: To you, O my Strength, will I sing; *
for you, O God, are my stronghold and my merciful God.
verses.text: To you, O my Strength, will I sing; * for you, O God, are my stronghold and my merciful God.

lines: O God, you have cast us off and broken us; *
you have been angry;
oh, take us back to you again.
verses.text: O God, you have cast us off and broken us; * you have been angry; oh, take us back to you again.

lines: You have shaken the earth and split it open; *
repair the cracks in it, for it totters.
verses.text: You have shaken the earth and split it open; * repair the cracks in it, for it totters.

lines: You have made your people know hardship; *
you have given us wine that makes us stagger.
verses.text: You have made your people know hardship; * you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

lines: You have set up a banner for those who fear you, *
to be a refuge from the power of the bow.
verses.text: You have set up a banner for those who fear you, * to be a refuge from the power of the bow.

lines: Save us by your right hand and answer us, *
that those who are dear to you may be delivered.
verses.text: Save us by your right hand and answer us, * that those who are dear to you may be delivered.

lines: God spoke from his holy place and said: *
"I will exult and parcel out Shechem;
I will divide the valley of Succoth.
verses.text: God spoke from his holy place and said: * "I will exult and parcel out Shechem; I will divide the valley of Succoth.

lines: Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine; *
Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my scepter.
verses.text: Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine; * Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my scepter.

lines: Moab is my wash-basin,
on Edom I throw down my sandal to claim it, *
and over Philistia will I shout in triumph."
verses.text: Moab is my wash-basin, on Edom I throw down my sandal to claim it, * and over Philistia will I shout in triumph."

lines: Who will lead me into the strong city? *
who will bring me to Edom?
verses.text: Who will lead me into the strong city? * who will bring me to Edom?

lines: Have you not cast us off, O God? *
you no longer go out, O God, with our armies.
verses.text: Have you not cast us off, O God? * you no longer go out, O God, with our armies.

lines: Grant us your help against the enemy, *
for vain is the help of man.
verses.text: Grant us your help against the enemy, * for vain is the help of man.

lines: With God we will do valiant deeds, *
and he shall tread our enemies under foot.
verses.text: With God we will do valiant deeds, * and he shall tread our enemies under foot.

lines: Hear my cry, O God, *
and listen to my prayer.
verses.text: Hear my cry, O God, * and listen to my prayer.

lines: I call upon you from the ends of the earth
with heaviness in my heart; *
set me upon the rock that is higher than I.
verses.text: I call upon you from the ends of the earth with heaviness in my heart; * set me upon the rock that is higher than I.

lines: For you have been my refuge, *
a strong tower against the enemy.
verses.text: For you have been my refuge, * a strong tower against the enemy.

lines: I will dwell in your house for ever; *
I will take refuge under the cover of your wings.
verses.text: I will dwell in your house for ever; * I will take refuge under the cover of your wings.

lines: For you, O God, have heard my vows; *
you have granted me the heritage of those
who fear your Name.
verses.text: For you, O God, have heard my vows; * you have granted me the heritage of those who fear your Name.

lines: Add length of days to the king's life; *
let his years extend over many generations.
verses.text: Add length of days to the king's life; * let his years extend over many generations.

lines: Let him sit enthroned before God for ever; *
bid love and faithfulness watch over him.
verses.text: Let him sit enthroned before God for ever; * bid love and faithfulness watch over him.

lines: So will I always sing the praise of your Name, *
and day by day I will fulfill my vows.
verses.text: So will I always sing the praise of your Name, * and day by day I will fulfill my vows.

lines: For God alone my soul in silence waits; *
from him comes my salvation.
verses.text: For God alone my soul in silence waits; * from him comes my salvation.

lines: He alone is my rock and my salvation, *
my stronghold, so that I shall not be greatly shaken.
verses.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, * my stronghold, so that I shall not be greatly shaken.

lines: How long will you assail me to crush me,
all of you together, *
as if you were a leaning fence, a toppling wall?
verses.text: How long will you assail me to crush me, all of you together, * as if you were a leaning fence, a toppling wall?

lines: They seek only to bring me down from my place of honor; *
lies are their chief delight.
verses.text: They seek only to bring me down from my place of honor; * lies are their chief delight.

lines: They bless with their lips, *
but in their hearts they curse.
verses.text: They bless with their lips, * but in their hearts they curse.

lines: For God alone my soul in silence waits; *
truly, my hope is in him.
verses.text: For God alone my soul in silence waits; * truly, my hope is in him.

lines: He alone is my rock and my salvation, *
my stronghold, so that I shall not be shaken.
verses.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, * my stronghold, so that I shall not be shaken.

lines: In God is my safety and my honor; *
God is my strong rock and my refuge.
verses.text: In God is my safety and my honor; * God is my strong rock and my refuge.

lines: Put your trust in him always, O people, *
pour out your hearts before him, for God is our refuge.
verses.text: Put your trust in him always, O people, * pour out your hearts before him, for God is our refuge.

lines: Those of high degree are but a fleeting breath, *
even those of low estate cannot be trusted.
verses.text: Those of high degree are but a fleeting breath, * even those of low estate cannot be trusted.

lines: On the scales they are lighter than a breath, *
all of them together.
verses.text: On the scales they are lighter than a breath, * all of them together.

lines: Put no trust in extortion;
in robbery take no empty pride; *
though wealth increase, set not your heart upon it.
verses.text: Put no trust in extortion; in robbery take no empty pride; * though wealth increase, set not your heart upon it.

lines: God has spoken once, twice have I heard it, *
that power belongs to God.
verses.text: God has spoken once, twice have I heard it, * that power belongs to God.

lines: Steadfast love is yours, O Lord, *
for you repay everyone according to his deeds.
verses.text: Steadfast love is yours, O Lord, * for you repay everyone according to his deeds.

lines: O God, you are my God; eagerly I seek you; *
my soul thirsts for you, my flesh faints for you,
as in a barren and dry land where there is no water.
verses.text: O God, you are my God; eagerly I seek you; * my soul thirsts for you, my flesh faints for you, as in a barren and dry land where there is no water.

lines: Therefore I have gazed upon you in your holy place, *
that I might behold your power and your glory.
verses.text: Therefore I have gazed upon you in your holy place, * that I might behold your power and your glory.

lines: For your loving-kindness is better than life itself; *
my lips shall give you praise.
verses.text: For your loving-kindness is better than life itself; * my lips shall give you praise.

lines: So will I bless you as long as I live *
and lift up my hands in your Name.
verses.text: So will I bless you as long as I live * and lift up my hands in your Name.

lines: My soul is content, as with marrow and fatness, *
and my mouth praises you with joyful lips,
verses.text: My soul is content, as with marrow and fatness, * and my mouth praises you with joyful lips,

lines: When I remember you upon my bed, *
and meditate on you in the night watches.
verses.text: When I remember you upon my bed, * and meditate on you in the night watches.

lines: For you have been my helper, *
and under the shadow of your wings I will rejoice.
verses.text: For you have been my helper, * and under the shadow of your wings I will rejoice.

lines: My soul clings to you; *
your right hand holds me fast.
verses.text: My soul clings to you; * your right hand holds me fast.

lines: May those who seek my life to destroy it *
go down into the depths of the earth;
verses.text: May those who seek my life to destroy it * go down into the depths of the earth;

lines: Let them fall upon the edge of the sword, *
and let them be food for jackals.
verses.text: Let them fall upon the edge of the sword, * and let them be food for jackals.

lines: But the king will rejoice in God;
all those who swear by him will be glad; *
for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.text: But the king will rejoice in God; all those who swear by him will be glad; * for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.

lines: Hear my voice, O God, when I complain; *
protect my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.text: Hear my voice, O God, when I complain; * protect my life from fear of the enemy.

lines: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, *
from the mob of evildoers.
verses.text: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, * from the mob of evildoers.

lines: They sharpen their tongue like a sword, *
and aim their bitter words like arrows,
verses.text: They sharpen their tongue like a sword, * and aim their bitter words like arrows,

lines: That they may shoot down the blameless from ambush; *
they shoot without warning and are not afraid.
verses.text: That they may shoot down the blameless from ambush; * they shoot without warning and are not afraid.

lines: They hold fast to their evil course; *
they plan how they may hide their snares.
verses.text: They hold fast to their evil course; * they plan how they may hide their snares.

lines: They say, "Who will see us?
who will find out our crimes? *
we have thought out a perfect plot."
verses.text: They say, "Who will see us? who will find out our crimes? * we have thought out a perfect plot."

lines: The human mind and heart are a mystery; *
but God will loose an arrow at them,
and suddenly they will be wounded.
verses.text: The human mind and heart are a mystery; * but God will loose an arrow at them, and suddenly they will be wounded.

lines: He will make them trip over their tongues, *
and all who see them will shake their heads.
verses.text: He will make them trip over their tongues, * and all who see them will shake their heads.

lines: Everyone will stand in awe and declare God's deeds; *
they will recognize his works.
verses.text: Everyone will stand in awe and declare God's deeds; * they will recognize his works.

lines: The righteous will rejoice in the LORD and put their trust in him, *
and all who are true of heart will glory.
verses.text: The righteous will rejoice in the LORD and put their trust in him, * and all who are true of heart will glory.

lines: You are to be praised, O God, in Zion; *
to you shall vows be performed in Jerusalem.
verses.text: You are to be praised, O God, in Zion; * to you shall vows be performed in Jerusalem.

lines: To you that hear prayer shall all flesh come, *
because of their transgressions.
verses.text: To you that hear prayer shall all flesh come, * because of their transgressions.

lines: Our sins are stronger than we are, *
but you will blot them out.
verses.text: Our sins are stronger than we are, * but you will blot them out.

lines: Happy are they whom you choose
and draw to your courts to dwell there! *
they will be satisfied by the beauty of your house,
by the holiness of your temple.
verses.text: Happy are they whom you choose and draw to your courts to dwell there! * they will be satisfied by the beauty of your house, by the holiness of your temple.

lines: Awesome things will you show us in your righteousness,
O God of our salvation, *
O Hope of all the ends of the earth
and of the seas that are far away.
verses.text: Awesome things will you show us in your righteousness, O God of our salvation, * O Hope of all the ends of the earth and of the seas that are far away.

lines: You make fast the mountains by your power; *
they are girded about with might.
verses.text: You make fast the mountains by your power; * they are girded about with might.

lines: You still the roaring of the seas, *
the roaring of their waves,
and the clamor of the peoples.
verses.text: You still the roaring of the seas, * the roaring of their waves, and the clamor of the peoples.

lines: Those who dwell at the ends of the earth will tremble at your
marvelous signs; *
you make the dawn and the dusk to sing for joy.
verses.text: Those who dwell at the ends of the earth will tremble at your marvelous signs; * you make the dawn and the dusk to sing for joy.

lines: You visit the earth and water it abundantly;
you make it very plenteous; *
the river of God is full of water.
verses.text: You visit the earth and water it abundantly; you make it very plenteous; * the river of God is full of water.

lines: You prepare the grain, *
for so you provide for the earth.
verses.text: You prepare the grain, * for so you provide for the earth.

lines: You drench the furrows and smooth out the ridges; *
with heavy rain you soften the ground and bless its increase.
verses.text: You drench the furrows and smooth out the ridges; * with heavy rain you soften the ground and bless its increase.

lines: You crown the year with your goodness, *
and your paths overflow with plenty.
verses.text: You crown the year with your goodness, * and your paths overflow with plenty.

lines: May the fields of the wilderness be rich for grazing, *
and the hills be clothed with joy.
verses.text: May the fields of the wilderness be rich for grazing, * and the hills be clothed with joy.

lines: May the meadows cover themselves with flocks,
and the valleys cloak themselves with grain; *
let them shout for joy and sing.
verses.text: May the meadows cover themselves with flocks, and the valleys cloak themselves with grain; * let them shout for joy and sing.

lines: Be joyful in God, all you lands; *
sing the glory of his Name;
sing the glory of his praise.
verses.text: Be joyful in God, all you lands; * sing the glory of his Name; sing the glory of his praise.

lines: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! *
because of your great strength your enemies
cringe before you.
verses.text: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! * because of your great strength your enemies cringe before you.

lines: All the earth bows down before you, *
sings to you, sings out your Name."
verses.text: All the earth bows down before you, * sings to you, sings out your Name."

lines: Come now and see the works of God, *
how wonderful he is in his doing toward all people.
verses.text: Come now and see the works of God, * how wonderful he is in his doing toward all people.

lines: He turned the sea into dry land,
so that they went through the water on foot, *
and there we rejoiced in him.
verses.text: He turned the sea into dry land, so that they went through the water on foot, * and there we rejoiced in him.

lines: In his might he rules for ever;
his eyes keep watch over the nations; *
let no rebel rise up against him.
verses.text: In his might he rules for ever; his eyes keep watch over the nations; * let no rebel rise up against him.

lines: Bless our God, you peoples; *
make the voice of his praise to be heard;
verses.text: Bless our God, you peoples; * make the voice of his praise to be heard;

lines: Who holds our souls in life, *
and will not allow our feet to slip.
verses.text: Who holds our souls in life, * and will not allow our feet to slip.

lines: For you, O God, have proved us; *
you have tried us just as silver is tried.
verses.text: For you, O God, have proved us; * you have tried us just as silver is tried.

lines: You brought us into the snare; *
you laid heavy burdens upon our backs.
verses.text: You brought us into the snare; * you laid heavy burdens upon our backs.

lines: You let enemies ride over our heads;
we went through fire and water; *
but you brought us out into a place of refreshment.
verses.text: You let enemies ride over our heads; we went through fire and water; * but you brought us out into a place of refreshment.

lines: I will enter your house with burnt-offerings
and will pay you my vows, *
which I promised with my lips
and spoke with my mouth when I was in trouble.
verses.text: I will enter your house with burnt-offerings and will pay you my vows, * which I promised with my lips and spoke with my mouth when I was in trouble.

lines: I will offer you sacrifices of fat beasts
with the smoke of rams; *
I will give you oxen and goats.
verses.text: I will offer you sacrifices of fat beasts with the smoke of rams; * I will give you oxen and goats.

lines: Come and listen, all you who fear God, *
and I will tell you what he has done for me.
verses.text: Come and listen, all you who fear God, * and I will tell you what he has done for me.

lines: I called out to him with my mouth, *
and his praise was on my tongue.
verses.text: I called out to him with my mouth, * and his praise was on my tongue.

lines: If I had found evil in my heart, *
the Lord would not have heard me;
verses.text: If I had found evil in my heart, * the Lord would not have heard me;

lines: But in truth God has heard me; *
he has attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.text: But in truth God has heard me; * he has attended to the voice of my prayer.

lines: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer, *
nor withheld his love from me.
verses.text: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer, * nor withheld his love from me.

lines: May God be merciful to us and bless us, *
show us the light of his countenance and come to us.
verses.text: May God be merciful to us and bless us, * show us the light of his countenance and come to us.

lines: Let your ways be known upon earth, *
your saving health among all nations.
verses.text: Let your ways be known upon earth, * your saving health among all nations.

lines: Let the peoples praise you, O God; *
let all the peoples praise you.
verses.text: Let the peoples praise you, O God; * let all the peoples praise you.

lines: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, *
for you judge the peoples with equity
and guide all the nations upon earth.
verses.text: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, * for you judge the peoples with equity and guide all the nations upon earth.

lines: Let the peoples praise you, O God; *
let all the peoples praise you.
verses.text: Let the peoples praise you, O God; * let all the peoples praise you.

lines: The earth has brought forth her increase; *
may God, our own God, give us his blessing.
verses.text: The earth has brought forth her increase; * may God, our own God, give us his blessing.

lines: May God give us his blessing, *
and may all the ends of the earth stand in awe of him.
verses.text: May God give us his blessing, * and may all the ends of the earth stand in awe of him.

lines: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered; *
let those who hate him flee before him.
verses.text: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered; * let those who hate him flee before him.

lines: Let them vanish like smoke when the wind drives it away; *
as the wax melts at the fire, so let the wicked perish at
the presence of God.
verses.text: Let them vanish like smoke when the wind drives it away; * as the wax melts at the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

lines: But let the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; *
let them also be merry and joyful.
verses.text: But let the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; * let them also be merry and joyful.

lines: Sing to God, sing praises to his Name;
exalt him who rides upon the heavens; *
YAHWEH is his Name, rejoice before him!
verses.text: Sing to God, sing praises to his Name; exalt him who rides upon the heavens; * YAHWEH is his Name, rejoice before him!

lines: Father of orphans, defender of widows, *
God in his holy habitation!
verses.text: Father of orphans, defender of widows, * God in his holy habitation!

lines: God gives the solitary a home and brings forth prisoners
into freedom; *
but the rebels shall live in dry places.
verses.text: God gives the solitary a home and brings forth prisoners into freedom; * but the rebels shall live in dry places.

lines: O God, when you went forth before your people, *
when you marched through the wilderness,
verses.text: O God, when you went forth before your people, * when you marched through the wilderness,

lines: The earth shook, and the skies poured down rain,
at the presence of God, the God of Sinai, *
at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.text: The earth shook, and the skies poured down rain, at the presence of God, the God of Sinai, * at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

lines: You sent a gracious rain, O God, upon your inheritance; *
you refreshed the land when it was weary.
verses.text: You sent a gracious rain, O God, upon your inheritance; * you refreshed the land when it was weary.

lines: Your people found their home in it; *
in your goodness, O God, you have made provision
for the poor.
verses.text: Your people found their home in it; * in your goodness, O God, you have made provision for the poor.

lines: The Lord gave the word; *
great was the company of women who bore the tidings:
verses.text: The Lord gave the word; * great was the company of women who bore the tidings:

lines: "Kings with their armies are fleeing away; *
the women at home are dividing the spoils."
verses.text: "Kings with their armies are fleeing away; * the women at home are dividing the spoils."

lines: Though you lingered among the sheepfolds, *
you shall be like a dove whose wings are covered with silver,
whose feathers are like green gold.
verses.text: Though you lingered among the sheepfolds, * you shall be like a dove whose wings are covered with silver, whose feathers are like green gold.

lines: When the Almighty scattered kings, *
it was like snow falling in Zalmon.
verses.text: When the Almighty scattered kings, * it was like snow falling in Zalmon.

lines: O mighty mountain, O hill of Bashan! *
O rugged mountain, O hill of Bashan!
verses.text: O mighty mountain, O hill of Bashan! * O rugged mountain, O hill of Bashan!

lines: Why do you look with envy, O rugged mountain,
at the hill which God chose for his resting place? *
truly, the LORD will dwell there for ever.
verses.text: Why do you look with envy, O rugged mountain, at the hill which God chose for his resting place? * truly, the LORD will dwell there for ever.

lines: The chariots of God are twenty thousand,
even thousands of thousands; *
the Lord comes in holiness from Sinai.
verses.text: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of thousands; * the Lord comes in holiness from Sinai.

lines: You have gone up on high and led captivity captive;
you have received gifts even from your enemies, *
that the LORD God might dwell among them.
verses.text: You have gone up on high and led captivity captive; you have received gifts even from your enemies, * that the LORD God might dwell among them.

lines: Blessed be the Lord day by day, *
the God of our salvation, who bears our burdens.
verses.text: Blessed be the Lord day by day, * the God of our salvation, who bears our burdens.

lines: He is our God, the God of our salvation; *
God is the LORD, by whom we escape death.
verses.text: He is our God, the God of our salvation; * God is the LORD, by whom we escape death.

lines: God shall crush the heads of his enemies, *
and the hairy scalp of those who go on still in their
wickedness.
verses.text: God shall crush the heads of his enemies, * and the hairy scalp of those who go on still in their wickedness.

lines: The Lord has said, "I will bring them back from Bashan; *
I will bring them back from the depths of the sea;
verses.text: The Lord has said, "I will bring them back from Bashan; * I will bring them back from the depths of the sea;

lines: That your foot may be dipped in blood, *
the tongues of your dogs in the blood of your enemies."
verses.text: That your foot may be dipped in blood, * the tongues of your dogs in the blood of your enemies."

lines: They see your procession, O God, *
your procession into the sanctuary, my God and my King.
verses.text: They see your procession, O God, * your procession into the sanctuary, my God and my King.

lines: The singers go before, musicians follow after, *
in the midst of maidens playing upon the hand-drums.
verses.text: The singers go before, musicians follow after, * in the midst of maidens playing upon the hand-drums.

lines: Bless God in the congregation; *
bless the LORD, you that are of the fountain of Israel.
verses.text: Bless God in the congregation; * bless the LORD, you that are of the fountain of Israel.

lines: There is Benjamin, least of the tribes, at the head;
the princes of Judah in a company; *
and the princes of Zebulon and Naphtali.
verses.text: There is Benjamin, least of the tribes, at the head; the princes of Judah in a company; * and the princes of Zebulon and Naphtali.

lines: Send forth your strength, O God; *
establish, O God, what you have wrought for us.
verses.text: Send forth your strength, O God; * establish, O God, what you have wrought for us.

lines: Kings shall bring gifts to you, *
for your temple's sake at Jerusalem.
verses.text: Kings shall bring gifts to you, * for your temple's sake at Jerusalem.

lines: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, *
and the peoples, a herd of wild bulls with its calves.
verses.text: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, * and the peoples, a herd of wild bulls with its calves.

lines: Trample down those who lust after silver; *
scatter the peoples that delight in war.
verses.text: Trample down those who lust after silver; * scatter the peoples that delight in war.

lines: Let tribute be brought out of Egypt; *
let Ethiopia stretch out her hands to God.
verses.text: Let tribute be brought out of Egypt; * let Ethiopia stretch out her hands to God.

lines: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; *
sing praises to the Lord.
verses.text: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; * sing praises to the Lord.

lines: He rides in the heavens, the ancient heavens; *
he sends forth his voice, his mighty voice.
verses.text: He rides in the heavens, the ancient heavens; * he sends forth his voice, his mighty voice.

lines: Ascribe power to God; *
his majesty is over Israel;
his strength is in the skies.
verses.text: Ascribe power to God; * his majesty is over Israel; his strength is in the skies.

lines: How wonderful is God in his holy places! *
the God of Israel giving strength and power to his people!
Blessed be God!
verses.text: How wonderful is God in his holy places! * the God of Israel giving strength and power to his people! Blessed be God!

lines: Save me, O God, *
for the waters have risen up to my neck.
verses.text: Save me, O God, * for the waters have risen up to my neck.

lines: I am sinking in deep mire, *
and there is no firm ground for my feet.
verses.text: I am sinking in deep mire, * and there is no firm ground for my feet.

lines: I have come into deep waters, *
and the torrent washes over me.
verses.text: I have come into deep waters, * and the torrent washes over me.

lines: I have grown weary with my crying;
my throat is inflamed; *
my eyes have failed from looking for my God.
verses.text: I have grown weary with my crying; my throat is inflamed; * my eyes have failed from looking for my God.

lines: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs
of my head;
my lying foes who would destroy me are mighty. *
Must I then give back what I never stole?
verses.text: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; my lying foes who would destroy me are mighty. * Must I then give back what I never stole?

lines: O God, you know my foolishness, *
and my faults are not hidden from you.
verses.text: O God, you know my foolishness, * and my faults are not hidden from you.

lines: Let not those who hope in you be put to shame through me,
Lord GOD of hosts; *
let not those who seek you be disgraced because of me,
O God of Israel.
verses.text: Let not those who hope in you be put to shame through me, Lord GOD of hosts; * let not those who seek you be disgraced because of me, O God of Israel.

lines: Surely, for your sake have I suffered reproach, *
and shame has covered my face.
verses.text: Surely, for your sake have I suffered reproach, * and shame has covered my face.

lines: I have become a stranger to my own kindred, *
an alien to my mother's children.
verses.text: I have become a stranger to my own kindred, * an alien to my mother's children.

lines: Zeal for your house has eaten me up; *
the scorn of those who scorn you has fallen upon me.
verses.text: Zeal for your house has eaten me up; * the scorn of those who scorn you has fallen upon me.

lines: I humbled myself with fasting, *
but that was turned to my reproach.
verses.text: I humbled myself with fasting, * but that was turned to my reproach.

lines: I put on sack-cloth also, *
and became a byword among them.
verses.text: I put on sack-cloth also, * and became a byword among them.

lines: Those who sit at the gate murmur against me, *
and the drunkards make songs about me.
verses.text: Those who sit at the gate murmur against me, * and the drunkards make songs about me.

lines: But as for me, this is my prayer to you, *
at the time you have set, O LORD:
verses.text: But as for me, this is my prayer to you, * at the time you have set, O LORD:

lines: "In your great mercy, O God, *
answer me with your unfailing help.
verses.text: "In your great mercy, O God, * answer me with your unfailing help.

lines: Save me from the mire; do not let me sink; *
let me be rescued from those who hate me
and out of the deep waters.
verses.text: Save me from the mire; do not let me sink; * let me be rescued from those who hate me and out of the deep waters.

lines: Let not the torrent of waters wash over me,
neither let the deep swallow me up; *
do not let the Pit shut its mouth upon me.
verses.text: Let not the torrent of waters wash over me, neither let the deep swallow me up; * do not let the Pit shut its mouth upon me.

lines: Answer me, O LORD, for your love is kind; *
in your great compassion, turn to me."
verses.text: Answer me, O LORD, for your love is kind; * in your great compassion, turn to me."

lines: "Hide not your face from your servant; *
be swift and answer me, for I am in distress.
verses.text: "Hide not your face from your servant; * be swift and answer me, for I am in distress.

lines: Draw near to me and redeem me; *
because of my enemies deliver me.
verses.text: Draw near to me and redeem me; * because of my enemies deliver me.

lines: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor; *
my adversaries are all in your sight."
verses.text: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor; * my adversaries are all in your sight."

lines: Reproach has broken my heart, and it cannot be healed; *
I looked for sympathy, but there was none,
for comforters, but I could find no one.
verses.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and it cannot be healed; * I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I could find no one.

lines: They gave me gall to eat, *
and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.text: They gave me gall to eat, * and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar to drink.

lines: Let the table before them be a trap *
and their sacred feasts a snare.
verses.text: Let the table before them be a trap * and their sacred feasts a snare.

lines: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, *
and give them continual trembling in their loins.
verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, * and give them continual trembling in their loins.

lines: Pour out your indignation upon them, *
and let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
verses.text: Pour out your indignation upon them, * and let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

lines: Let their camp be desolate, *
and let there be none to dwell in their tents.
verses.text: Let their camp be desolate, * and let there be none to dwell in their tents.

lines: For they persecute him whom you have stricken *
and add to the pain of those whom you have pierced.
verses.text: For they persecute him whom you have stricken * and add to the pain of those whom you have pierced.

lines: Lay to their charge guilt upon guilt, *
and let them not receive your vindication.
verses.text: Lay to their charge guilt upon guilt, * and let them not receive your vindication.

lines: Let them be wiped out of the book of the living *
and not be written among the righteous.
verses.text: Let them be wiped out of the book of the living * and not be written among the righteous.

lines: As for me, I am afflicted and in pain; *
your help, O God, will lift me up on high.
verses.text: As for me, I am afflicted and in pain; * your help, O God, will lift me up on high.

lines: I will praise the Name of God in song; *
I will proclaim his greatness with thanksgiving.
verses.text: I will praise the Name of God in song; * I will proclaim his greatness with thanksgiving.

lines: This will please the LORD more than an offering of oxen, *
more than bullocks with horns and hoofs.
verses.text: This will please the LORD more than an offering of oxen, * more than bullocks with horns and hoofs.

lines: The afflicted shall see and be glad; *
you who seek God, your heart shall live.
verses.text: The afflicted shall see and be glad; * you who seek God, your heart shall live.

lines: For the LORD listens to the needy, *
and his prisoners he does not despise.
verses.text: For the LORD listens to the needy, * and his prisoners he does not despise.

lines: Let the heavens and the earth praise him, *
the seas and all that moves in them;
verses.text: Let the heavens and the earth praise him, * the seas and all that moves in them;

lines: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah; *
they shall live there and have it in possession.
verses.text: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah; * they shall live there and have it in possession.

lines: The children of his servants will inherit it, *
and those who love his Name will dwell therein.
verses.text: The children of his servants will inherit it, * and those who love his Name will dwell therein.

lines: Be pleased, O God, to deliver me; *
O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.text: Be pleased, O God, to deliver me; * O LORD, make haste to help me.

lines: Let those who seek my life be ashamed
and altogether dismayed; *
let those who take pleasure in my misfortune
draw back and be disgraced.
verses.text: Let those who seek my life be ashamed and altogether dismayed; * let those who take pleasure in my misfortune draw back and be disgraced.

lines: Let those who say to me "Aha!" and gloat over me turn back, *
because they are ashamed.
verses.text: Let those who say to me "Aha!" and gloat over me turn back, * because they are ashamed.

lines: Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; *
let those who love your salvation say for ever,
"Great is the LORD!"
verses.text: Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; * let those who love your salvation say for ever, "Great is the LORD!"

lines: But as for me, I am poor and needy; *
come to me speedily, O God.
verses.text: But as for me, I am poor and needy; * come to me speedily, O God.

lines: You are my helper and my deliverer; *
O LORD, do not tarry.
verses.text: You are my helper and my deliverer; * O LORD, do not tarry.

lines: In you, O LORD, have I taken refuge; *
let me never be ashamed.
verses.text: In you, O LORD, have I taken refuge; * let me never be ashamed.

lines: In your righteousness, deliver me and set me free; *
incline your ear to me and save me.
verses.text: In your righteousness, deliver me and set me free; * incline your ear to me and save me.

lines: Be my strong rock, a castle to keep me safe; *
you are my crag and my stronghold.
verses.text: Be my strong rock, a castle to keep me safe; * you are my crag and my stronghold.

lines: Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, *
from the clutches of the evildoer and the oppressor.
verses.text: Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, * from the clutches of the evildoer and the oppressor.

lines: For you are my hope, O LORD God, *
my confidence since I was young.
verses.text: For you are my hope, O LORD God, * my confidence since I was young.

lines: I have been sustained by you ever since I was born;
from my mother's womb you have been my strength; *
my praise shall be always of you.
verses.text: I have been sustained by you ever since I was born; from my mother's womb you have been my strength; * my praise shall be always of you.

lines: I have become a portent to many; *
but you are my refuge and my strength.
verses.text: I have become a portent to many; * but you are my refuge and my strength.

lines: Let my mouth be full of your praise *
and your glory all the day long.
verses.text: Let my mouth be full of your praise * and your glory all the day long.

lines: Do not cast me off in my old age; *
forsake me not when my strength fails.
verses.text: Do not cast me off in my old age; * forsake me not when my strength fails.

lines: For my enemies are talking against me, *
and those who lie in wait for my life take counsel together.
verses.text: For my enemies are talking against me, * and those who lie in wait for my life take counsel together.

lines: They say, "God has forsaken him;
go after him and seize him; *
because there is none who will save."
verses.text: They say, "God has forsaken him; go after him and seize him; * because there is none who will save."

lines: O God, be not far from me; *
come quickly to help me, O my God.
verses.text: O God, be not far from me; * come quickly to help me, O my God.

lines: Let those who set themselves against me be put to shame and
be disgraced; *
let those who seek to do me evil be covered with scorn
and reproach.
verses.text: Let those who set themselves against me be put to shame and be disgraced; * let those who seek to do me evil be covered with scorn and reproach.

lines: But I shall always wait in patience, *
and shall praise you more and more.
verses.text: But I shall always wait in patience, * and shall praise you more and more.

lines: My mouth shall recount your mighty acts
and saving deeds all day long; *
though I cannot know the number of them.
verses.text: My mouth shall recount your mighty acts and saving deeds all day long; * though I cannot know the number of them.

lines: I will begin with the mighty works of the Lord GOD; *
I will recall your righteousness, yours alone.
verses.text: I will begin with the mighty works of the Lord GOD; * I will recall your righteousness, yours alone.

lines: O God, you have taught me since I was young, *
and to this day I tell of your wonderful works.
verses.text: O God, you have taught me since I was young, * and to this day I tell of your wonderful works.

lines: And now that I am old and gray-headed, O God, do not
forsake me, *
till I make known your strength to this generation
and your power to all who are to come.
verses.text: And now that I am old and gray-headed, O God, do not forsake me, * till I make known your strength to this generation and your power to all who are to come.

lines: Your righteousness, O God, reaches to the heavens; *
you have done great things;
who is like you, O God?
verses.text: Your righteousness, O God, reaches to the heavens; * you have done great things; who is like you, O God?

lines: You have showed me great troubles and adversities, *
but you will restore my life
and bring me up again from the deep places of the earth.
verses.text: You have showed me great troubles and adversities, * but you will restore my life and bring me up again from the deep places of the earth.

lines: You strengthen me more and more; *
you enfold and comfort me,
verses.text: You strengthen me more and more; * you enfold and comfort me,

lines: Therefore I will praise you upon the lyre for your
faithfulness, O my God; *
I will sing to you with the harp, O Holy One of Israel.
verses.text: Therefore I will praise you upon the lyre for your faithfulness, O my God; * I will sing to you with the harp, O Holy One of Israel.

lines: My lips will sing with joy when I play to you, *
and so will my soul, which you have redeemed.
verses.text: My lips will sing with joy when I play to you, * and so will my soul, which you have redeemed.

lines: My tongue will proclaim your righteousness all day long, *
for they are ashamed and disgraced who sought
to do me harm.
verses.text: My tongue will proclaim your righteousness all day long, * for they are ashamed and disgraced who sought to do me harm.

lines: Give the King your justice, O God, *
and your righteousness to the King's son;
verses.text: Give the King your justice, O God, * and your righteousness to the King's son;

lines: That he may rule your people righteously *
and the poor with justice;
verses.text: That he may rule your people righteously * and the poor with justice;

lines: That the mountains may bring prosperity to the people, *
and the little hills bring righteousness.
verses.text: That the mountains may bring prosperity to the people, * and the little hills bring righteousness.

lines: He shall defend the needy among the people; *
he shall rescue the poor and crush the oppressor.
verses.text: He shall defend the needy among the people; * he shall rescue the poor and crush the oppressor.

lines: He shall live as long as the sun and moon endure, *
from one generation to another.
verses.text: He shall live as long as the sun and moon endure, * from one generation to another.

lines: He shall come down like rain upon the mown field, *
like showers that water the earth.
verses.text: He shall come down like rain upon the mown field, * like showers that water the earth.

lines: In his time shall the righteous flourish; *
there shall be abundance of peace till the moon shall
be no more.
verses.text: In his time shall the righteous flourish; * there shall be abundance of peace till the moon shall be no more.

lines: He shall rule from sea to sea, *
and from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.text: He shall rule from sea to sea, * and from the River to the ends of the earth.

lines: His foes shall bow down before him, *
and his enemies lick the dust.
verses.text: His foes shall bow down before him, * and his enemies lick the dust.

lines: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall pay tribute, *
and the kings of Arabia and Saba offer gifts.
verses.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall pay tribute, * and the kings of Arabia and Saba offer gifts.

lines: All kings shall bow down before him, *
and all the nations do him service.
verses.text: All kings shall bow down before him, * and all the nations do him service.

lines: For he shall deliver the poor who cries out in distress, *
and the oppressed who has no helper.
verses.text: For he shall deliver the poor who cries out in distress, * and the oppressed who has no helper.

lines: He shall have pity on the lowly and poor; *
he shall preserve the lives of the needy.
verses.text: He shall have pity on the lowly and poor; * he shall preserve the lives of the needy.

lines: He shall redeem their lives from oppression and violence, *
and dear shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.text: He shall redeem their lives from oppression and violence, * and dear shall their blood be in his sight.

lines: Long may he live!
and may there be given to him gold from Arabia; *
may prayer be made for him always,
and may they bless him all the day long.
verses.text: Long may he live! and may there be given to him gold from Arabia; * may prayer be made for him always, and may they bless him all the day long.

lines: May there be abundance of grain on the earth,
growing thick even on the hilltops; *
may its fruit flourish like Lebanon,
and its grain like grass upon the earth.
verses.text: May there be abundance of grain on the earth, growing thick even on the hilltops; * may its fruit flourish like Lebanon, and its grain like grass upon the earth.

lines: May his Name remain for ever
and be established as long as the sun endures; *
may all the nations bless themselves in him and
call him blessed.
verses.text: May his Name remain for ever and be established as long as the sun endures; * may all the nations bless themselves in him and call him blessed.

lines: Blessed be the Lord GOD, the God of Israel, *
who alone does wondrous deeds!
verses.text: Blessed be the Lord GOD, the God of Israel, * who alone does wondrous deeds!

lines: And blessed be his glorious Name for ever! *
and may all the earth be filled with his glory.
Amen. Amen.
verses.text: And blessed be his glorious Name for ever! * and may all the earth be filled with his glory. Amen. Amen.

lines: Truly, God is good to Israel, *
to those who are pure in heart.
verses.text: Truly, God is good to Israel, * to those who are pure in heart.

lines: But as for me, my feet had nearly slipped; *
I had almost tripped and fallen;
verses.text: But as for me, my feet had nearly slipped; * I had almost tripped and fallen;

lines: Because I envied the proud *
and saw the prosperity of the wicked:
verses.text: Because I envied the proud * and saw the prosperity of the wicked:

lines: For they suffer no pain, *
and their bodies are sleek and sound;
verses.text: For they suffer no pain, * and their bodies are sleek and sound;

lines: In the misfortunes of others they have no share; *
they are not afflicted as others are;
verses.text: In the misfortunes of others they have no share; * they are not afflicted as others are;

lines: Therefore they wear their pride like a necklace *
and wrap their violence about them like a cloak.
verses.text: Therefore they wear their pride like a necklace * and wrap their violence about them like a cloak.

lines: Their iniquity comes from gross minds, *
and their hearts overflow with wicked thoughts.
verses.text: Their iniquity comes from gross minds, * and their hearts overflow with wicked thoughts.

lines: They scoff and speak maliciously; *
out of their haughtiness they plan oppression.
verses.text: They scoff and speak maliciously; * out of their haughtiness they plan oppression.

lines: They set their mouths against the heavens, *
and their evil speech runs through the world.
verses.text: They set their mouths against the heavens, * and their evil speech runs through the world.

lines: And so the people turn to them *
and find in them no fault.
verses.text: And so the people turn to them * and find in them no fault.

lines: They say, "How should God know? *
is there knowledge in the Most High?"
verses.text: They say, "How should God know? * is there knowledge in the Most High?"

lines: So then, these are the wicked; *
always at ease, they increase their wealth.
verses.text: So then, these are the wicked; * always at ease, they increase their wealth.

lines: In vain have I kept my heart clean, *
and washed my hands in innocence.
verses.text: In vain have I kept my heart clean, * and washed my hands in innocence.

lines: I have been afflicted all day long, *
and punished every morning.
verses.text: I have been afflicted all day long, * and punished every morning.

lines: Had I gone on speaking this way, *
I should have betrayed the generation of your children.
verses.text: Had I gone on speaking this way, * I should have betrayed the generation of your children.

lines: When I tried to understand these things, *
it was too hard for me;
verses.text: When I tried to understand these things, * it was too hard for me;

lines: Until I entered the sanctuary of God *
and discerned the end of the wicked.
verses.text: Until I entered the sanctuary of God * and discerned the end of the wicked.

lines: Surely, you set them in slippery places; *
you cast them down in ruin.
verses.text: Surely, you set them in slippery places; * you cast them down in ruin.

lines: Oh, how suddenly do they come to destruction, *
come to an end, and perish from terror!
verses.text: Oh, how suddenly do they come to destruction, * come to an end, and perish from terror!

lines: Like a dream when one awakens, O Lord, *
when you arise you will make their image vanish.
verses.text: Like a dream when one awakens, O Lord, * when you arise you will make their image vanish.

lines: When my mind became embittered, *
I was sorely wounded in my heart.
verses.text: When my mind became embittered, * I was sorely wounded in my heart.

lines: I was stupid and had no understanding; *
I was like a brute beast in your presence.
verses.text: I was stupid and had no understanding; * I was like a brute beast in your presence.

lines: Yet I am always with you; *
you hold me by my right hand.
verses.text: Yet I am always with you; * you hold me by my right hand.

lines: You will guide me by your counsel, *
and afterwards receive me with glory.
verses.text: You will guide me by your counsel, * and afterwards receive me with glory.

lines: Whom have I in heaven but you? *
and having you I desire nothing upon earth.
verses.text: Whom have I in heaven but you? * and having you I desire nothing upon earth.

lines: Though my flesh and my heart should waste away, *
God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.
verses.text: Though my flesh and my heart should waste away, * God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.

lines: Truly, those who forsake you will perish; *
you destroy all who are unfaithful.
verses.text: Truly, those who forsake you will perish; * you destroy all who are unfaithful.

lines: But it is good for me to be near God; *
I have made the Lord GOD my refuge.
verses.text: But it is good for me to be near God; * I have made the Lord GOD my refuge.

lines: I will speak of all your works *
in the gates of the city of Zion.
verses.text: I will speak of all your works * in the gates of the city of Zion.

lines: O God, why have you utterly cast us off? *
why is your wrath so hot against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.text: O God, why have you utterly cast us off? * why is your wrath so hot against the sheep of your pasture?

lines: Remember your congregation that you purchased long ago, *
the tribe you redeemed to be your inheritance,
and Mount Zion where you dwell.
verses.text: Remember your congregation that you purchased long ago, * the tribe you redeemed to be your inheritance, and Mount Zion where you dwell.

lines: Turn your steps toward the endless ruins; *
the enemy has laid waste everything in your sanctuary.
verses.text: Turn your steps toward the endless ruins; * the enemy has laid waste everything in your sanctuary.

lines: Your adversaries roared in your holy place; *
they set up their banners as tokens of victory.
verses.text: Your adversaries roared in your holy place; * they set up their banners as tokens of victory.

lines: They were like men coming up with axes to a grove of trees; *
they broke down all your carved work with hatchets
and hammers.
verses.text: They were like men coming up with axes to a grove of trees; * they broke down all your carved work with hatchets and hammers.

lines: They set fire to your holy place; *
they defiled the dwelling-place of your Name
and razed it to the ground.
verses.text: They set fire to your holy place; * they defiled the dwelling-place of your Name and razed it to the ground.

lines: They said to themselves, "Let us destroy them altogether." *
They burned down all the meeting-places of God
in the land.
verses.text: They said to themselves, "Let us destroy them altogether." * They burned down all the meeting-places of God in the land.

lines: There are no signs for us to see;
there is no prophet left; *
there is not one among us who knows how long.
verses.text: There are no signs for us to see; there is no prophet left; * there is not one among us who knows how long.

lines: How long, O God, will the adversary scoff? *
will the enemy blaspheme your Name for ever?
verses.text: How long, O God, will the adversary scoff? * will the enemy blaspheme your Name for ever?

lines: Why do you draw back your hand? *
why is your right hand hidden in your bosom?
verses.text: Why do you draw back your hand? * why is your right hand hidden in your bosom?

lines: Yet God is my King from ancient times, *
victorious in the midst of the earth.
verses.text: Yet God is my King from ancient times, * victorious in the midst of the earth.

lines: You divided the sea by your might *
and shattered the heads of the dragons upon the waters;
verses.text: You divided the sea by your might * and shattered the heads of the dragons upon the waters;

lines: You crushed the heads of Leviathan *
and gave him to the people of the desert for food.
verses.text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan * and gave him to the people of the desert for food.

lines: You split open spring and torrent; *
you dried up ever-flowing rivers.
verses.text: You split open spring and torrent; * you dried up ever-flowing rivers.

lines: Yours is the day, yours also the night; *
you established the moon and the sun.
verses.text: Yours is the day, yours also the night; * you established the moon and the sun.

lines: You fixed all the boundaries of the earth; *
you made both summer and winter.
verses.text: You fixed all the boundaries of the earth; * you made both summer and winter.

lines: Remember, O LORD, how the enemy scoffed, *
how a foolish people despised your Name.
verses.text: Remember, O LORD, how the enemy scoffed, * how a foolish people despised your Name.

lines: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; *
never forget the lives of your poor.
verses.text: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; * never forget the lives of your poor.
