lines: Look upon your covenant; *
the dark places of the earth are haunts of violence.
verses.text: Look upon your covenant; * the dark places of the earth are haunts of violence.

lines: Let not the oppressed turn away ashamed; *
let the poor and needy praise your Name.
verses.text: Let not the oppressed turn away ashamed; * let the poor and needy praise your Name.

lines: Arise, O God, maintain your cause; *
remember how fools revile you all day long.
verses.text: Arise, O God, maintain your cause; * remember how fools revile you all day long.

lines: Forget not the clamor of your adversaries, *
the unending tumult of those who rise up against you.
verses.text: Forget not the clamor of your adversaries, * the unending tumult of those who rise up against you.

lines: We give you thanks, O God, we give you thanks, *
calling upon your Name and declaring all your
wonderful deeds.
verses.text: We give you thanks, O God, we give you thanks, * calling upon your Name and declaring all your wonderful deeds.

lines: "I will appoint a time," says God; *
"I will judge with equity.
verses.text: "I will appoint a time," says God; * "I will judge with equity.

lines: Though the earth and all its inhabitants are quaking, *
I will make its pillars fast.
verses.text: Though the earth and all its inhabitants are quaking, * I will make its pillars fast.

lines: I will say to the boasters, 'Boast no more,' *
and to the wicked, 'Do not toss your horns;
verses.text: I will say to the boasters, 'Boast no more,' * and to the wicked, 'Do not toss your horns;

lines: Do not toss your horns so high, *
nor speak with a proud neck.'"
verses.text: Do not toss your horns so high, * nor speak with a proud neck.'"

lines: For judgment is neither from the east nor from the west, *
nor yet from the wilderness or the mountains.
verses.text: For judgment is neither from the east nor from the west, * nor yet from the wilderness or the mountains.

lines: It is God who judges; *
he puts down one and lifts up another.
verses.text: It is God who judges; * he puts down one and lifts up another.

lines: For in the LORD'S hand there is a cup,
full of spiced and foaming wine, which he pours out, *
and all the wicked of the earth shall drink and
drain the dregs.
verses.text: For in the LORD'S hand there is a cup, full of spiced and foaming wine, which he pours out, * and all the wicked of the earth shall drink and drain the dregs.

lines: But I will rejoice for ever; *
I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.text: But I will rejoice for ever; * I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

lines: He shall break off all the horns of the wicked; *
but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.text: He shall break off all the horns of the wicked; * but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

lines: In Judah is God known; *
his Name is great in Israel.
verses.text: In Judah is God known; * his Name is great in Israel.

lines: At Salem is his tabernacle, *
and his dwelling is in Zion.
verses.text: At Salem is his tabernacle, * and his dwelling is in Zion.

lines: There he broke the flashing arrows, *
the shield, the sword, and the weapons of battle.
verses.text: There he broke the flashing arrows, * the shield, the sword, and the weapons of battle.

lines: How glorious you are! *
more splendid than the everlasting mountains!
verses.text: How glorious you are! * more splendid than the everlasting mountains!

lines: The strong of heart have been despoiled;
they sink into sleep; *
none of the warriors can lift a hand.
verses.text: The strong of heart have been despoiled; they sink into sleep; * none of the warriors can lift a hand.

lines: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, *
both horse and rider lie stunned.
verses.text: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, * both horse and rider lie stunned.

lines: What terror you inspire! *
who can stand before you when you are angry?
verses.text: What terror you inspire! * who can stand before you when you are angry?

lines: From heaven you pronounced judgment; *
the earth was afraid and was still;
verses.text: From heaven you pronounced judgment; * the earth was afraid and was still;

lines: When God rose up to judgment *
and to save all the oppressed of the earth.
verses.text: When God rose up to judgment * and to save all the oppressed of the earth.

lines: Truly, wrathful Edom will give you thanks, *
and the remnant of Hamath will keep your feasts.
verses.text: Truly, wrathful Edom will give you thanks, * and the remnant of Hamath will keep your feasts.

lines: Make a vow to the LORD your God and keep it; *
let all around him bring gifts to him who is worthy
to be feared.
verses.text: Make a vow to the LORD your God and keep it; * let all around him bring gifts to him who is worthy to be feared.

lines: He breaks the spirit of princes, *
and strikes terror in the kings of the earth.
verses.text: He breaks the spirit of princes, * and strikes terror in the kings of the earth.

lines: I will cry aloud to God; *
I will cry aloud, and he will hear me.
verses.text: I will cry aloud to God; * I will cry aloud, and he will hear me.

lines: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; *
my hands were stretched out by night and did not tire;
I refused to be comforted.
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; * my hands were stretched out by night and did not tire; I refused to be comforted.

lines: I think of God, I am restless, *
I ponder, and my spirit faints.
verses.text: I think of God, I am restless, * I ponder, and my spirit faints.

lines: You will not let my eyelids close; *
I am troubled and I cannot speak.
verses.text: You will not let my eyelids close; * I am troubled and I cannot speak.

lines: I consider the days of old; *
I remember the years long past;
verses.text: I consider the days of old; * I remember the years long past;

lines: I commune with my heart in the night; *
I ponder and search my mind.
verses.text: I commune with my heart in the night; * I ponder and search my mind.

lines: Will the Lord cast me off for ever? *
will he no more show his favor?
verses.text: Will the Lord cast me off for ever? * will he no more show his favor?

lines: Has his loving-kindness come to an end for ever? *
has his promise failed for evermore?
verses.text: Has his loving-kindness come to an end for ever? * has his promise failed for evermore?

lines: Has God forgotten to be gracious? *
has he, in his anger, withheld his compassion?
verses.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? * has he, in his anger, withheld his compassion?

lines: And I said, "My grief is this: *
the right hand of the Most High has lost its power."
verses.text: And I said, "My grief is this: * the right hand of the Most High has lost its power."

lines: I will remember the works of the LORD, *
and call to mind your wonders of old time.
verses.text: I will remember the works of the LORD, * and call to mind your wonders of old time.

lines: I will meditate on all your acts *
and ponder your mighty deeds.
verses.text: I will meditate on all your acts * and ponder your mighty deeds.

lines: Your way, O God, is holy; *
who is so great a god as our God?
verses.text: Your way, O God, is holy; * who is so great a god as our God?

lines: You are the God who works wonders *
and have declared your power among the peoples.
verses.text: You are the God who works wonders * and have declared your power among the peoples.

lines: By your strength you have redeemed your people, *
the children of Jacob and Joseph.
verses.text: By your strength you have redeemed your people, * the children of Jacob and Joseph.

lines: The waters saw you, O God;
the waters saw you and trembled; *
the very depths were shaken.
verses.text: The waters saw you, O God; the waters saw you and trembled; * the very depths were shaken.

lines: The clouds poured out water;
the skies thundered; *
your arrows flashed to and fro;
verses.text: The clouds poured out water; the skies thundered; * your arrows flashed to and fro;

lines: The sound of your thunder was in the whirlwind;
your lightnings lit up the world; *
the earth trembled and shook.
verses.text: The sound of your thunder was in the whirlwind; your lightnings lit up the world; * the earth trembled and shook.

lines: Your way was in the sea,
and your paths in the great waters, *
yet your footsteps were not seen.
verses.text: Your way was in the sea, and your paths in the great waters, * yet your footsteps were not seen.

lines: You led your people like a flock *
by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.text: You led your people like a flock * by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

lines: Hear my teaching, O my people; *
incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Hear my teaching, O my people; * incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

lines: I will open my mouth in a parable; *
I will declare the mysteries of ancient times.
verses.text: I will open my mouth in a parable; * I will declare the mysteries of ancient times.

lines: That which we have heard and known,
and what our forefathers have told us, *
we will not hide from their children.
verses.text: That which we have heard and known, and what our forefathers have told us, * we will not hide from their children.

lines: We will recount to generations to come
the praiseworthy deeds and the power of the LORD, *
and the wonderful works he has done.
verses.text: We will recount to generations to come the praiseworthy deeds and the power of the LORD, * and the wonderful works he has done.

lines: He gave his decrees to Jacob
and established a law for Israel, *
which he commanded them to teach their children;
verses.text: He gave his decrees to Jacob and established a law for Israel, * which he commanded them to teach their children;

lines: That the generations to come might know,
and the children yet unborn; *
that they in their turn might tell it to their children;
verses.text: That the generations to come might know, and the children yet unborn; * that they in their turn might tell it to their children;

lines: So that they might put their trust in God, *
and not forget the deeds of God,
but keep his commandments;
verses.text: So that they might put their trust in God, * and not forget the deeds of God, but keep his commandments;

lines: And not be like their forefathers,
a stubborn and rebellious generation, *
a generation whose heart was not steadfast,
and whose spirit was not faithful to God.
verses.text: And not be like their forefathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, * a generation whose heart was not steadfast, and whose spirit was not faithful to God.

lines: The people of Ephraim, armed with the bow, *
turned back in the day of battle;
verses.text: The people of Ephraim, armed with the bow, * turned back in the day of battle;

lines: They did not keep the covenant of God, *
and refused to walk in his law;
verses.text: They did not keep the covenant of God, * and refused to walk in his law;

lines: They forgot what he had done, *
and the wonders he had shown them.
verses.text: They forgot what he had done, * and the wonders he had shown them.

lines: He worked marvels in the sight of their forefathers, *
in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.text: He worked marvels in the sight of their forefathers, * in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

lines: He split open the sea and let them pass through; *
he made the waters stand up like walls.
verses.text: He split open the sea and let them pass through; * he made the waters stand up like walls.

lines: He led them with a cloud by day, *
and all the night through with a glow of fire.
verses.text: He led them with a cloud by day, * and all the night through with a glow of fire.

lines: He split the hard rocks in the wilderness *
and gave them drink as from the great deep.
verses.text: He split the hard rocks in the wilderness * and gave them drink as from the great deep.

lines: He brought streams out of the cliff, *
and the waters gushed out like rivers.
verses.text: He brought streams out of the cliff, * and the waters gushed out like rivers.

lines: But they went on sinning against him, *
rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
verses.text: But they went on sinning against him, * rebelling in the desert against the Most High.

lines: They tested God in their hearts, *
demanding food for their craving.
verses.text: They tested God in their hearts, * demanding food for their craving.

lines: They railed against God and said, *
"Can God set a table in the wilderness?
verses.text: They railed against God and said, * "Can God set a table in the wilderness?

lines: True, he struck the rock, the waters gushed out, and the
gullies overflowed; *
but is he able to give bread
or to provide meat for his people?"
verses.text: True, he struck the rock, the waters gushed out, and the gullies overflowed; * but is he able to give bread or to provide meat for his people?"

lines: When the LORD heard this, he was full of wrath; *
a fire was kindled against Jacob,
and his anger mounted against Israel;
verses.text: When the LORD heard this, he was full of wrath; * a fire was kindled against Jacob, and his anger mounted against Israel;

lines: For they had no faith in God, *
nor did they put their trust in his saving power.
verses.text: For they had no faith in God, * nor did they put their trust in his saving power.

lines: So he commanded the clouds above *
and opened the doors of heaven.
verses.text: So he commanded the clouds above * and opened the doors of heaven.

lines: He rained down manna upon them to eat *
and gave them grain from heaven.
verses.text: He rained down manna upon them to eat * and gave them grain from heaven.

lines: So mortals ate the bread of angels; *
he provided for them food enough.
verses.text: So mortals ate the bread of angels; * he provided for them food enough.

lines: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens *
and led out the south wind by his might.
verses.text: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens * and led out the south wind by his might.

lines: He rained down flesh upon them like dust *
and wingèd birds like the sand of the sea.
verses.text: He rained down flesh upon them like dust * and wingèd birds like the sand of the sea.

lines: He let it fall in the midst of their camp *
and round about their dwellings.
verses.text: He let it fall in the midst of their camp * and round about their dwellings.

lines: So they ate and were well filled, *
for he gave them what they craved.
verses.text: So they ate and were well filled, * for he gave them what they craved.

lines: But they did not stop their craving, *
though the food was still in their mouths.
verses.text: But they did not stop their craving, * though the food was still in their mouths.

lines: So God's anger mounted against them; *
he slew their strongest men
and laid low the youth of Israel.
verses.text: So God's anger mounted against them; * he slew their strongest men and laid low the youth of Israel.

lines: In spite of all this, they went on sinning *
and had no faith in his wonderful works.
verses.text: In spite of all this, they went on sinning * and had no faith in his wonderful works.

lines: So he brought their days to an end like a breath *
and their years in sudden terror.
verses.text: So he brought their days to an end like a breath * and their years in sudden terror.

lines: Whenever he slew them, they would seek him, *
and repent, and diligently search for God.
verses.text: Whenever he slew them, they would seek him, * and repent, and diligently search for God.

lines: They would remember that God was their rock, *
and the Most High God their redeemer.
verses.text: They would remember that God was their rock, * and the Most High God their redeemer.

lines: But they flattered him with their mouths *
and lied to him with their tongues.
verses.text: But they flattered him with their mouths * and lied to him with their tongues.

lines: Their heart was not steadfast toward him, *
and they were not faithful to his covenant.
verses.text: Their heart was not steadfast toward him, * and they were not faithful to his covenant.

lines: But he was so merciful that he forgave their sins
and did not destroy them; *
many times he held back his anger
and did not permit his wrath to be roused.
verses.text: But he was so merciful that he forgave their sins and did not destroy them; * many times he held back his anger and did not permit his wrath to be roused.

lines: For he remembered that they were but flesh, *
a breath that goes forth and does not return.
verses.text: For he remembered that they were but flesh, * a breath that goes forth and does not return.

lines: How often the people disobeyed him in the wilderness *
and offended him in the desert!
verses.text: How often the people disobeyed him in the wilderness * and offended him in the desert!

lines: Again and again they tempted God *
and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text: Again and again they tempted God * and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

lines: They did not remember his power *
in the day when he ransomed them from the enemy;
verses.text: They did not remember his power * in the day when he ransomed them from the enemy;

lines: How he wrought his signs in Egypt *
and his omens in the field of Zoan.
verses.text: How he wrought his signs in Egypt * and his omens in the field of Zoan.

lines: He turned their rivers into blood, *
so that they could not drink of their streams.
verses.text: He turned their rivers into blood, * so that they could not drink of their streams.

lines: He sent swarms of flies among them, which ate them up, *
and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.text: He sent swarms of flies among them, which ate them up, * and frogs, which destroyed them.

lines: He gave their crops to the caterpillar, *
the fruit of their toil to the locust.
verses.text: He gave their crops to the caterpillar, * the fruit of their toil to the locust.

lines: He killed their vines with hail *
and their sycamores with frost.
verses.text: He killed their vines with hail * and their sycamores with frost.

lines: He delivered their cattle to hailstones *
and their livestock to hot thunderbolts.
verses.text: He delivered their cattle to hailstones * and their livestock to hot thunderbolts.

lines: He poured out upon them his blazing anger: *
fury, indignation, and distress,
a troop of destroying angels.
verses.text: He poured out upon them his blazing anger: * fury, indignation, and distress, a troop of destroying angels.

lines: He gave full rein to his anger;
he did not spare their souls from death; *
but delivered their lives to the plague.
verses.text: He gave full rein to his anger; he did not spare their souls from death; * but delivered their lives to the plague.

lines: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, *
the flower of manhood in the dwellings of Ham.
verses.text: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, * the flower of manhood in the dwellings of Ham.

lines: He led out his people like sheep *
and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.text: He led out his people like sheep * and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

lines: He led them to safety, and they were not afraid; *
but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.text: He led them to safety, and they were not afraid; * but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

lines: He brought them to his holy land, *
the mountain his right hand had won.
verses.text: He brought them to his holy land, * the mountain his right hand had won.

lines: He drove out the Canaanites before them
and apportioned an inheritance to them by lot; *
he made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.text: He drove out the Canaanites before them and apportioned an inheritance to them by lot; * he made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

lines: But they tested the Most High God, and defied him, *
and did not keep his commandments.
verses.text: But they tested the Most High God, and defied him, * and did not keep his commandments.

lines: They turned away and were disloyal like their fathers; *
they were undependable like a warped bow.
verses.text: They turned away and were disloyal like their fathers; * they were undependable like a warped bow.

lines: They grieved him with their hill-altars *
they provoked his displeasure with their idols.
verses.text: They grieved him with their hill-altars * they provoked his displeasure with their idols.

lines: When God heard this, he was angry *
and utterly rejected Israel.
verses.text: When God heard this, he was angry * and utterly rejected Israel.

lines: He forsook the shrine at Shiloh, *
the tabernacle where he had lived among his people.
verses.text: He forsook the shrine at Shiloh, * the tabernacle where he had lived among his people.

lines: He delivered the ark into captivity, *
his glory into the adversary's hand.
verses.text: He delivered the ark into captivity, * his glory into the adversary's hand.

lines: He gave his people to the sword *
and was angered against his inheritance.
verses.text: He gave his people to the sword * and was angered against his inheritance.

lines: The fire consumed their young men; *
there were no wedding songs for their maidens.
verses.text: The fire consumed their young men; * there were no wedding songs for their maidens.

lines: Their priests fell by the sword, *
and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.text: Their priests fell by the sword, * and their widows made no lamentation.

lines: Then the LORD woke as though from sleep, *
like a warrior refreshed with wine.
verses.text: Then the LORD woke as though from sleep, * like a warrior refreshed with wine.

lines: He struck his enemies on the backside *
and put them to perpetual shame.
verses.text: He struck his enemies on the backside * and put them to perpetual shame.

lines: He rejected the tent of Joseph *
and did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;
verses.text: He rejected the tent of Joseph * and did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

lines: He chose instead the tribe of Judah *
and Mount Zion, which he loved.
verses.text: He chose instead the tribe of Judah * and Mount Zion, which he loved.

lines: He built his sanctuary like the heights of heaven, *
like the earth which he founded for ever.
verses.text: He built his sanctuary like the heights of heaven, * like the earth which he founded for ever.

lines: He chose David his servant, *
and took him away from the sheepfolds.
verses.text: He chose David his servant, * and took him away from the sheepfolds.

lines: He brought him from following the ewes, *
to be a shepherd over Jacob his people
and over Israel his inheritance.
verses.text: He brought him from following the ewes, * to be a shepherd over Jacob his people and over Israel his inheritance.

lines: So he shepherded them with a faithful and true heart *
and guided them with the skillfulness of his hands.
verses.text: So he shepherded them with a faithful and true heart * and guided them with the skillfulness of his hands.

lines: O God, the heathen have come into your inheritance;
they have profaned your holy temple; *
they have made Jerusalem a heap of rubble.
verses.text: O God, the heathen have come into your inheritance; they have profaned your holy temple; * they have made Jerusalem a heap of rubble.

lines: They have given the bodies of your servants as food for the
birds of the air, *
and the flesh of your faithful ones to the beasts
of the field.
verses.text: They have given the bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the air, * and the flesh of your faithful ones to the beasts of the field.

lines: They have shed their blood like water on every side
of Jerusalem, *
and there was no one to bury them.
verses.text: They have shed their blood like water on every side of Jerusalem, * and there was no one to bury them.

lines: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, *
an object of scorn and derision to those around us.
verses.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, * an object of scorn and derision to those around us.

lines: How long will you be angry, O LORD? *
will your fury blaze like fire for ever?
verses.text: How long will you be angry, O LORD? * will your fury blaze like fire for ever?

lines: Pour out your wrath upon the heathen who have not
known you *
and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon
your Name.
verses.text: Pour out your wrath upon the heathen who have not known you * and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon your Name.

lines: For they have devoured Jacob *
and made his dwelling a ruin.
verses.text: For they have devoured Jacob * and made his dwelling a ruin.

lines: Remember not our past sins;
let your compassion be swift to meet us; *
for we have been brought very low.
verses.text: Remember not our past sins; let your compassion be swift to meet us; * for we have been brought very low.

lines: Help us, O God our Savior, for the glory of your Name; *
deliver us and forgive us our sins, for your Name's sake.
verses.text: Help us, O God our Savior, for the glory of your Name; * deliver us and forgive us our sins, for your Name's sake.

lines: Why should the heathen say, "Where is their God?" *
Let it be known among the heathen and in our sight
that you avenge the shedding of your servants' blood.
verses.text: Why should the heathen say, "Where is their God?" * Let it be known among the heathen and in our sight that you avenge the shedding of your servants' blood.

lines: Let the sorrowful sighing of the prisoners come before you, *
and by your great might spare those who are
condemned to die.
verses.text: Let the sorrowful sighing of the prisoners come before you, * and by your great might spare those who are condemned to die.

lines: May the revilings with which they reviled you, O Lord, *
return seven-fold into their bosoms.
verses.text: May the revilings with which they reviled you, O Lord, * return seven-fold into their bosoms.

lines: For we are your people and the sheep of your pasture; *
we will give you thanks for ever
and show forth your praise from age to age.
verses.text: For we are your people and the sheep of your pasture; * we will give you thanks for ever and show forth your praise from age to age.

lines: Hear, O Shepherd of Israel, leading Joseph like a flock; *
shine forth, you that are enthroned upon the cherubim.
verses.text: Hear, O Shepherd of Israel, leading Joseph like a flock; * shine forth, you that are enthroned upon the cherubim.

lines: In the presence of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, *
stir up your strength and come to help us.
verses.text: In the presence of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, * stir up your strength and come to help us.

lines: Restore us, O God of hosts; *
show the light of your countenance, and we shall be saved.
verses.text: Restore us, O God of hosts; * show the light of your countenance, and we shall be saved.

lines: O LORD God of hosts, *
how long will you be angered
despite the prayers of your people?
verses.text: O LORD God of hosts, * how long will you be angered despite the prayers of your people?

lines: You have fed them with the bread of tears; *
you have given them bowls of tears to drink.
verses.text: You have fed them with the bread of tears; * you have given them bowls of tears to drink.

lines: You have made us the derision of our neighbors, *
and our enemies laugh us to scorn.
verses.text: You have made us the derision of our neighbors, * and our enemies laugh us to scorn.

lines: Restore us, O God of hosts; *
show the light of your countenance, and we shall be saved.
verses.text: Restore us, O God of hosts; * show the light of your countenance, and we shall be saved.

lines: You have brought a vine out of Egypt; *
you cast out the nations and planted it.
verses.text: You have brought a vine out of Egypt; * you cast out the nations and planted it.

lines: You prepared the ground for it; *
it took root and filled the land.
verses.text: You prepared the ground for it; * it took root and filled the land.

lines: The mountains were covered by its shadow *
and the towering cedar trees by its boughs.
verses.text: The mountains were covered by its shadow * and the towering cedar trees by its boughs.

lines: You stretched out its tendrils to the Sea *
and its branches to the River.
verses.text: You stretched out its tendrils to the Sea * and its branches to the River.

lines: Why have you broken down its wall, *
so that all who pass by pluck off its grapes?
verses.text: Why have you broken down its wall, * so that all who pass by pluck off its grapes?

lines: The wild boar of the forest has ravaged it, *
and the beasts of the field have grazed upon it.
verses.text: The wild boar of the forest has ravaged it, * and the beasts of the field have grazed upon it.

lines: Turn now, O God of hosts, look down from heaven;
behold and tend this vine; *
preserve what your right hand has planted.
verses.text: Turn now, O God of hosts, look down from heaven; behold and tend this vine; * preserve what your right hand has planted.

lines: They burn it with fire like rubbish; *
at the rebuke of your countenance let them perish.
verses.text: They burn it with fire like rubbish; * at the rebuke of your countenance let them perish.

lines: Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand, *
the son of man you have made so strong for yourself.
verses.text: Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand, * the son of man you have made so strong for yourself.

lines: And so will we never turn away from you; *
give us life, that we may call upon your Name.
verses.text: And so will we never turn away from you; * give us life, that we may call upon your Name.

lines: Restore us, O LORD God of hosts; *
show the light of your countenance, and we shall be saved.
verses.text: Restore us, O LORD God of hosts; * show the light of your countenance, and we shall be saved.

lines: Sing with joy to God our strength *
and raise a loud shout to the God of Jacob.
verses.text: Sing with joy to God our strength * and raise a loud shout to the God of Jacob.

lines: Raise a song and sound the timbrel, *
the merry harp, and the lyre.
verses.text: Raise a song and sound the timbrel, * the merry harp, and the lyre.

lines: Blow the ram's-horn at the new moon, *
and at the full moon, the day of our feast.
verses.text: Blow the ram's-horn at the new moon, * and at the full moon, the day of our feast.

lines: For this is a statute for Israel, *
a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.text: For this is a statute for Israel, * a law of the God of Jacob.

lines: He laid it as a solemn charge upon Joseph, *
when he came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: He laid it as a solemn charge upon Joseph, * when he came out of the land of Egypt.

lines: I heard an unfamiliar voice saying, *
"I eased his shoulder from the burden;
his hands were set free from bearing the load."
verses.text: I heard an unfamiliar voice saying, * "I eased his shoulder from the burden; his hands were set free from bearing the load."

lines: You called on me in trouble, and I saved you; *
I answered you from the secret place of thunder
and tested you at the waters of Meribah.
verses.text: You called on me in trouble, and I saved you; * I answered you from the secret place of thunder and tested you at the waters of Meribah.

lines: Hear, O my people, and I will admonish you: *
O Israel, if you would but listen to me!
verses.text: Hear, O my people, and I will admonish you: * O Israel, if you would but listen to me!

lines: There shall be no strange god among you; *
you shall not worship a foreign god.
verses.text: There shall be no strange god among you; * you shall not worship a foreign god.

lines: I am the LORD your God,
who brought you out of the land of Egypt and said, *
"Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it."
verses.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and said, * "Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it."

lines: And yet my people did not hear my voice, *
and Israel would not obey me.
verses.text: And yet my people did not hear my voice, * and Israel would not obey me.

lines: So I gave them over to the stubbornness of their hearts, *
to follow their own devices.
verses.text: So I gave them over to the stubbornness of their hearts, * to follow their own devices.

lines: Oh, that my people would listen to me! *
that Israel would walk in my ways!
verses.text: Oh, that my people would listen to me! * that Israel would walk in my ways!

lines: I should soon subdue their enemies *
and turn my hand against their foes.
verses.text: I should soon subdue their enemies * and turn my hand against their foes.

lines: Those who hate the LORD would cringe before him, *
and their punishment would last for ever.
verses.text: Those who hate the LORD would cringe before him, * and their punishment would last for ever.

lines: But Israel would I feed with the finest wheat *
and satisfy him with honey from the rock.
verses.text: But Israel would I feed with the finest wheat * and satisfy him with honey from the rock.

lines: God takes his stand in the council of heaven; *
he gives judgment in the midst of the gods:
verses.text: God takes his stand in the council of heaven; * he gives judgment in the midst of the gods:

lines: "How long will you judge unjustly, *
and show favor to the wicked?
verses.text: "How long will you judge unjustly, * and show favor to the wicked?

lines: Save the weak and the orphan; *
defend the humble and needy;
verses.text: Save the weak and the orphan; * defend the humble and needy;

lines: Rescue the weak and the poor; *
deliver them from the power of the wicked.
verses.text: Rescue the weak and the poor; * deliver them from the power of the wicked.

lines: They do not know, neither do they understand;
they go about in darkness; *
all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.text: They do not know, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; * all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

lines: Now I say to you, 'You are gods, *
and all of you children of the Most High;
verses.text: Now I say to you, 'You are gods, * and all of you children of the Most High;

lines: Nevertheless, you shall die like mortals, *
and fall like any prince.'"
verses.text: Nevertheless, you shall die like mortals, * and fall like any prince.'"

lines: Arise, O God, and rule the earth, *
for you shall take all nations for your own.
verses.text: Arise, O God, and rule the earth, * for you shall take all nations for your own.

lines: O God, do not be silent; *
do not keep still nor hold your peace, O God;
verses.text: O God, do not be silent; * do not keep still nor hold your peace, O God;

lines: For your enemies are in tumult, *
and those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
verses.text: For your enemies are in tumult, * and those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

lines: They take secret counsel against your people *
and plot against those whom you protect.
verses.text: They take secret counsel against your people * and plot against those whom you protect.

lines: They have said, "Come, let us wipe them out from among
the nations; *
let the name of Israel be remembered no more."
verses.text: They have said, "Come, let us wipe them out from among the nations; * let the name of Israel be remembered no more."

lines: They have conspired together; *
they have made an alliance against you:
verses.text: They have conspired together; * they have made an alliance against you:

lines: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; *
the Moabites and the Hagarenes;
verses.text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; * the Moabites and the Hagarenes;

lines: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; *
the Philistines and those who dwell in Tyre.
verses.text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; * the Philistines and those who dwell in Tyre.

lines: The Assyrians also have joined them, *
and have come to help the people of Lot.
verses.text: The Assyrians also have joined them, * and have come to help the people of Lot.

lines: Do to them as you did to Midian, *
to Sisera, and to Jabin at the river of Kishon:
verses.text: Do to them as you did to Midian, * to Sisera, and to Jabin at the river of Kishon:

lines: They were destroyed at Endor; *
they became like dung upon the ground.
verses.text: They were destroyed at Endor; * they became like dung upon the ground.

lines: Make their leaders like Oreb and Zeëb, *
and all their commanders like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.text: Make their leaders like Oreb and Zeëb, * and all their commanders like Zebah and Zalmunna,

lines: Who said, "Let us take for ourselves *
the fields of God as our possession."
verses.text: Who said, "Let us take for ourselves * the fields of God as our possession."

lines: O my God, make them like whirling dust *
and like chaff before the wind;
verses.text: O my God, make them like whirling dust * and like chaff before the wind;

lines: Like fire that burns down a forest, *
like the flame that sets mountains ablaze.
verses.text: Like fire that burns down a forest, * like the flame that sets mountains ablaze.

lines: Drive them with your tempest *
and terrify them with your storm;
verses.text: Drive them with your tempest * and terrify them with your storm;

lines: Cover their faces with shame, O LORD, *
that they may seek your Name.
verses.text: Cover their faces with shame, O LORD, * that they may seek your Name.

lines: Let them be disgraced and terrified for ever; *
let them be put to confusion and perish.
verses.text: Let them be disgraced and terrified for ever; * let them be put to confusion and perish.

lines: Let them know that you, whose Name is YAHWEH, *
you alone are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.text: Let them know that you, whose Name is YAHWEH, * you alone are the Most High over all the earth.

lines: How dear to me is your dwelling, O LORD of hosts! *
My soul has a desire and longing for the courts of
the LORD;
my heart and my flesh rejoice in the living God.
verses.text: How dear to me is your dwelling, O LORD of hosts! * My soul has a desire and longing for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh rejoice in the living God.

lines: The sparrow has found her a house
and the swallow a nest where she may lay her young; *
by the side of your altars, O LORD of hosts,
my King and my God.
verses.text: The sparrow has found her a house and the swallow a nest where she may lay her young; * by the side of your altars, O LORD of hosts, my King and my God.

lines: Happy are they who dwell in your house! *
they will always be praising you.
verses.text: Happy are they who dwell in your house! * they will always be praising you.

lines: Happy are the people whose strength is in you! *
whose hearts are set on the pilgrims' way.
verses.text: Happy are the people whose strength is in you! * whose hearts are set on the pilgrims' way.

lines: Those who go through the desolate valley will find
it a place of springs, *
for the early rains have covered it with pools of water.
verses.text: Those who go through the desolate valley will find it a place of springs, * for the early rains have covered it with pools of water.

lines: They will climb from height to height, *
and the God of gods will reveal himself in Zion.
verses.text: They will climb from height to height, * and the God of gods will reveal himself in Zion.

lines: LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; *
hearken, O God of Jacob.
verses.text: LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; * hearken, O God of Jacob.

lines: Behold our defender, O God; *
and look upon the face of your Anointed.
verses.text: Behold our defender, O God; * and look upon the face of your Anointed.

lines: For one day in your courts is better than
a thousand in my own room, *
and to stand at the threshold of the house of my God
than to dwell in the tents of the wicked.
verses.text: For one day in your courts is better than a thousand in my own room, * and to stand at the threshold of the house of my God than to dwell in the tents of the wicked.

lines: For the LORD God is both sun and shield; *
he will give grace and glory;
verses.text: For the LORD God is both sun and shield; * he will give grace and glory;

lines: No good thing will the LORD withhold *
from those who walk with integrity.
verses.text: No good thing will the LORD withhold * from those who walk with integrity.

lines: O LORD of hosts, *
happy are they who put their trust in you!
verses.text: O LORD of hosts, * happy are they who put their trust in you!

lines: You have been gracious to your land, O LORD, *
you have restored the good fortune of Jacob.
verses.text: You have been gracious to your land, O LORD, * you have restored the good fortune of Jacob.

lines: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people *
and blotted out all their sins.
verses.text: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people * and blotted out all their sins.

lines: You have withdrawn all your fury *
and turned yourself from your wrathful indignation.
verses.text: You have withdrawn all your fury * and turned yourself from your wrathful indignation.

lines: Restore us then, O God our Savior; *
let your anger depart from us.
verses.text: Restore us then, O God our Savior; * let your anger depart from us.

lines: Will you be displeased with us for ever? *
will you prolong your anger from age to age?
verses.text: Will you be displeased with us for ever? * will you prolong your anger from age to age?

lines: Will you not give us life again, *
that your people may rejoice in you?
verses.text: Will you not give us life again, * that your people may rejoice in you?

lines: Show us your mercy, O LORD, *
and grant us your salvation.
verses.text: Show us your mercy, O LORD, * and grant us your salvation.

lines: I will listen to what the LORD God is saying, *
for he is speaking peace to his faithful people
and to those who turn their hearts to him.
verses.text: I will listen to what the LORD God is saying, * for he is speaking peace to his faithful people and to those who turn their hearts to him.

lines: Truly, his salvation is very near to those who fear him, *
that his glory may dwell in our land.
verses.text: Truly, his salvation is very near to those who fear him, * that his glory may dwell in our land.

lines: Mercy and truth have met together; *
righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.text: Mercy and truth have met together; * righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

lines: Truth shall spring up from the earth, *
and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.text: Truth shall spring up from the earth, * and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

lines: The LORD will indeed grant prosperity, *
and our land will yield its increase.
verses.text: The LORD will indeed grant prosperity, * and our land will yield its increase.

lines: Righteousness shall go before him, *
and peace shall be a pathway for his feet.
verses.text: Righteousness shall go before him, * and peace shall be a pathway for his feet.

lines: Bow down your ear, O LORD, and answer me, *
for I am poor and in misery.
verses.text: Bow down your ear, O LORD, and answer me, * for I am poor and in misery.

lines: Keep watch over my life, for I am faithful; *
save your servant who puts his trust in you.
verses.text: Keep watch over my life, for I am faithful; * save your servant who puts his trust in you.

lines: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for you are my God; *
I call upon you all the day long.
verses.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for you are my God; * I call upon you all the day long.

lines: Gladden the soul of your servant, *
for to you, O LORD, I lift up my soul.
verses.text: Gladden the soul of your servant, * for to you, O LORD, I lift up my soul.

lines: For you, O LORD, are good and forgiving, *
and great is your love toward all who call upon you.
verses.text: For you, O LORD, are good and forgiving, * and great is your love toward all who call upon you.

lines: Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer, *
and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.text: Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer, * and attend to the voice of my supplications.

lines: In the time of my trouble I will call upon you, *
for you will answer me.
verses.text: In the time of my trouble I will call upon you, * for you will answer me.

lines: Among the gods there is none like you, O LORD, *
nor anything like your works.
verses.text: Among the gods there is none like you, O LORD, * nor anything like your works.

lines: All the nations you have made will come and
worship you, O LORD, *
and glorify your Name.
verses.text: All the nations you have made will come and worship you, O LORD, * and glorify your Name.

lines: For you are great;
you do wondrous things; *
and you alone are God.
verses.text: For you are great; you do wondrous things; * and you alone are God.

lines: Teach me your way, O LORD,
and I will walk in your truth; *
knit my heart to you that I may fear your Name.
verses.text: Teach me your way, O LORD, and I will walk in your truth; * knit my heart to you that I may fear your Name.

lines: I will thank you, O LORD my God, with all my heart, *
and glorify your Name for evermore.
verses.text: I will thank you, O LORD my God, with all my heart, * and glorify your Name for evermore.

lines: For great is your love toward me; *
you have delivered me from the nethermost Pit.
verses.text: For great is your love toward me; * you have delivered me from the nethermost Pit.

lines: The arrogant rise up against me, O God,
and a band of violent men seeks my life; *
they have not set you before their eyes.
verses.text: The arrogant rise up against me, O God, and a band of violent men seeks my life; * they have not set you before their eyes.

lines: But you, O LORD, are gracious and full of compassion, *
slow to anger, and full of kindness and truth.
verses.text: But you, O LORD, are gracious and full of compassion, * slow to anger, and full of kindness and truth.

lines: Turn to me and have mercy upon me; *
give your strength to your servant;
and save the child of your handmaid.
verses.text: Turn to me and have mercy upon me; * give your strength to your servant; and save the child of your handmaid.

lines: Show me a sign of your favor,
so that those who hate me may see it and be ashamed; *
because you, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
verses.text: Show me a sign of your favor, so that those who hate me may see it and be ashamed; * because you, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

lines: On the holy mountain stands the city he has founded; *
the LORD loves the gates of Zion
more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.text: On the holy mountain stands the city he has founded; * the LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

lines: Glorious things are spoken of you, *
O city of our God.
verses.text: Glorious things are spoken of you, * O city of our God.

lines: I count Egypt and Babylon among those who know me; *
behold Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia:
in Zion were they born.
verses.text: I count Egypt and Babylon among those who know me; * behold Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia: in Zion were they born.

lines: Of Zion it shall be said, "Everyone was born in her, *
and the Most High himself shall sustain her."
verses.text: Of Zion it shall be said, "Everyone was born in her, * and the Most High himself shall sustain her."

lines: The LORD will record as he enrolls the peoples, *
"These also were born there."
verses.text: The LORD will record as he enrolls the peoples, * "These also were born there."

lines: The singers and the dancers will say, *
"All my fresh springs are in you."
verses.text: The singers and the dancers will say, * "All my fresh springs are in you."

lines: O LORD, my God, my Savior, *
by day and night I cry to you.
verses.text: O LORD, my God, my Savior, * by day and night I cry to you.

lines: Let my prayer enter into your presence; *
incline your ear to my lamentation.
verses.text: Let my prayer enter into your presence; * incline your ear to my lamentation.

lines: For I am full of trouble; *
my life is at the brink of the grave.
verses.text: For I am full of trouble; * my life is at the brink of the grave.

lines: I am counted among those who go down to the Pit; *
I have become like one who has no strength;
verses.text: I am counted among those who go down to the Pit; * I have become like one who has no strength;

lines: Lost among the dead, *
like the slain who lie in the grave,
verses.text: Lost among the dead, * like the slain who lie in the grave,

lines: Whom you remember no more, *
for they are cut off from your hand.
verses.text: Whom you remember no more, * for they are cut off from your hand.

lines: You have laid me in the depths of the Pit, *
in dark places, and in the abyss.
verses.text: You have laid me in the depths of the Pit, * in dark places, and in the abyss.

lines: Your anger weighs upon me heavily, *
and all your great waves overwhelm me.
verses.text: Your anger weighs upon me heavily, * and all your great waves overwhelm me.

lines: You have put my friends far from me;
you have made me to be abhorred by them; *
I am in prison and cannot get free.
verses.text: You have put my friends far from me; you have made me to be abhorred by them; * I am in prison and cannot get free.

lines: My sight has failed me because of trouble; *
LORD, I have called upon you daily;
I have stretched out my hands to you.
verses.text: My sight has failed me because of trouble; * LORD, I have called upon you daily; I have stretched out my hands to you.

lines: Do you work wonders for the dead? *
will those who have died stand up and give you thanks?
verses.text: Do you work wonders for the dead? * will those who have died stand up and give you thanks?

lines: Will your loving-kindness be declared in the grave? *
your faithfulness in the land of destruction?
verses.text: Will your loving-kindness be declared in the grave? * your faithfulness in the land of destruction?

lines: Will your wonders be known in the dark? *
or your righteousness in the country where all
is forgotten?
verses.text: Will your wonders be known in the dark? * or your righteousness in the country where all is forgotten?

lines: But as for me, O LORD, I cry to you for help; *
in the morning my prayer comes before you.
verses.text: But as for me, O LORD, I cry to you for help; * in the morning my prayer comes before you.

lines: LORD, why have you rejected me? *
why have you hidden your face from me?
verses.text: LORD, why have you rejected me? * why have you hidden your face from me?

lines: Ever since my youth, I have been wretched and at the
point of death; *
I have borne your terrors with a troubled mind.
verses.text: Ever since my youth, I have been wretched and at the point of death; * I have borne your terrors with a troubled mind.

lines: Your blazing anger has swept over me; *
your terrors have destroyed me;
verses.text: Your blazing anger has swept over me; * your terrors have destroyed me;

lines: They surround me all day long like a flood; *
they encompass me on every side.
verses.text: They surround me all day long like a flood; * they encompass me on every side.

lines: My friend and my neighbor you have put away from me, *
and darkness is my only companion.
verses.text: My friend and my neighbor you have put away from me, * and darkness is my only companion.

lines: Your love, O LORD, for ever will I sing; *
from age to age my mouth will proclaim your faithfulness.
verses.text: Your love, O LORD, for ever will I sing; * from age to age my mouth will proclaim your faithfulness.

lines: For I am persuaded that your love is established for ever; *
you have set your faithfulness firmly in the heavens.
verses.text: For I am persuaded that your love is established for ever; * you have set your faithfulness firmly in the heavens.

lines: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one; *
I have sworn an oath to David my servant:
verses.text: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one; * I have sworn an oath to David my servant:

lines: 'I will establish your line for ever, *
and preserve your throne for all generations.'"
verses.text: 'I will establish your line for ever, * and preserve your throne for all generations.'"

lines: The heavens bear witness to your wonders, O LORD, *
and to your faithfulness in the assembly of the holy ones;
verses.text: The heavens bear witness to your wonders, O LORD, * and to your faithfulness in the assembly of the holy ones;

lines: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? *
who is like the LORD among the gods?
verses.text: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? * who is like the LORD among the gods?

lines: God is much to be feared in the council of the holy ones, *
great and terrible to all those round about him.
verses.text: God is much to be feared in the council of the holy ones, * great and terrible to all those round about him.

lines: Who is like you, LORD God of hosts? *
O mighty LORD, your faithfulness is all around you.
verses.text: Who is like you, LORD God of hosts? * O mighty LORD, your faithfulness is all around you.

lines: You rule the raging of the sea *
and still the surging of its waves.
verses.text: You rule the raging of the sea * and still the surging of its waves.

lines: You have crushed Rahab of the deep with a deadly wound; *
you have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
verses.text: You have crushed Rahab of the deep with a deadly wound; * you have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

lines: Yours are the heavens; the earth also is yours; *
you laid the foundations of the world and all that is in it.
verses.text: Yours are the heavens; the earth also is yours; * you laid the foundations of the world and all that is in it.

lines: You have made the north and the south; *
Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your Name.
verses.text: You have made the north and the south; * Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your Name.

lines: You have a mighty arm; *
strong is your hand and high is your right hand.
verses.text: You have a mighty arm; * strong is your hand and high is your right hand.

lines: Righteousness and justice are the foundations of your throne; *
love and truth go before your face.
verses.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundations of your throne; * love and truth go before your face.

lines: Happy are the people who know the festal shout! *
they walk, O LORD, in the light of your presence.
verses.text: Happy are the people who know the festal shout! * they walk, O LORD, in the light of your presence.

lines: They rejoice daily in your Name; *
they are jubilant in your righteousness.
verses.text: They rejoice daily in your Name; * they are jubilant in your righteousness.

lines: For you are the glory of their strength, *
and by your favor our might is exalted.
verses.text: For you are the glory of their strength, * and by your favor our might is exalted.

lines: Truly, the LORD is our ruler; *
The Holy One of Israel is our King.
verses.text: Truly, the LORD is our ruler; * The Holy One of Israel is our King.

lines: You spoke once in a vision and said to your faithful people: *
"I have set the crown upon a warrior
and have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.text: You spoke once in a vision and said to your faithful people: * "I have set the crown upon a warrior and have exalted one chosen out of the people.

lines: I have found David my servant; *
with my holy oil have I anointed him.
verses.text: I have found David my servant; * with my holy oil have I anointed him.

lines: My hand will hold him fast *
and my arm will make him strong.
verses.text: My hand will hold him fast * and my arm will make him strong.

lines: No enemy shall deceive him, *
nor any wicked man bring him down.
verses.text: No enemy shall deceive him, * nor any wicked man bring him down.

lines: I will crush his foes before him *
and strike down those who hate him.
verses.text: I will crush his foes before him * and strike down those who hate him.

lines: My faithfulness and love shall be with him, *
and he shall be victorious through my Name.
verses.text: My faithfulness and love shall be with him, * and he shall be victorious through my Name.

lines: I shall make his dominion extend *
from the Great Sea to the River.
verses.text: I shall make his dominion extend * from the Great Sea to the River.

lines: He will say to me, 'You are my Father, *
my God, and the rock of my salvation.'
verses.text: He will say to me, 'You are my Father, * my God, and the rock of my salvation.'

lines: I will make him my firstborn *
and higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.text: I will make him my firstborn * and higher than the kings of the earth.

lines: I will keep my love for him for ever, *
and my covenant will stand firm for him.
verses.text: I will keep my love for him for ever, * and my covenant will stand firm for him.

lines: I will establish his line for ever *
and his throne as the days of heaven."
verses.text: I will establish his line for ever * and his throne as the days of heaven."

lines: "If his children forsake my law *
and do not walk according to my judgments;
verses.text: "If his children forsake my law * and do not walk according to my judgments;

lines: If they break my statutes *
and do not keep my commandments;
verses.text: If they break my statutes * and do not keep my commandments;

lines: I will punish their transgressions with a rod *
and their iniquities with the lash;
verses.text: I will punish their transgressions with a rod * and their iniquities with the lash;

lines: But I will not take my love from him, *
nor let my faithfulness prove false.
verses.text: But I will not take my love from him, * nor let my faithfulness prove false.

lines: I will not break my covenant, *
nor change what has gone out of my lips.
verses.text: I will not break my covenant, * nor change what has gone out of my lips.

lines: Once for all I have sworn by my holiness: *
'I will not lie to David.
verses.text: Once for all I have sworn by my holiness: * 'I will not lie to David.

lines: His line shall endure for ever *
and his throne as the sun before me;
verses.text: His line shall endure for ever * and his throne as the sun before me;

lines: It shall stand fast for evermore like the moon, *
the abiding witness in the sky.'"
verses.text: It shall stand fast for evermore like the moon, * the abiding witness in the sky.'"

lines: But you have cast off and rejected your anointed; *
you have become enraged at him.
verses.text: But you have cast off and rejected your anointed; * you have become enraged at him.

lines: You have broken your covenant with your servant, *
defiled his crown, and hurled it to the ground.
verses.text: You have broken your covenant with your servant, * defiled his crown, and hurled it to the ground.

lines: You have breached all his walls *
and laid his strongholds in ruins.
verses.text: You have breached all his walls * and laid his strongholds in ruins.

lines: All who pass by despoil him; *
he has become the scorn of his neighbors.
verses.text: All who pass by despoil him; * he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

lines: You have exalted the right hand of his foes *
and made all his enemies rejoice.
verses.text: You have exalted the right hand of his foes * and made all his enemies rejoice.

lines: You have turned back the edge of his sword *
and have not sustained him in battle.
verses.text: You have turned back the edge of his sword * and have not sustained him in battle.

lines: You have put an end to his splendor *
and cast his throne to the ground.
verses.text: You have put an end to his splendor * and cast his throne to the ground.

lines: You have cut short the days of his youth *
and have covered him with shame.
verses.text: You have cut short the days of his youth * and have covered him with shame.

lines: How long will you hide yourself, O LORD?
will you hide yourself for ever? *
how long will your anger burn like fire?
verses.text: How long will you hide yourself, O LORD? will you hide yourself for ever? * how long will your anger burn like fire?

lines: Remember, LORD, how short life is, *
how frail you have made all flesh.
verses.text: Remember, LORD, how short life is, * how frail you have made all flesh.

lines: Who can live and not see death? *
who can save himself from the power of the grave?
verses.text: Who can live and not see death? * who can save himself from the power of the grave?

lines: Where, Lord, are your loving-kindnesses of old, *
which you promised David in your faithfulness?
verses.text: Where, Lord, are your loving-kindnesses of old, * which you promised David in your faithfulness?

lines: Remember, Lord, how your servant is mocked, *
how I carry in my bosom the taunts of many peoples,
verses.text: Remember, Lord, how your servant is mocked, * how I carry in my bosom the taunts of many peoples,

lines: The taunts your enemies have hurled, O LORD, *
which they hurled at the heels of your anointed.
verses.text: The taunts your enemies have hurled, O LORD, * which they hurled at the heels of your anointed.

lines: Blessed be the LORD for evermore! *
Amen, I say, Amen.
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD for evermore! * Amen, I say, Amen.

lines: Lord, you have been our refuge *
from one generation to another.
verses.text: Lord, you have been our refuge * from one generation to another.

lines: Before the mountains were brought forth,
or the land and the earth were born, *
from age to age you are God.
verses.text: Before the mountains were brought forth, or the land and the earth were born, * from age to age you are God.

lines: You turn us back to the dust and say, *
"Go back, O child of earth."
verses.text: You turn us back to the dust and say, * "Go back, O child of earth."

lines: For a thousand years in your sight are like yesterday
when it is past *
and like a watch in the night.
verses.text: For a thousand years in your sight are like yesterday when it is past * and like a watch in the night.

lines: You sweep us away like a dream; *
we fade away suddenly like the grass.
verses.text: You sweep us away like a dream; * we fade away suddenly like the grass.

lines: In the morning it is green and flourishes; *
in the evening it is dried up and withered.
verses.text: In the morning it is green and flourishes; * in the evening it is dried up and withered.

lines: For we consume away in your displeasure; *
we are afraid because of your wrathful indignation.
verses.text: For we consume away in your displeasure; * we are afraid because of your wrathful indignation.

lines: Our iniquities you have set before you, *
and our secret sins in the light of your countenance.
verses.text: Our iniquities you have set before you, * and our secret sins in the light of your countenance.

lines: When you are angry, all our days are gone; *
we bring our years to an end like a sigh.
verses.text: When you are angry, all our days are gone; * we bring our years to an end like a sigh.

lines: The span of our life is seventy years,
perhaps in strength even eighty; *
yet the sum of them is but labor and sorrow,
for they pass away quickly and we are gone.
verses.text: The span of our life is seventy years, perhaps in strength even eighty; * yet the sum of them is but labor and sorrow, for they pass away quickly and we are gone.

lines: Who regards the power of your wrath? *
who rightly fears your indignation?
verses.text: Who regards the power of your wrath? * who rightly fears your indignation?

lines: So teach us to number our days *
that we may apply our hearts to wisdom.
verses.text: So teach us to number our days * that we may apply our hearts to wisdom.

lines: Return, O LORD; how long will you tarry? *
be gracious to your servants.
verses.text: Return, O LORD; how long will you tarry? * be gracious to your servants.

lines: Satisfy us by your loving-kindness in the morning; *
so shall we rejoice and be glad all the days of our life.
verses.text: Satisfy us by your loving-kindness in the morning; * so shall we rejoice and be glad all the days of our life.

lines: Make us glad by the measure of the days that you afflicted us *
and the years in which we suffered adversity.
verses.text: Make us glad by the measure of the days that you afflicted us * and the years in which we suffered adversity.

lines: Show your servants your works *
and your splendor to their children.
verses.text: Show your servants your works * and your splendor to their children.

lines: May the graciousness of the LORD our God be upon us; *
prosper the work of our hands;
prosper our handiwork.
verses.text: May the graciousness of the LORD our God be upon us; * prosper the work of our hands; prosper our handiwork.

lines: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High, *
abides under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High, * abides under the shadow of the Almighty.

lines: He shall say to the LORD,
"You are my refuge and my stronghold, *
my God in whom I put my trust."
verses.text: He shall say to the LORD, "You are my refuge and my stronghold, * my God in whom I put my trust."

lines: He shall deliver you from the snare of the hunter *
and from the deadly pestilence.
verses.text: He shall deliver you from the snare of the hunter * and from the deadly pestilence.

lines: He shall cover you with his pinions,
and you shall find refuge under his wings; *
his faithfulness shall be a shield and buckler.
verses.text: He shall cover you with his pinions, and you shall find refuge under his wings; * his faithfulness shall be a shield and buckler.

lines: You shall not be afraid of any terror by night, *
nor of the arrow that flies by day;
verses.text: You shall not be afraid of any terror by night, * nor of the arrow that flies by day;

lines: Of the plague that stalks in the darkness, *
nor of the sickness that lays waste at mid-day.
verses.text: Of the plague that stalks in the darkness, * nor of the sickness that lays waste at mid-day.

lines: A thousand shall fall at your side
and ten thousand at your right hand, *
but it shall not come near you.
verses.text: A thousand shall fall at your side and ten thousand at your right hand, * but it shall not come near you.

lines: Your eyes have only to behold *
to see the reward of the wicked.
verses.text: Your eyes have only to behold * to see the reward of the wicked.

lines: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, *
and the Most High your habitation,
verses.text: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, * and the Most High your habitation,

lines: There shall no evil happen to you, *
neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
verses.text: There shall no evil happen to you, * neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

lines: For he shall give his angels charge over you, *
to keep you in all your ways.
verses.text: For he shall give his angels charge over you, * to keep you in all your ways.

lines: They shall bear you in their hands, *
lest you dash your foot against a stone.
verses.text: They shall bear you in their hands, * lest you dash your foot against a stone.

lines: You shall tread upon the lion and adder; *
you shall trample the young lion and the serpent
under your feet.
verses.text: You shall tread upon the lion and adder; * you shall trample the young lion and the serpent under your feet.

lines: Because he is bound to me in love,
therefore will I deliver him; *
I will protect him, because he knows my Name.
verses.text: Because he is bound to me in love, therefore will I deliver him; * I will protect him, because he knows my Name.

lines: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; *
I am with him in trouble;
I will rescue him and bring him to honor.
verses.text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; * I am with him in trouble; I will rescue him and bring him to honor.

lines: With long life will I satisfy him, *
and show him my salvation.
verses.text: With long life will I satisfy him, * and show him my salvation.

lines: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, *
and to sing praises to your Name, O Most High;
verses.text: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, * and to sing praises to your Name, O Most High;

lines: To tell of your loving-kindness early in the morning *
and of your faithfulness in the night season;
verses.text: To tell of your loving-kindness early in the morning * and of your faithfulness in the night season;

lines: On the psaltery, and on the lyre, *
and to the melody of the harp.
verses.text: On the psaltery, and on the lyre, * and to the melody of the harp.

lines: For you have made me glad by your acts, O LORD; *
and I shout for joy because of the works of your hands.
verses.text: For you have made me glad by your acts, O LORD; * and I shout for joy because of the works of your hands.

lines: LORD, how great are your works! *
your thoughts are very deep.
verses.text: LORD, how great are your works! * your thoughts are very deep.

lines: The dullard does not know,
nor does the fool understand, *
that though the wicked grow like weeds,
and all the workers of iniquity flourish,
verses.text: The dullard does not know, nor does the fool understand, * that though the wicked grow like weeds, and all the workers of iniquity flourish,

lines: They flourish only to be destroyed for ever; *
but you, O LORD, are exalted for evermore.
verses.text: They flourish only to be destroyed for ever; * but you, O LORD, are exalted for evermore.

lines: For lo, your enemies, O LORD,
lo, your enemies shall perish, *
and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.text: For lo, your enemies, O LORD, lo, your enemies shall perish, * and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

lines: But my horn you have exalted like the horns of wild bulls; *
I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.text: But my horn you have exalted like the horns of wild bulls; * I am anointed with fresh oil.

lines: My eyes also gloat over my enemies, *
and my ears rejoice to hear the doom of the wicked who
rise up against me.
verses.text: My eyes also gloat over my enemies, * and my ears rejoice to hear the doom of the wicked who rise up against me.

lines: The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, *
and shall spread abroad like a cedar of Lebanon.
verses.text: The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, * and shall spread abroad like a cedar of Lebanon.

lines: Those who are planted in the house of the LORD *
shall flourish in the courts of our God;
verses.text: Those who are planted in the house of the LORD * shall flourish in the courts of our God;

lines: They shall still bear fruit in old age; *
they shall be green and succulent;
verses.text: They shall still bear fruit in old age; * they shall be green and succulent;

lines: That they may show how upright the LORD is, *
my Rock, in whom there is no fault.
verses.text: That they may show how upright the LORD is, * my Rock, in whom there is no fault.

lines: The LORD is King;
he has put on splendid apparel; *
the LORD has put on his apparel
and girded himself with strength.
verses.text: The LORD is King; he has put on splendid apparel; * the LORD has put on his apparel and girded himself with strength.

lines: He has made the whole world so sure *
that it cannot be moved;
verses.text: He has made the whole world so sure * that it cannot be moved;

lines: Ever since the world began, your throne has been established; *
you are from everlasting.
verses.text: Ever since the world began, your throne has been established; * you are from everlasting.

lines: The waters have lifted up, O LORD,
the waters have lifted up their voice; *
the waters have lifted up their pounding waves.
verses.text: The waters have lifted up, O LORD, the waters have lifted up their voice; * the waters have lifted up their pounding waves.

lines: Mightier than the sound of many waters,
mightier than the breakers of the sea, *
mightier is the LORD who dwells on high.
verses.text: Mightier than the sound of many waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea, * mightier is the LORD who dwells on high.

lines: Your testimonies are very sure, *
and holiness adorns your house, O LORD,
for ever and for evermore.
verses.text: Your testimonies are very sure, * and holiness adorns your house, O LORD, for ever and for evermore.

lines: O LORD God of vengeance, *
O God of vengeance, show yourself.
verses.text: O LORD God of vengeance, * O God of vengeance, show yourself.

lines: Rise up, O Judge of the world; *
give the arrogant their just deserts.
verses.text: Rise up, O Judge of the world; * give the arrogant their just deserts.

lines: How long shall the wicked, O LORD, *
how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.text: How long shall the wicked, O LORD, * how long shall the wicked triumph?

lines: They bluster in their insolence; *
all evildoers are full of boasting.
verses.text: They bluster in their insolence; * all evildoers are full of boasting.

lines: They crush your people, O LORD, *
and afflict your chosen nation.
verses.text: They crush your people, O LORD, * and afflict your chosen nation.

lines: They murder the widow and the stranger *
and put the orphans to death.
verses.text: They murder the widow and the stranger * and put the orphans to death.

lines: Yet they say, "The LORD does not see, *
the God of Jacob takes no notice."
verses.text: Yet they say, "The LORD does not see, * the God of Jacob takes no notice."

lines: Consider well, you dullards among the people; *
when will you fools understand?
verses.text: Consider well, you dullards among the people; * when will you fools understand?

lines: He that planted the ear, does he not hear? *
he that formed the eye, does he not see?
verses.text: He that planted the ear, does he not hear? * he that formed the eye, does he not see?

lines: He who admonishes the nations, will he not punish? *
he who teaches all the world, has he no knowledge?
verses.text: He who admonishes the nations, will he not punish? * he who teaches all the world, has he no knowledge?

lines: The LORD knows our human thoughts; *
how like a puff of wind they are.
verses.text: The LORD knows our human thoughts; * how like a puff of wind they are.

lines: Happy are they whom you instruct, O Lord! *
whom you teach out of your law;
verses.text: Happy are they whom you instruct, O Lord! * whom you teach out of your law;

lines: To give them rest in evil days, *
until a pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.text: To give them rest in evil days, * until a pit is dug for the wicked.

lines: For the LORD will not abandon his people, *
nor will he forsake his own.
verses.text: For the LORD will not abandon his people, * nor will he forsake his own.

lines: For judgment will again be just, *
and all the true of heart will follow it.
verses.text: For judgment will again be just, * and all the true of heart will follow it.

lines: Who rose up for me against the wicked? *
who took my part against the evildoers?
verses.text: Who rose up for me against the wicked? * who took my part against the evildoers?

lines: If the LORD had not come to my help, *
I should soon have dwelt in the land of silence.
verses.text: If the LORD had not come to my help, * I should soon have dwelt in the land of silence.

lines: As often as I said, "My foot has slipped," *
your love, O LORD, upheld me.
verses.text: As often as I said, "My foot has slipped," * your love, O LORD, upheld me.

lines: When many cares fill my mind, *
your consolations cheer my soul.
verses.text: When many cares fill my mind, * your consolations cheer my soul.

lines: Can a corrupt tribunal have any part with you, *
one which frames evil into law?
verses.text: Can a corrupt tribunal have any part with you, * one which frames evil into law?

lines: They conspire against the life of the just *
and condemn the innocent to death.
verses.text: They conspire against the life of the just * and condemn the innocent to death.

lines: But the LORD has become my stronghold, *
and my God the rock of my trust.
verses.text: But the LORD has become my stronghold, * and my God the rock of my trust.

lines: He will turn their wickedness back upon them
and destroy them in their own malice; *
the LORD our God will destroy them.
verses.text: He will turn their wickedness back upon them and destroy them in their own malice; * the LORD our God will destroy them.

lines: Come, let us sing to the LORD; *
let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.
verses.text: Come, let us sing to the LORD; * let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.

lines: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving *
and raise a loud shout to him with psalms.
verses.text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving * and raise a loud shout to him with psalms.

lines: For the LORD is a great God, *
and a great King above all gods.
verses.text: For the LORD is a great God, * and a great King above all gods.

lines: In his hand are the caverns of the earth, *
and the heights of the hills are his also.
verses.text: In his hand are the caverns of the earth, * and the heights of the hills are his also.

lines: The sea is his, for he made it, *
and his hands have molded the dry land.
verses.text: The sea is his, for he made it, * and his hands have molded the dry land.

lines: Come, let us bow down, and bend the knee, *
and kneel before the LORD our Maker.
verses.text: Come, let us bow down, and bend the knee, * and kneel before the LORD our Maker.

lines: For he is our God,
and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand. *
Oh, that today you would hearken to his voice!
verses.text: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand. * Oh, that today you would hearken to his voice!

lines: Harden not your hearts,
as your forebears did in the wilderness, *
at Meribah, and on that day at Massah,
when they tempted me.
verses.text: Harden not your hearts, as your forebears did in the wilderness, * at Meribah, and on that day at Massah, when they tempted me.

lines: They put me to the test, *
though they had seen my works.
verses.text: They put me to the test, * though they had seen my works.

lines: Forty years long I detested that generation and said, *
"This people are wayward in their hearts;
they do not know my ways."
verses.text: Forty years long I detested that generation and said, * "This people are wayward in their hearts; they do not know my ways."

lines: So I swore in my wrath, *
"They shall not enter into my rest."
verses.text: So I swore in my wrath, * "They shall not enter into my rest."

lines: Sing to the LORD a new song; *
sing to the LORD, all the whole earth.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD a new song; * sing to the LORD, all the whole earth.

lines: Sing to the LORD and bless his Name; *
proclaim the good news of his salvation from day to day.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD and bless his Name; * proclaim the good news of his salvation from day to day.

lines: Declare his glory among the nations *
and his wonders among all peoples.
verses.text: Declare his glory among the nations * and his wonders among all peoples.

lines: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; *
he is more to be feared than all gods.
verses.text: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; * he is more to be feared than all gods.

lines: As for all the gods of the nations, they are but idols; *
but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
verses.text: As for all the gods of the nations, they are but idols; * but it is the LORD who made the heavens.

lines: Oh, the majesty and magnificence of his presence! *
Oh, the power and the splendor of his sanctuary!
verses.text: Oh, the majesty and magnificence of his presence! * Oh, the power and the splendor of his sanctuary!

lines: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples; *
ascribe to the LORD honor and power.
