verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples; * ascribe to the LORD honor and power.

lines: Ascribe to the LORD the honor due his Name; *
bring offerings and come into his courts.
verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD the honor due his Name; * bring offerings and come into his courts.

lines: Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; *
let the whole earth tremble before him.
verses.text: Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; * let the whole earth tremble before him.

lines: Tell it out among the nations: "The LORD is King! *
he has made the world so firm that it cannot be moved;
he will judge the peoples with equity."
verses.text: Tell it out among the nations: "The LORD is King! * he has made the world so firm that it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity."

lines: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad;
let the sea thunder and all that is in it; *
let the field be joyful and all that is therein.
verses.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea thunder and all that is in it; * let the field be joyful and all that is therein.

lines: Then shall all the trees of the wood shout for joy
before the LORD when he comes, *
when he comes to judge the earth.
verses.text: Then shall all the trees of the wood shout for joy before the LORD when he comes, * when he comes to judge the earth.

lines: He will judge the world with righteousness *
and the peoples with his truth.
verses.text: He will judge the world with righteousness * and the peoples with his truth.

lines: The LORD is King;
let the earth rejoice; *
let the multitude of the isles be glad.
verses.text: The LORD is King; let the earth rejoice; * let the multitude of the isles be glad.

lines: Clouds and darkness are round about him, *
righteousness and justice are the foundations of his throne.
verses.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him, * righteousness and justice are the foundations of his throne.

lines: A fire goes before him *
and burns up his enemies on every side.
verses.text: A fire goes before him * and burns up his enemies on every side.

lines: His lightnings light up the world; *
the earth sees it and is afraid.
verses.text: His lightnings light up the world; * the earth sees it and is afraid.

lines: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, *
at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, * at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

lines: The heavens declare his righteousness, *
and all the peoples see his glory.
verses.text: The heavens declare his righteousness, * and all the peoples see his glory.

lines: Confounded be all who worship carved images
and delight in false gods! *
Bow down before him, all you gods.
verses.text: Confounded be all who worship carved images and delight in false gods! * Bow down before him, all you gods.

lines: Zion hears and is glad, and the cities of Judah rejoice, *
because of your judgments, O LORD.
verses.text: Zion hears and is glad, and the cities of Judah rejoice, * because of your judgments, O LORD.

lines: For you are the LORD,
most high over all the earth; *
you are exalted far above all gods.
verses.text: For you are the LORD, most high over all the earth; * you are exalted far above all gods.

lines: The LORD loves those who hate evil; *
he preserves the lives of his saints
and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.text: The LORD loves those who hate evil; * he preserves the lives of his saints and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

lines: Light has sprung up for the righteous, *
and joyful gladness for those who are truehearted.
verses.text: Light has sprung up for the righteous, * and joyful gladness for those who are truehearted.

lines: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, *
and give thanks to his holy Name.
verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, * and give thanks to his holy Name.

lines: Sing to the LORD a new song, *
for he has done marvelous things.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, * for he has done marvelous things.

lines: With his right hand and his holy arm *
has he won for himself the victory.
verses.text: With his right hand and his holy arm * has he won for himself the victory.

lines: The LORD has made known his victory; *
his righteousness has he openly shown in
the sight of the nations.
verses.text: The LORD has made known his victory; * his righteousness has he openly shown in the sight of the nations.

lines: He remembers his mercy and faithfulness to
the house of Israel, *
and all the ends of the earth have seen the
victory of our God.
verses.text: He remembers his mercy and faithfulness to the house of Israel, * and all the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.

lines: Shout with joy to the LORD, all you lands; *
lift up your voice, rejoice, and sing.
verses.text: Shout with joy to the LORD, all you lands; * lift up your voice, rejoice, and sing.

lines: Sing to the LORD with the harp, *
with the harp and the voice of song.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD with the harp, * with the harp and the voice of song.

lines: With trumpets and the sound of the horn *
shout with joy before the King, the LORD.
verses.text: With trumpets and the sound of the horn * shout with joy before the King, the LORD.

lines: Let the sea make a noise and all that is in it, *
the lands and those who dwell therein.
verses.text: Let the sea make a noise and all that is in it, * the lands and those who dwell therein.

lines: Let the rivers clap their hands, *
and let the hills ring out with joy before the LORD,
when he comes to judge the earth.
verses.text: Let the rivers clap their hands, * and let the hills ring out with joy before the LORD, when he comes to judge the earth.

lines: In righteousness shall he judge the world *
and the peoples with equity.
verses.text: In righteousness shall he judge the world * and the peoples with equity.

lines: The LORD is King;
let the people tremble; *
he is enthroned upon the cherubim;
let the earth shake.
verses.text: The LORD is King; let the people tremble; * he is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth shake.

lines: The LORD is great in Zion; *
he is high above all peoples.
verses.text: The LORD is great in Zion; * he is high above all peoples.

lines: Let them confess his Name, which is great and awesome; *
he is the Holy One.
verses.text: Let them confess his Name, which is great and awesome; * he is the Holy One.

lines: "O mighty King, lover of justice,
you have established equity; *
you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob."
verses.text: "O mighty King, lover of justice, you have established equity; * you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob."

lines: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God
and fall down before his footstool; *
he is the Holy One.
verses.text: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God and fall down before his footstool; * he is the Holy One.

lines: Moses and Aaron among his priests,
and Samuel among those who call upon his Name, *
they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who call upon his Name, * they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

lines: He spoke to them out of the pillar of cloud; *
they kept his testimonies and the decree that he gave them.
verses.text: He spoke to them out of the pillar of cloud; * they kept his testimonies and the decree that he gave them.

lines: "O LORD our God, you answered them indeed; *
you were a God who forgave them,
yet punished them for their evil deeds."
verses.text: "O LORD our God, you answered them indeed; * you were a God who forgave them, yet punished them for their evil deeds."

lines: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God
and worship him upon his holy hill; *
for the LORD our God is the Holy One.
verses.text: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God and worship him upon his holy hill; * for the LORD our God is the Holy One.

lines: Be joyful in the LORD, all you lands; *
serve the LORD with gladness
and come before his presence with a song.
verses.text: Be joyful in the LORD, all you lands; * serve the LORD with gladness and come before his presence with a song.

lines: Know this: The LORD himself is God; *
he himself has made us, and we are his;
we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.text: Know this: The LORD himself is God; * he himself has made us, and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.

lines: Enter his gates with thanksgiving;
go into his courts with praise; *
give thanks to him and call upon his Name.
verses.text: Enter his gates with thanksgiving; go into his courts with praise; * give thanks to him and call upon his Name.

lines: For the LORD is good;
his mercy is everlasting; *
and his faithfulness endures from age to age.
verses.text: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; * and his faithfulness endures from age to age.

lines: I will sing of mercy and justice; *
to you, O LORD, will I sing praises.
verses.text: I will sing of mercy and justice; * to you, O LORD, will I sing praises.

lines: I will strive to follow a blameless course;
oh, when will you come to me? *
I will walk with sincerity of heart within my house.
verses.text: I will strive to follow a blameless course; oh, when will you come to me? * I will walk with sincerity of heart within my house.

lines: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes; *
I hate the doers of evil deeds;
they shall not remain with me.
verses.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes; * I hate the doers of evil deeds; they shall not remain with me.

lines: A crooked heart shall be far from me; *
I will not know evil.
verses.text: A crooked heart shall be far from me; * I will not know evil.

lines: Those who in secret slander their neighbors I will destroy; *
those who have a haughty look and a proud
heart I cannot abide.
verses.text: Those who in secret slander their neighbors I will destroy; * those who have a haughty look and a proud heart I cannot abide.

lines: My eyes are upon the faithful in the land, that they may
dwell with me, *
and only those who lead a blameless life shall
be my servants.
verses.text: My eyes are upon the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me, * and only those who lead a blameless life shall be my servants.

lines: Those who act deceitfully shall not dwell in my house, *
and those who tell lies shall not continue in my sight.
verses.text: Those who act deceitfully shall not dwell in my house, * and those who tell lies shall not continue in my sight.

lines: I will soon destroy all the wicked in the land, *
that I may root out all evildoers from the city of the LORD.
verses.text: I will soon destroy all the wicked in the land, * that I may root out all evildoers from the city of the LORD.

lines: LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come before you; *
hide not your face from me in the day of my trouble.
verses.text: LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come before you; * hide not your face from me in the day of my trouble.

lines: Incline your ear to me; *
when I call, make haste to answer me,
verses.text: Incline your ear to me; * when I call, make haste to answer me,

lines: For my days drift away like smoke, *
and my bones are hot as burning coals.
verses.text: For my days drift away like smoke, * and my bones are hot as burning coals.

lines: My heart is smitten like grass and withered, *
so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.text: My heart is smitten like grass and withered, * so that I forget to eat my bread.

lines: Because of the voice of my groaning *
I am but skin and bones.
verses.text: Because of the voice of my groaning * I am but skin and bones.

lines: I have become like a vulture in the wilderness, *
like an owl among the ruins.
verses.text: I have become like a vulture in the wilderness, * like an owl among the ruins.

lines: I lie awake and groan; *
I am like a sparrow, lonely on a house-top.
verses.text: I lie awake and groan; * I am like a sparrow, lonely on a house-top.

lines: My enemies revile me all day long, *
and those who scoff at me have taken an oath against me.
verses.text: My enemies revile me all day long, * and those who scoff at me have taken an oath against me.

lines: For I have eaten ashes for bread *
and mingled my drink with weeping.
verses.text: For I have eaten ashes for bread * and mingled my drink with weeping.

lines: Because of your indignation and wrath *
you have lifted me up and thrown me away.
verses.text: Because of your indignation and wrath * you have lifted me up and thrown me away.

lines: My days pass away like a shadow, *
and I wither like the grass.
verses.text: My days pass away like a shadow, * and I wither like the grass.

lines: But you, O LORD, endure for ever, *
and your Name from age to age.
verses.text: But you, O LORD, endure for ever, * and your Name from age to age.

lines: You will arise and have compassion on Zion,
for it is time to have mercy upon her; *
indeed, the appointed time has come.
verses.text: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to have mercy upon her; * indeed, the appointed time has come.

lines: For your servants love her very rubble, *
and are moved to pity even for her dust.
verses.text: For your servants love her very rubble, * and are moved to pity even for her dust.

lines: The nations shall fear your Name, O LORD, *
and all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.text: The nations shall fear your Name, O LORD, * and all the kings of the earth your glory.

lines: For the LORD will build up Zion, *
and his glory will appear.
verses.text: For the LORD will build up Zion, * and his glory will appear.

lines: He will look with favor on the prayer of the homeless; *
he will not despise their plea.
verses.text: He will look with favor on the prayer of the homeless; * he will not despise their plea.

lines: Let this be written for a future generation, *
so that a people yet unborn may praise the LORD.
verses.text: Let this be written for a future generation, * so that a people yet unborn may praise the LORD.

lines: For the LORD looked down from his holy place on high; *
from the heavens he beheld the earth;
verses.text: For the LORD looked down from his holy place on high; * from the heavens he beheld the earth;

lines: That he might hear the groan of the captive *
and set free those condemned to die;
verses.text: That he might hear the groan of the captive * and set free those condemned to die;

lines: That they may declare in Zion the Name of the LORD, *
and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.text: That they may declare in Zion the Name of the LORD, * and his praise in Jerusalem;

lines: When the peoples are gathered together, *
and the kingdoms also, to serve the LORD.
verses.text: When the peoples are gathered together, * and the kingdoms also, to serve the LORD.

lines: He has brought down my strength before my time; *
he has shortened the number of my days;
verses.text: He has brought down my strength before my time; * he has shortened the number of my days;

lines: And I said, "O my God,
do not take me away in the midst of my days; *
your years endure throughout all generations.
verses.text: And I said, "O my God, do not take me away in the midst of my days; * your years endure throughout all generations.

lines: In the beginning, O LORD, you laid the foundations
of the earth, *
and the heavens are the work of your hands;
verses.text: In the beginning, O LORD, you laid the foundations of the earth, * and the heavens are the work of your hands;

lines: They shall perish, but you will endure;
they all shall wear out like a garment; *
as clothing you will change them,
and they shall be changed;
verses.text: They shall perish, but you will endure; they all shall wear out like a garment; * as clothing you will change them, and they shall be changed;

lines: But you are always the same, *
and your years will never end.
verses.text: But you are always the same, * and your years will never end.

lines: The children of your servants shall continue, *
and their offspring shall stand fast in your sight."
verses.text: The children of your servants shall continue, * and their offspring shall stand fast in your sight."

lines: Bless the LORD, O my soul, *
and all that is within me, bless his holy Name.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, * and all that is within me, bless his holy Name.

lines: Bless the LORD, O my soul, *
and forget not all his benefits.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, * and forget not all his benefits.

lines: He forgives all your sins *
and heals all your infirmities;
verses.text: He forgives all your sins * and heals all your infirmities;

lines: He redeems your life from the grave *
and crowns you with mercy and loving-kindness;
verses.text: He redeems your life from the grave * and crowns you with mercy and loving-kindness;

lines: He satisfies you with good things, *
and your youth is renewed like an eagle's.
verses.text: He satisfies you with good things, * and your youth is renewed like an eagle's.

lines: The LORD executes righteousness *
and judgment for all who are oppressed.
verses.text: The LORD executes righteousness * and judgment for all who are oppressed.

lines: He made his ways known to Moses *
and his works to the children of Israel.
verses.text: He made his ways known to Moses * and his works to the children of Israel.

lines: The LORD is full of compassion and mercy, *
slow to anger and of great kindness.
verses.text: The LORD is full of compassion and mercy, * slow to anger and of great kindness.

lines: He will not always accuse us, *
nor will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.text: He will not always accuse us, * nor will he keep his anger for ever.

lines: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, *
nor rewarded us according to our wickedness.
verses.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, * nor rewarded us according to our wickedness.

lines: For as the heavens are high above the earth, *
so is his mercy great upon those who fear him.
verses.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, * so is his mercy great upon those who fear him.

lines: As far as the east is from the west, *
so far has he removed our sins from us.
verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, * so far has he removed our sins from us.

lines: As a father cares for his children, *
so does the LORD care for those who fear him.
verses.text: As a father cares for his children, * so does the LORD care for those who fear him.

lines: For he himself knows whereof we are made; *
he remembers that we are but dust.
verses.text: For he himself knows whereof we are made; * he remembers that we are but dust.

lines: Our days are like the grass; *
we flourish like a flower of the field;
verses.text: Our days are like the grass; * we flourish like a flower of the field;

lines: When the wind goes over it, it is gone, *
and its place shall know it no more.
verses.text: When the wind goes over it, it is gone, * and its place shall know it no more.

lines: But the merciful goodness of the LORD endures for ever
on those who fear him, *
and his righteousness on children's children;
verses.text: But the merciful goodness of the LORD endures for ever on those who fear him, * and his righteousness on children's children;

lines: On those who keep his covenant *
and remember his commandments and do them.
verses.text: On those who keep his covenant * and remember his commandments and do them.

lines: The LORD has set his throne in heaven, *
and his kingship has dominion over all.
verses.text: The LORD has set his throne in heaven, * and his kingship has dominion over all.

lines: Bless the LORD, you angels of his,
you mighty ones who do his bidding, *
and hearken to the voice of his word.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, you angels of his, you mighty ones who do his bidding, * and hearken to the voice of his word.

lines: Bless the LORD, all you his hosts, *
you ministers of his who do his will.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, all you his hosts, * you ministers of his who do his will.

lines: Bless the LORD, all you works of his,
in all places of his dominion; *
bless the LORD, O my soul.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion; * bless the LORD, O my soul.

lines: Bless the LORD, O my soul; *
O LORD my God, how excellent is your greatness!
you are clothed with majesty and splendor.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul; * O LORD my God, how excellent is your greatness! you are clothed with majesty and splendor.

lines: You wrap yourself with light as with a cloak *
and spread out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.text: You wrap yourself with light as with a cloak * and spread out the heavens like a curtain.

lines: You lay the beams of your chambers in the waters above; *
you make the clouds your chariot;
you ride on the wings of the wind.
verses.text: You lay the beams of your chambers in the waters above; * you make the clouds your chariot; you ride on the wings of the wind.

lines: You make the winds your messengers *
and flames of fire your servants.
verses.text: You make the winds your messengers * and flames of fire your servants.

lines: You have set the earth upon its foundations, *
so that it never shall move at any time.
verses.text: You have set the earth upon its foundations, * so that it never shall move at any time.

lines: You covered it with the Deep as with a mantle; *
the waters stood higher than the mountains.
verses.text: You covered it with the Deep as with a mantle; * the waters stood higher than the mountains.

lines: At your rebuke they fled; *
at the voice of your thunder they hastened away.
verses.text: At your rebuke they fled; * at the voice of your thunder they hastened away.

lines: They went up into the hills and down to the valleys beneath, *
to the places you had appointed for them.
verses.text: They went up into the hills and down to the valleys beneath, * to the places you had appointed for them.

lines: You set the limits that they should not pass; *
they shall not again cover the earth.

he did not let their herds decrease.
verses.text: He blessed them, so that they increased greatly; * he did not let their herds decrease.

lines: Yet when they were diminished and brought low, *
through stress of adversity and sorrow,
verses.text: Yet when they were diminished and brought low, * through stress of adversity and sorrow,

lines: (He pours contempt on princes *
and makes them wander in trackless wastes)
verses.text: (He pours contempt on princes * and makes them wander in trackless wastes)

lines: He lifted up the poor out of misery *
and multiplied their families like flocks of sheep.
verses.text: He lifted up the poor out of misery * and multiplied their families like flocks of sheep.

lines: The upright will see this and rejoice, *
but all wickedness will shut its mouth.
verses.text: The upright will see this and rejoice, * but all wickedness will shut its mouth.

lines: Whoever is wise will ponder these things, *
and consider well the mercies of the LORD.
verses.text: Whoever is wise will ponder these things, * and consider well the mercies of the LORD.

lines: My heart is firmly fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; *
I will sing and make melody.
verses.text: My heart is firmly fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; * I will sing and make melody.

lines: Wake up, my spirit;
awake, lute and harp; *
I myself will waken the dawn.
verses.text: Wake up, my spirit; awake, lute and harp; * I myself will waken the dawn.

lines: I will confess you among the peoples, O LORD; *
I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.text: I will confess you among the peoples, O LORD; * I will sing praises to you among the nations.

lines: For your loving-kindness is greater than the heavens, *
and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.text: For your loving-kindness is greater than the heavens, * and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

lines: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God, *
and your glory over all the earth.
verses.text: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God, * and your glory over all the earth.

lines: So that those who are dear to you may be delivered, *
save with your right hand and answer me.
verses.text: So that those who are dear to you may be delivered, * save with your right hand and answer me.

lines: God spoke from his holy place and said, *
"I will exult and parcel out Shechem;
I will divide the valley of Succoth.
verses.text: God spoke from his holy place and said, * "I will exult and parcel out Shechem; I will divide the valley of Succoth.

lines: Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine; *
Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my scepter.
verses.text: Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine; * Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my scepter.

lines: Moab is my washbasin,
on Edom I throw down my sandal to claim it, *
and over Philistia will I shout in triumph."
verses.text: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I throw down my sandal to claim it, * and over Philistia will I shout in triumph."

lines: Who will lead me into the strong city? *
who will bring me into Edom?
verses.text: Who will lead me into the strong city? * who will bring me into Edom?

lines: Have you not cast us off, O God? *
you no longer go out, O God, with our armies.
verses.text: Have you not cast us off, O God? * you no longer go out, O God, with our armies.

lines: Grant us your help against the enemy, *
for vain is the help of man.
verses.text: Grant us your help against the enemy, * for vain is the help of man.

lines: With God we will do valiant deeds, *
and he shall tread our enemies under foot.
verses.text: With God we will do valiant deeds, * and he shall tread our enemies under foot.

lines: Hold not your tongue, O God of my praise; *
for the mouth of the wicked,
the mouth of the deceitful, is opened against me.
verses.text: Hold not your tongue, O God of my praise; * for the mouth of the wicked, the mouth of the deceitful, is opened against me.

lines: They speak to me with a lying tongue; *
they encompass me with hateful words
and fight against me without a cause.
verses.text: They speak to me with a lying tongue; * they encompass me with hateful words and fight against me without a cause.

lines: Despite my love, they accuse me; *
but as for me, I pray for them.
verses.text: Despite my love, they accuse me; * but as for me, I pray for them.

lines: They repay evil for good, *
and hatred for my love.
verses.text: They repay evil for good, * and hatred for my love.

lines: Set a wicked man against him, *
and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.text: Set a wicked man against him, * and let an accuser stand at his right hand.

lines: When he is judged, let him be found guilty, *
and let his appeal be in vain.
verses.text: When he is judged, let him be found guilty, * and let his appeal be in vain.

lines: Let his days be few, *
and let another take his office.
verses.text: Let his days be few, * and let another take his office.

lines: Let his children be fatherless, *
and his wife become a widow.
verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, * and his wife become a widow.

lines: Let his children be waifs and beggars; *
let them be driven from the ruins of their homes.
verses.text: Let his children be waifs and beggars; * let them be driven from the ruins of their homes.

lines: Let the creditor seize everything he has; *
let strangers plunder his gains.
verses.text: Let the creditor seize everything he has; * let strangers plunder his gains.

lines: Let there be no one to show him kindness, *
and none to pity his fatherless children.
verses.text: Let there be no one to show him kindness, * and none to pity his fatherless children.

lines: Let his descendants be destroyed, *
and his name be blotted out in the next generation.
verses.text: Let his descendants be destroyed, * and his name be blotted out in the next generation.

lines: Let the wickedness of his fathers be remembered before
the LORD, *
and his mother's sin not be blotted out;
verses.text: Let the wickedness of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, * and his mother's sin not be blotted out;

lines: Let their sin be always before the LORD; *
but let him root out their names from the earth;
verses.text: Let their sin be always before the LORD; * but let him root out their names from the earth;

lines: Because he did not remember to show mercy, *
but persecuted the poor and needy
and sought to kill the brokenhearted.
verses.text: Because he did not remember to show mercy, * but persecuted the poor and needy and sought to kill the brokenhearted.

lines: He loved cursing,
let it come upon him; *
he took no delight in blessing,
let it depart from him.
verses.text: He loved cursing, let it come upon him; * he took no delight in blessing, let it depart from him.

lines: He put on cursing like a garment, *
let it soak into his body like water
and into his bones like oil;
verses.text: He put on cursing like a garment, * let it soak into his body like water and into his bones like oil;

lines: Let it be to him like the cloak which he
wraps around himself, *
and like the belt that he wears continually.
verses.text: Let it be to him like the cloak which he wraps around himself, * and like the belt that he wears continually.

lines: Let this be the recompense from the LORD to my accusers, *
and to those who speak evil against me.
verses.text: Let this be the recompense from the LORD to my accusers, * and to those who speak evil against me.

lines: But you, O Lord my God,
oh, deal with me according to your Name; *
for your tender mercy's sake, deliver me.
verses.text: But you, O Lord my God, oh, deal with me according to your Name; * for your tender mercy's sake, deliver me.

lines: For I am poor and needy, *
and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.text: For I am poor and needy, * and my heart is wounded within me.

lines: I have faded away like a shadow when it lengthens; *
I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.text: I have faded away like a shadow when it lengthens; * I am shaken off like a locust.

lines: My knees are weak through fasting, *
and my flesh is wasted and gaunt.
verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting, * and my flesh is wasted and gaunt.

lines: I have become a reproach to them; *
they see and shake their heads.
verses.text: I have become a reproach to them; * they see and shake their heads.

lines: Help me, O LORD my God; *
save me for your mercy's sake.
verses.text: Help me, O LORD my God; * save me for your mercy's sake.

lines: Let them know that this is your hand, *
that you, O LORD, have done it.
verses.text: Let them know that this is your hand, * that you, O LORD, have done it.

lines: They may curse, but you will bless; *
let those who rise up against me be put to shame,
and your servant will rejoice.
verses.text: They may curse, but you will bless; * let those who rise up against me be put to shame, and your servant will rejoice.

lines: Let my accusers be clothed with disgrace *
and wrap themselves in their shame as in a cloak.
verses.text: Let my accusers be clothed with disgrace * and wrap themselves in their shame as in a cloak.

lines: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth; *
in the midst of the multitude will I praise him;
verses.text: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth; * in the midst of the multitude will I praise him;

lines: Because he stands at the right hand of the needy, *
to save his life from those who would condemn him.
verses.text: Because he stands at the right hand of the needy, * to save his life from those who would condemn him.

lines: The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, *
until I make your enemies your footstool."
verses.text: The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, * until I make your enemies your footstool."

lines: The LORD will send the scepter of your power out of Zion, *
saying, "Rule over your enemies round about you.
verses.text: The LORD will send the scepter of your power out of Zion, * saying, "Rule over your enemies round about you.

lines: Princely state has been yours from the day of your birth; *
in the beauty of holiness have I begotten you,
like dew from the womb of the morning."
verses.text: Princely state has been yours from the day of your birth; * in the beauty of holiness have I begotten you, like dew from the womb of the morning."

lines: The LORD has sworn and he will not recant: *
"You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek."
verses.text: The LORD has sworn and he will not recant: * "You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek."

lines: The Lord who is at your right hand
will smite kings in the day of his wrath; *
he will rule over the nations.
verses.text: The Lord who is at your right hand will smite kings in the day of his wrath; * he will rule over the nations.

lines: He will heap high the corpses; *
he will smash heads over the wide earth.
verses.text: He will heap high the corpses; * he will smash heads over the wide earth.

lines: He will drink from the brook beside the road; *
therefore he will lift high his head.
verses.text: He will drink from the brook beside the road; * therefore he will lift high his head.

lines: Hallelujah!
I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, *
in the assembly of the upright, in the congregation.
verses.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, * in the assembly of the upright, in the congregation.

lines: Great are the deeds of the LORD! *
they are studied by all who delight in them.
verses.text: Great are the deeds of the LORD! * they are studied by all who delight in them.

lines: His work is full of majesty and splendor, *
and his righteousness endures for ever.
verses.text: His work is full of majesty and splendor, * and his righteousness endures for ever.

lines: He makes his marvelous works to be remembered; *
the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.text: He makes his marvelous works to be remembered; * the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

lines: He gives food to those who fear him; *
he is ever mindful of his covenant.
verses.text: He gives food to those who fear him; * he is ever mindful of his covenant.

lines: He has shown his people the power of his works *
in giving them the lands of the nations.
verses.text: He has shown his people the power of his works * in giving them the lands of the nations.

lines: The works of his hands are faithfulness and justice; *
all his commandments are sure.
verses.text: The works of his hands are faithfulness and justice; * all his commandments are sure.

lines: They stand fast for ever and ever, *
because they are done in truth and equity.
verses.text: They stand fast for ever and ever, * because they are done in truth and equity.

lines: He sent redemption to his people;
he commanded his covenant for ever; *
holy and awesome is his Name.
verses.text: He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant for ever; * holy and awesome is his Name.

lines: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; *
those who act accordingly have a good understanding;
his praise endures for ever.
verses.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; * those who act accordingly have a good understanding; his praise endures for ever.

lines: Hallelujah!
Happy are they who fear the Lord *
and have great delight in his commandments!
verses.text: Hallelujah! Happy are they who fear the Lord * and have great delight in his commandments!

lines: Their descendants will be mighty in the land; *
the generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.text: Their descendants will be mighty in the land; * the generation of the upright will be blessed.

lines: Wealth and riches will be in their house, *
and their righteousness will last for ever.
verses.text: Wealth and riches will be in their house, * and their righteousness will last for ever.

lines: Light shines in the darkness for the upright; *
the righteous are merciful and full of compassion.
verses.text: Light shines in the darkness for the upright; * the righteous are merciful and full of compassion.

lines: It is good for them to be generous in lending *
and to manage their affairs with justice.
verses.text: It is good for them to be generous in lending * and to manage their affairs with justice.

lines: For they will never be shaken; *
the righteous will be kept in everlasting remembrance.
verses.text: For they will never be shaken; * the righteous will be kept in everlasting remembrance.

lines: They will not be afraid of any evil rumors; *
their heart is right;
they put their trust in the Lord.
verses.text: They will not be afraid of any evil rumors; * their heart is right; they put their trust in the Lord.

lines: Their heart is established and will not shrink, *
until they see their desire upon their enemies.
verses.text: Their heart is established and will not shrink, * until they see their desire upon their enemies.

lines: They have given freely to the poor, *
and their righteousness stands fast for ever;
they will hold up their head with honor.
verses.text: They have given freely to the poor, * and their righteousness stands fast for ever; they will hold up their head with honor.

lines: The wicked will see it and be angry;
they will gnash their teeth and pine away; *
the desires of the wicked will perish.
verses.text: The wicked will see it and be angry; they will gnash their teeth and pine away; * the desires of the wicked will perish.

lines: Hallelujah!
Give praise, you servants of the LORD; *
praise the Name of the LORD.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Give praise, you servants of the LORD; * praise the Name of the LORD.

lines: Let the Name of the LORD be blessed, *
from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: Let the Name of the LORD be blessed, * from this time forth for evermore.

lines: From the rising of the sun to its going down *
let the Name of the LORD be praised.
verses.text: From the rising of the sun to its going down * let the Name of the LORD be praised.

lines: The LORD is high above all nations, *
and his glory above the heavens.
verses.text: The LORD is high above all nations, * and his glory above the heavens.

lines: Who is like the LORD our God, who sits enthroned on high, *
but stoops to behold the heavens and the earth?
verses.text: Who is like the LORD our God, who sits enthroned on high, * but stoops to behold the heavens and the earth?

lines: He takes up the weak out of the dust *
and lifts up the poor from the ashes.
verses.text: He takes up the weak out of the dust * and lifts up the poor from the ashes.

lines: He sets them with the princes, *
with the princes of his people.
verses.text: He sets them with the princes, * with the princes of his people.

lines: He makes the woman of a childless house *
to be a joyful mother of children.
verses.text: He makes the woman of a childless house * to be a joyful mother of children.

lines: Hallelujah!
When Israel came out of Egypt, *
the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,
verses.text: Hallelujah! When Israel came out of Egypt, * the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,

lines: Judah became God's sanctuary *
and Israel his dominion.
verses.text: Judah became God's sanctuary * and Israel his dominion.

lines: The sea beheld it and fled; *
Jordan turned and went back.
verses.text: The sea beheld it and fled; * Jordan turned and went back.

lines: The mountains skipped like rams, *
and the little hills like young sheep.
verses.text: The mountains skipped like rams, * and the little hills like young sheep.

lines: What ailed you, O sea, that you fled? *
O Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.text: What ailed you, O sea, that you fled? * O Jordan, that you turned back?

lines: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? *
you little hills like young sheep?
verses.text: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? * you little hills like young sheep?

lines: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, *
at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.text: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, * at the presence of the God of Jacob,

lines: Who turned the hard rock into a pool of water *
and flint-stone into a flowing spring.
verses.text: Who turned the hard rock into a pool of water * and flint-stone into a flowing spring.

lines: Not to us, O LORD, not to us,
but to your Name give glory; *
because of your love and because of your faithfulness.
verses.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to your Name give glory; * because of your love and because of your faithfulness.

lines: Why should the heathen say, *
"Where then is their God?"
verses.text: Why should the heathen say, * "Where then is their God?"

lines: Our God is in heaven; *
whatever he wills to do he does.
verses.text: Our God is in heaven; * whatever he wills to do he does.

lines: Their idols are silver and gold, *
the work of human hands.
verses.text: Their idols are silver and gold, * the work of human hands.

lines: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; *
eyes have they, but they cannot see;
verses.text: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; * eyes have they, but they cannot see;

lines: They have ears but they cannot hear; *
noses, but they cannot smell;
verses.text: They have ears but they cannot hear; * noses, but they cannot smell;

lines: They have hands, but they cannot feel;
feet, but they cannot walk; *
they make no sound with their throat.
verses.text: They have hands, but they cannot feel; feet, but they cannot walk; * they make no sound with their throat.

lines: Those who make them are like them, *
and so are all who put their trust in them.
verses.text: Those who make them are like them, * and so are all who put their trust in them.

lines: O Israel, trust in the LORD; *
he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD; * he is their help and their shield.

lines: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; *
he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; * he is their help and their shield.

lines: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; *
he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; * he is their help and their shield.

lines: The LORD has been mindful of us, and he will bless us; *
he will bless the house of Israel;
he will bless the house of Aaron;
verses.text: The LORD has been mindful of us, and he will bless us; * he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;

lines: He will bless those who fear the LORD, *
both small and great together.
verses.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD, * both small and great together.

lines: May the LORD increase you more and more, *
you and your children after you.
verses.text: May the LORD increase you more and more, * you and your children after you.

lines: May you be blessed by the LORD, *
the maker of heaven and earth.
verses.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, * the maker of heaven and earth.

lines: The heaven of heavens is the LORD'S, *
but he entrusted the earth to its peoples.
verses.text: The heaven of heavens is the LORD'S, * but he entrusted the earth to its peoples.

lines: The dead do not praise the LORD, *
nor all those who go down into silence;
verses.text: The dead do not praise the LORD, * nor all those who go down into silence;

lines: But we will bless the LORD, *
from this time forth for evermore.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: But we will bless the LORD, * from this time forth for evermore. Hallelujah!

lines: I love the LORD, because he has heard the voice of
my supplication, *
because he has inclined his ear to me whenever
I called upon him.
verses.text: I love the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my supplication, * because he has inclined his ear to me whenever I called upon him.

lines: The cords of death entangled me;
the grip of the grave took hold of me; *
I came to grief and sorrow.
verses.text: The cords of death entangled me; the grip of the grave took hold of me; * I came to grief and sorrow.

lines: Then I called upon the Name of the LORD: *
"O LORD, I pray you, save my life."
verses.text: Then I called upon the Name of the LORD: * "O LORD, I pray you, save my life."

lines: Gracious is the LORD and righteous; *
our God is full of compassion.
verses.text: Gracious is the LORD and righteous; * our God is full of compassion.

lines: The LORD watches over the innocent; *
I was brought very low, and he helped me.
verses.text: The LORD watches over the innocent; * I was brought very low, and he helped me.

lines: Turn again to your rest, O my soul, *
for the LORD has treated you well.
verses.text: Turn again to your rest, O my soul, * for the LORD has treated you well.

lines: For you have rescued my life from death, *
my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
verses.text: For you have rescued my life from death, * my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.

lines: I will walk in the presence of the LORD *
in the land of the living.
verses.text: I will walk in the presence of the LORD * in the land of the living.

lines: I believed, even when I said,
"I have been brought very low." *
In my distress I said, "No one can be trusted."
verses.text: I believed, even when I said, "I have been brought very low." * In my distress I said, "No one can be trusted."

lines: How shall I repay the LORD *
for all the good things he has done for me?
verses.text: How shall I repay the LORD * for all the good things he has done for me?

lines: I will lift up the cup of salvation *
and call upon the Name of the LORD.
verses.text: I will lift up the cup of salvation * and call upon the Name of the LORD.

lines: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD *
in the presence of all his people.
verses.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD * in the presence of all his people.

lines: Precious in the sight of the LORD *
is the death of his servants.
verses.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD * is the death of his servants.

lines: O LORD, I am your servant; *
I am your servant and the child of your handmaid;
you have freed me from my bonds.
verses.text: O LORD, I am your servant; * I am your servant and the child of your handmaid; you have freed me from my bonds.

lines: I will offer you the sacrifice of thanksgiving *
and call upon the Name of the LORD.

in the presence of all his people,
verses.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD * in the presence of all his people,

in the midst of you, O Jerusalem.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: In the courts of the LORD'S house, * in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

lines: Praise the LORD, all you nations; *
laud him, all you peoples.

lines: For his loving-kindness toward us is great, *
and the faithfulness of the LORD endures for ever.

verses.text: For his loving-kindness toward us is great, * and the faithfulness of the LORD endures for ever. Hallelujah!

lines: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; *
his mercy endures for ever.

"His mercy endures for ever."
verses.text: Let Israel now proclaim, * "His mercy endures for ever."

"His mercy endures for ever."

"His mercy endures for ever."

the LORD answered by setting me free.

what can anyone do to me?

I will triumph over those who hate me.

than to put any trust in flesh.

than to put any trust in rulers.

in the Name of the LORD I will repel them.

in the name of the LORD I will repel them.

they blaze like a fire of thorns; *
in the name of the LORD I will repel them.

lines: I was pressed so hard that I almost fell, *
but the LORD came to my help.

and he has become my salvation.

in the tents of the righteous:

the right hand of the LORD is exalted!
the right hand of the LORD has triumphed!"

and declare the works of the LORD.
