lines: Behold my affliction and deliver me, *
for I do not forget your law.
verses.text: Behold my affliction and deliver me, * for I do not forget your law.

lines: Plead my cause and redeem me; *
according to your promise, give me life.
verses.text: Plead my cause and redeem me; * according to your promise, give me life.

lines: Deliverance is far from the wicked, *
for they do not study your statutes.
verses.text: Deliverance is far from the wicked, * for they do not study your statutes.

lines: Great is your compassion, O LORD; *
preserve my life, according to your judgments.
verses.text: Great is your compassion, O LORD; * preserve my life, according to your judgments.

lines: There are many who persecute and oppress me, *
yet I have not swerved from your decrees.
verses.text: There are many who persecute and oppress me, * yet I have not swerved from your decrees.

lines: I look with loathing at the faithless, *
for they have not kept your word.
verses.text: I look with loathing at the faithless, * for they have not kept your word.

lines: See how I love your commandments! *
O LORD, in your mercy, preserve me.
verses.text: See how I love your commandments! * O LORD, in your mercy, preserve me.

lines: The heart of your word is truth; *
all your righteous judgments endure for evermore.
verses.text: The heart of your word is truth; * all your righteous judgments endure for evermore.

lines: Rulers have persecuted me without a cause, *
but my heart stands in awe of your word.
verses.text: Rulers have persecuted me without a cause, * but my heart stands in awe of your word.

lines: I am as glad because of your promise *
as one who finds great spoils.
verses.text: I am as glad because of your promise * as one who finds great spoils.

lines: As for lies, I hate and abhor them, *
but your law is my love.
verses.text: As for lies, I hate and abhor them, * but your law is my love.

lines: Seven times a day do I praise you, *
because of your righteous judgments.
verses.text: Seven times a day do I praise you, * because of your righteous judgments.

lines: Great peace have they who love your law; *
for them there is no stumbling block.
verses.text: Great peace have they who love your law; * for them there is no stumbling block.

lines: I have hoped for your salvation, O LORD, *
and have fulfilled your commandments.
verses.text: I have hoped for your salvation, O LORD, * and have fulfilled your commandments.

lines: I have kept your decrees *
and I have loved them deeply.
verses.text: I have kept your decrees * and I have loved them deeply.

lines: I have kept your commandments and decrees, *
for all my ways are before you.
verses.text: I have kept your commandments and decrees, * for all my ways are before you.

lines: Let my cry come before you, O LORD; *
give me understanding, according to your word.
verses.text: Let my cry come before you, O LORD; * give me understanding, according to your word.

lines: Let my supplication come before you; *
deliver me, according to your promise.
verses.text: Let my supplication come before you; * deliver me, according to your promise.

lines: My lips shall pour forth your praise, *
when you teach me your statutes.
verses.text: My lips shall pour forth your praise, * when you teach me your statutes.

lines: My tongue shall sing of your promise, *
for all your commandments are righteous.
verses.text: My tongue shall sing of your promise, * for all your commandments are righteous.

lines: Let your hand be ready to help me, *
for I have chosen your commandments.
verses.text: Let your hand be ready to help me, * for I have chosen your commandments.

lines: I long for your salvation, O LORD, *
and your law is my delight.
verses.text: I long for your salvation, O LORD, * and your law is my delight.

lines: Let me live, and I will praise you, *
and let your judgments help me.
verses.text: Let me live, and I will praise you, * and let your judgments help me.

lines: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost; *
search for your servant,
for I do not forget your commandments.
verses.text: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost; * search for your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.

lines: When I was in trouble, I called to the LORD; *
I called to the LORD, and he answered me.
verses.text: When I was in trouble, I called to the LORD; * I called to the LORD, and he answered me.

lines: Deliver me, O LORD, from lying lips *
and from the deceitful tongue.
verses.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from lying lips * and from the deceitful tongue.

lines: What shall be done to you, and what more besides, *
O you deceitful tongue?
verses.text: What shall be done to you, and what more besides, * O you deceitful tongue?

lines: The sharpened arrows of a warrior, *
along with hot glowing coals.
verses.text: The sharpened arrows of a warrior, * along with hot glowing coals.

lines: How hateful it is that I must lodge in Meshech *
and dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.text: How hateful it is that I must lodge in Meshech * and dwell among the tents of Kedar!

lines: Too long have I had to live *
among the enemies of peace.
verses.text: Too long have I had to live * among the enemies of peace.

lines: I am on the side of peace, *
but when I speak of it, they are for war.
verses.text: I am on the side of peace, * but when I speak of it, they are for war.

lines: I lift up my eyes to the hills; *
from where is my help to come?
verses.text: I lift up my eyes to the hills; * from where is my help to come?

lines: My help comes from the LORD, *
the maker of heaven and earth.
verses.text: My help comes from the LORD, * the maker of heaven and earth.

lines: He will not let your foot be moved *
and he who watches over you will not fall asleep.
verses.text: He will not let your foot be moved * and he who watches over you will not fall asleep.

lines: Behold, he who keeps watch over Israel *
shall neither slumber nor sleep;
verses.text: Behold, he who keeps watch over Israel * shall neither slumber nor sleep;

lines: The LORD himself watches over you; *
the LORD is your shade at your right hand,
verses.text: The LORD himself watches over you; * the LORD is your shade at your right hand,

lines: So that the sun shall not strike you by day, *
nor the moon by night.
verses.text: So that the sun shall not strike you by day, * nor the moon by night.

lines: The LORD shall preserve you from all evil; *
it is he who shall keep you safe.
verses.text: The LORD shall preserve you from all evil; * it is he who shall keep you safe.

lines: The LORD shall watch over your going out and
your coming in, *
from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: The LORD shall watch over your going out and your coming in, * from this time forth for evermore.

lines: I was glad when they said to me, *
"Let us go to the house of the LORD."
verses.text: I was glad when they said to me, * "Let us go to the house of the LORD."

lines: Now our feet are standing *
within your gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.text: Now our feet are standing * within your gates, O Jerusalem.

lines: Jerusalem is built as a city *
that is at unity with itself;
verses.text: Jerusalem is built as a city * that is at unity with itself;

lines: To which the tribes go up,
the tribes of the LORD, *
the assembly of Israel,
to praise the Name of the LORD.
verses.text: To which the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, * the assembly of Israel, to praise the Name of the LORD.

lines: For there are the thrones of judgment, *
the thrones of the house of David.
verses.text: For there are the thrones of judgment, * the thrones of the house of David.

lines: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: *
"May they prosper who love you.
verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: * "May they prosper who love you.

lines: Peace be within your walls *
and quietness within your towers.
verses.text: Peace be within your walls * and quietness within your towers.

lines: For my brethren and companions' sake, *
I pray for your prosperity.
verses.text: For my brethren and companions' sake, * I pray for your prosperity.

lines: Because of the house of the LORD our God, *
I will seek to do you good."
verses.text: Because of the house of the LORD our God, * I will seek to do you good."

lines: To you I lift up my eyes, *
to you enthroned in the heavens.
verses.text: To you I lift up my eyes, * to you enthroned in the heavens.

lines: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, *
and the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,
verses.text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, * and the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,

lines: So our eyes look to the LORD our God, *
until he show us his mercy.
verses.text: So our eyes look to the LORD our God, * until he show us his mercy.

lines: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy, *
for we have had more than enough of contempt,
verses.text: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy, * for we have had more than enough of contempt,

lines: Too much of the scorn of the indolent rich, *
and of the derision of the proud.
verses.text: Too much of the scorn of the indolent rich, * and of the derision of the proud.

lines: If the LORD had not been on our side, *
let Israel now say;
verses.text: If the LORD had not been on our side, * let Israel now say;

lines: If the LORD had not been on our side, *
when enemies rose up against us;
verses.text: If the LORD had not been on our side, * when enemies rose up against us;

lines: Then would they have swallowed us up alive *
in their fierce anger toward us;
verses.text: Then would they have swallowed us up alive * in their fierce anger toward us;

lines: Then would the waters have overwhelmed us *
and the torrent gone over us;
verses.text: Then would the waters have overwhelmed us * and the torrent gone over us;

lines: Then would the raging waters *
have gone right over us.
verses.text: Then would the raging waters * have gone right over us.

lines: Blessed be the LORD! *
he has not given us over to be a prey for their teeth.
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD! * he has not given us over to be a prey for their teeth.

lines: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; *
the snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.text: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; * the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

lines: Our help is in the Name of the LORD, *
the maker of heaven and earth.
verses.text: Our help is in the Name of the LORD, * the maker of heaven and earth.

lines: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, *
which cannot be moved, but stands fast for ever.
verses.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, * which cannot be moved, but stands fast for ever.

lines: The hills stand about Jerusalem; *
so does the LORD stand round about his people,
from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: The hills stand about Jerusalem; * so does the LORD stand round about his people, from this time forth for evermore.

lines: The scepter of the wicked shall not hold sway over the
land allotted to the just, *
so that the just shall not put their hands to evil.
verses.text: The scepter of the wicked shall not hold sway over the land allotted to the just, * so that the just shall not put their hands to evil.

lines: Show your goodness, O LORD, to those who are good *
and to those who are true of heart.
verses.text: Show your goodness, O LORD, to those who are good * and to those who are true of heart.

lines: As for those who turn aside to crooked ways,
the LORD will lead them away with the evildoers; *
but peace be upon Israel.
verses.text: As for those who turn aside to crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the evildoers; * but peace be upon Israel.

lines: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, *
then were we like those who dream.
verses.text: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, * then were we like those who dream.

lines: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, *
and our tongue with shouts of joy.
verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, * and our tongue with shouts of joy.

lines: Then they said among the nations, *
"The LORD has done great things for them."
verses.text: Then they said among the nations, * "The LORD has done great things for them."

lines: The LORD has done great things for us, *
and we are glad indeed.
verses.text: The LORD has done great things for us, * and we are glad indeed.

lines: Restore our fortunes, O LORD, *
like the watercourses of the Negev.
verses.text: Restore our fortunes, O LORD, * like the watercourses of the Negev.

lines: Those who sowed with tears *
will reap with songs of joy.
verses.text: Those who sowed with tears * will reap with songs of joy.

lines: Those who go out weeping, carrying the seed, *
will come again with joy, shouldering their sheaves.
verses.text: Those who go out weeping, carrying the seed, * will come again with joy, shouldering their sheaves.

lines: Unless the LORD builds the house, *
their labor is in vain who build it.
verses.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, * their labor is in vain who build it.

lines: Unless the LORD watches over the city, *
in vain the watchman keeps his vigil.
verses.text: Unless the LORD watches over the city, * in vain the watchman keeps his vigil.

lines: It is in vain that you rise so early and go to bed so late; *
vain, too, to eat the bread of toil,
for he gives to his beloved sleep.
verses.text: It is in vain that you rise so early and go to bed so late; * vain, too, to eat the bread of toil, for he gives to his beloved sleep.

lines: Children are a heritage from the LORD, *
and the fruit of the womb is a gift.
verses.text: Children are a heritage from the LORD, * and the fruit of the womb is a gift.

lines: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior *
are the children of one's youth.
verses.text: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior * are the children of one's youth.

lines: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them! *
he shall not be put to shame
when he contends with his enemies in the gate.
verses.text: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them! * he shall not be put to shame when he contends with his enemies in the gate.

lines: Happy are they all who fear the LORD, *
and who follow in his ways!
verses.text: Happy are they all who fear the LORD, * and who follow in his ways!

lines: You shall eat the fruit of your labor; *
happiness and prosperity shall be yours.
verses.text: You shall eat the fruit of your labor; * happiness and prosperity shall be yours.

lines: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house, *
your children like olive shoots round about your table.
verses.text: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house, * your children like olive shoots round about your table.

lines: The man who fears the LORD *
shall thus indeed be blessed.
verses.text: The man who fears the LORD * shall thus indeed be blessed.

lines: The LORD bless you from Zion, *
and may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days
of your life.
verses.text: The LORD bless you from Zion, * and may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

lines: May you live to see your children's children; *
may peace be upon Israel.
verses.text: May you live to see your children's children; * may peace be upon Israel.

lines: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth," *
let Israel now say;
verses.text: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth," * let Israel now say;

lines: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth, *
but they have not prevailed against me."
verses.text: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth, * but they have not prevailed against me."

lines: The plowmen plowed upon my back *
and made their furrows long.
verses.text: The plowmen plowed upon my back * and made their furrows long.

lines: The LORD, the Righteous One, *
has cut the cords of the wicked.
verses.text: The LORD, the Righteous One, * has cut the cords of the wicked.

lines: Let them be put to shame and thrown back, *
all those who are enemies of Zion.
verses.text: Let them be put to shame and thrown back, * all those who are enemies of Zion.

lines: Let them be like grass upon the housetops, *
which withers before it can be plucked;
verses.text: Let them be like grass upon the housetops, * which withers before it can be plucked;

lines: Which does not fill the hand of the reaper, *
nor the bosom of him who binds the sheaves;
verses.text: Which does not fill the hand of the reaper, * nor the bosom of him who binds the sheaves;

lines: So that those who go by say not so much as,
"The LORD prosper you. *
We wish you well in the Name of the LORD."
verses.text: So that those who go by say not so much as, "The LORD prosper you. * We wish you well in the Name of the LORD."

lines: Out of the depths have I called to you, O LORD;
LORD, hear my voice; *
let your ears consider well the voice of my supplication.
verses.text: Out of the depths have I called to you, O LORD; LORD, hear my voice; * let your ears consider well the voice of my supplication.

lines: If you, LORD, were to note what is done amiss, *
O LORD, who could stand?
verses.text: If you, LORD, were to note what is done amiss, * O LORD, who could stand?

lines: For there is forgiveness with you; *
therefore you shall be feared.
verses.text: For there is forgiveness with you; * therefore you shall be feared.

lines: I wait for the LORD; my soul waits for him; *
in his word is my hope.
verses.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul waits for him; * in his word is my hope.

lines: My soul waits for the LORD,
more than watchmen for the morning, *
more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.text: My soul waits for the LORD, more than watchmen for the morning, * more than watchmen for the morning.

lines: O Israel, wait for the LORD, *
for with the LORD there is mercy;
verses.text: O Israel, wait for the LORD, * for with the LORD there is mercy;

lines: With him there is plenteous redemption, *
and he shall redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.text: With him there is plenteous redemption, * and he shall redeem Israel from all their sins.

lines: O LORD, I am not proud; *
I have no haughty looks.
verses.text: O LORD, I am not proud; * I have no haughty looks.

lines: I do not occupy myself with great matters, *
or with things that are too hard for me.
verses.text: I do not occupy myself with great matters, * or with things that are too hard for me.

lines: But I still my soul and make it quiet,
like a child upon its mother's breast; *
my soul is quieted within me.
verses.text: But I still my soul and make it quiet, like a child upon its mother's breast; * my soul is quieted within me.

lines: O Israel, wait upon the LORD, *
from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: O Israel, wait upon the LORD, * from this time forth for evermore.

lines: LORD, remember David, *
and all the hardships he endured;
verses.text: LORD, remember David, * and all the hardships he endured;

lines: How he swore an oath to the LORD *
and vowed a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.text: How he swore an oath to the LORD * and vowed a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

lines: "I will not come under the roof of my house, *
nor climb up into my bed;
verses.text: "I will not come under the roof of my house, * nor climb up into my bed;

lines: I will not allow my eyes to sleep, *
nor let my eyelids slumber;
verses.text: I will not allow my eyes to sleep, * nor let my eyelids slumber;

lines: Until I find a place for the LORD, *
a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.text: Until I find a place for the LORD, * a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

lines: "The ark! We heard it was in Ephratah; *
we found it in the fields of Jearim.
verses.text: "The ark! We heard it was in Ephratah; * we found it in the fields of Jearim.

lines: Let us go to God's dwelling place; *
let us fall upon our knees before his footstool."
verses.text: Let us go to God's dwelling place; * let us fall upon our knees before his footstool."

lines: Arise, O LORD, into your resting-place, *
you and the ark of your strength.
verses.text: Arise, O LORD, into your resting-place, * you and the ark of your strength.

lines: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; *
let your faithful people sing with joy.
verses.text: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; * let your faithful people sing with joy.

lines: For your servant David's sake, *
do not turn away the face of your Anointed.
verses.text: For your servant David's sake, * do not turn away the face of your Anointed.

lines: The LORD has sworn an oath to David; *
in truth, he will not break it:
verses.text: The LORD has sworn an oath to David; * in truth, he will not break it:

lines: "A son, the fruit of your body *
will I set upon your throne.
verses.text: "A son, the fruit of your body * will I set upon your throne.

lines: If your children keep my covenant
and my testimonies that I shall teach them, *
their children will sit upon your throne for evermore."
verses.text: If your children keep my covenant and my testimonies that I shall teach them, * their children will sit upon your throne for evermore."

lines: For the LORD has chosen Zion; *
he has desired her for his habitation:
verses.text: For the LORD has chosen Zion; * he has desired her for his habitation:

lines: "This shall be my resting-place for ever; *
here will I dwell, for I delight in her.
verses.text: "This shall be my resting-place for ever; * here will I dwell, for I delight in her.

lines: I will surely bless her provisions, *
and satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.text: I will surely bless her provisions, * and satisfy her poor with bread.

lines: I will clothe her priests with salvation, *
and her faithful people will rejoice and sing.
verses.text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, * and her faithful people will rejoice and sing.

lines: There will I make the horn of David flourish; *
I have prepared a lamp for my Anointed.
verses.text: There will I make the horn of David flourish; * I have prepared a lamp for my Anointed.

lines: As for his enemies, I will clothe them with shame; *
but as for him, his crown will shine."
verses.text: As for his enemies, I will clothe them with shame; * but as for him, his crown will shine."

lines: Oh, how good and pleasant it is, *
when brethren live together in unity!
verses.text: Oh, how good and pleasant it is, * when brethren live together in unity!

lines: It is like fine oil upon the head *
that runs down upon the beard,
verses.text: It is like fine oil upon the head * that runs down upon the beard,

lines: Upon the beard of Aaron, *
and runs down upon the collar of his robe.
verses.text: Upon the beard of Aaron, * and runs down upon the collar of his robe.

lines: It is like the dew of Hermon *
that falls upon the hills of Zion.
verses.text: It is like the dew of Hermon * that falls upon the hills of Zion.

lines: For there the LORD has ordained the blessing: *
life for evermore.
verses.text: For there the LORD has ordained the blessing: * life for evermore.

lines: Behold now, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, *
you that stand by night in the house of the LORD.
verses.text: Behold now, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, * you that stand by night in the house of the LORD.

lines: Lift up your hands in the holy place and bless the LORD; *
the LORD who made heaven and earth bless
you out of Zion.
verses.text: Lift up your hands in the holy place and bless the LORD; * the LORD who made heaven and earth bless you out of Zion.

lines: Hallelujah!
Praise the Name of the LORD; *
give praise, you servants of the LORD.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Name of the LORD; * give praise, you servants of the LORD.

lines: You who stand in the house of the LORD, *
in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.text: You who stand in the house of the LORD, * in the courts of the house of our God.

lines: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; *
sing praises to his Name, for it is lovely.
verses.text: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; * sing praises to his Name, for it is lovely.

lines: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself *
and Israel for his own possession.
verses.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself * and Israel for his own possession.

lines: For I know that the LORD is great, *
and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.text: For I know that the LORD is great, * and that our Lord is above all gods.

lines: The LORD does whatever pleases him, in heaven and on earth, *
in the seas and all the deeps.
verses.text: The LORD does whatever pleases him, in heaven and on earth, * in the seas and all the deeps.

lines: He brings up rain clouds from the ends of the earth; *
he sends out lightning with the rain,
and brings the winds out of his storehouse.
verses.text: He brings up rain clouds from the ends of the earth; * he sends out lightning with the rain, and brings the winds out of his storehouse.

lines: It was he who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, *
the firstborn both of man and beast.
verses.text: It was he who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, * the firstborn both of man and beast.

lines: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, *
against Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.text: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, * against Pharaoh and all his servants.

lines: He overthrew many nations *
and put mighty kings to death:
verses.text: He overthrew many nations * and put mighty kings to death:

lines: Sihon, king of the Amorites,
and Og, the king of Bashan, *
and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
verses.text: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, the king of Bashan, * and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

lines: He gave their land to be an inheritance, *
an inheritance for Israel his people.
verses.text: He gave their land to be an inheritance, * an inheritance for Israel his people.

lines: O LORD, your Name is everlasting; *
your renown, O LORD, endures from age to age.
verses.text: O LORD, your Name is everlasting; * your renown, O LORD, endures from age to age.

lines: For the LORD gives his people justice *
and shows compassion to his servants.
verses.text: For the LORD gives his people justice * and shows compassion to his servants.

lines: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, *
the work of human hands.
verses.text: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, * the work of human hands.

lines: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; *
eyes have they, but they cannot see.
verses.text: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; * eyes have they, but they cannot see.

lines: They have ears, but they cannot hear; *
neither is there any breath in their mouth.
verses.text: They have ears, but they cannot hear; * neither is there any breath in their mouth.

lines: Those who make them are like them, *
and so are all who put their trust in them.
verses.text: Those who make them are like them, * and so are all who put their trust in them.

lines: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel; *
O house of Aaron, bless the LORD.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel; * O house of Aaron, bless the LORD.

lines: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi; *
you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi; * you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

lines: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, *
who dwells in Jerusalem.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, * who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

lines: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: Give thanks to the God of gods, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the God of gods, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: Who only does great wonders, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who only does great wonders, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: Who by wisdom made the heavens, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who by wisdom made the heavens, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: Who spread out the earth upon the waters, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who spread out the earth upon the waters, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: Who created great lights, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who created great lights, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: The sun to rule the day, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: The sun to rule the day, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: The moon and the stars to govern the night, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: The moon and the stars to govern the night, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: Who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: And brought out Israel from among them, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And brought out Israel from among them, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: With a mighty hand and a stretched-out arm, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: With a mighty hand and a stretched-out arm, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: Who divided the Red Sea in two, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who divided the Red Sea in two, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: But swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: But swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: Who led his people through the wilderness, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Who led his people through the wilderness, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: Who struck down great kings, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who struck down great kings, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: And slew mighty kings, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And slew mighty kings, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: Sihon, king of the Amorites, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Sihon, king of the Amorites, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: And Og, the king of Bashan, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And Og, the king of Bashan, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: And gave away their lands for an inheritance, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And gave away their lands for an inheritance, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: An inheritance for Israel his servant, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: An inheritance for Israel his servant, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: Who remembered us in our low estate, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who remembered us in our low estate, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: And delivered us from our enemies, *
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And delivered us from our enemies, * for his mercy endures for ever;

lines: Who gives food to all creatures, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Who gives food to all creatures, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: Give thanks to the God of heaven, *
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the God of heaven, * for his mercy endures for ever.

lines: By the waters of Babylon we sat down and wept, *
when we remembered you, O Zion.
verses.text: By the waters of Babylon we sat down and wept, * when we remembered you, O Zion.

lines: As for our harps, we hung them up *
on the trees in the midst of that land.
verses.text: As for our harps, we hung them up * on the trees in the midst of that land.

lines: For those who led us away captive asked us for a song,
and our oppressors called for mirth: *
"Sing us one of the songs of Zion."
verses.text: For those who led us away captive asked us for a song, and our oppressors called for mirth: * "Sing us one of the songs of Zion."

lines: How shall we sing the LORD'S song *
upon an alien soil?
verses.text: How shall we sing the LORD'S song * upon an alien soil?

lines: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, *
let my right hand forget its skill.
verses.text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, * let my right hand forget its skill.

lines: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth
if I do not remember you, *
if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.
verses.text: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, * if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.

lines: Remember the day of Jerusalem, O LORD,
against the people of Edom, *
who said, "Down with it! down with it!
even to the ground!"
verses.text: Remember the day of Jerusalem, O LORD, against the people of Edom, * who said, "Down with it! down with it! even to the ground!"

lines: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, *
happy the one who pays you back
for what you have done to us!
verses.text: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, * happy the one who pays you back for what you have done to us!

lines: Happy shall he be who takes your little ones, *
and dashes them against the rock!
verses.text: Happy shall he be who takes your little ones, * and dashes them against the rock!

lines: I will give thanks to you, O LORD, with my whole heart; *
before the gods I will sing your praise.
verses.text: I will give thanks to you, O LORD, with my whole heart; * before the gods I will sing your praise.

lines: I will bow down toward your holy temple
and praise your Name, *
because of your love and faithfulness;
verses.text: I will bow down toward your holy temple and praise your Name, * because of your love and faithfulness;

lines: For you have glorified your Name *
and your word above all things.
verses.text: For you have glorified your Name * and your word above all things.

lines: When I called, you answered me; *
you increased my strength within me.
verses.text: When I called, you answered me; * you increased my strength within me.

lines: All the kings of the earth will praise you, O LORD, *
when they have heard the words of your mouth.
verses.text: All the kings of the earth will praise you, O LORD, * when they have heard the words of your mouth.

lines: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, *
that great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.text: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, * that great is the glory of the LORD.

lines: Though the LORD be high, he cares for the lowly; *
he perceives the haughty from afar.
verses.text: Though the LORD be high, he cares for the lowly; * he perceives the haughty from afar.

lines: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you keep me safe; *
you stretch forth your hand against the fury of my enemies;
your right hand shall save me.
verses.text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you keep me safe; * you stretch forth your hand against the fury of my enemies; your right hand shall save me.

lines: The LORD will make good his purpose for me; *
O LORD, your love endures for ever;
do not abandon the works of your hands.
verses.text: The LORD will make good his purpose for me; * O LORD, your love endures for ever; do not abandon the works of your hands.

lines: LORD, you have searched me out and known me; *
you know my sitting down and my rising up;
you discern my thoughts from afar.
verses.text: LORD, you have searched me out and known me; * you know my sitting down and my rising up; you discern my thoughts from afar.

lines: You trace my journeys and my resting-places *
and are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.text: You trace my journeys and my resting-places * and are acquainted with all my ways.

lines: Indeed, there is not a word on my lips, *
but you, O LORD, know it altogether.
verses.text: Indeed, there is not a word on my lips, * but you, O LORD, know it altogether.

lines: You press upon me behind and before *
and lay your hand upon me.
verses.text: You press upon me behind and before * and lay your hand upon me.

lines: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; *
it is so high that I cannot attain to it.
verses.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; * it is so high that I cannot attain to it.

lines: Where can I go then from your Spirit? *
where can I flee from your presence?
verses.text: Where can I go then from your Spirit? * where can I flee from your presence?

lines: If I climb up to heaven, you are there; *
if I make the grave my bed, you are there also.
verses.text: If I climb up to heaven, you are there; * if I make the grave my bed, you are there also.

lines: If I take the wings of the morning *
and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
verses.text: If I take the wings of the morning * and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,

lines: Even there your hand will lead me *
and your right hand hold me fast.
verses.text: Even there your hand will lead me * and your right hand hold me fast.

lines: If I say, "Surely the darkness will cover me, *
and the light around me turn to night,"
verses.text: If I say, "Surely the darkness will cover me, * and the light around me turn to night,"

lines: Darkness is not dark to you;
the night is as bright as the day; *
darkness and light to you are both alike.
verses.text: Darkness is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day; * darkness and light to you are both alike.

lines: For you yourself created my inmost parts; *
you knit me together in my mother's womb.
verses.text: For you yourself created my inmost parts; * you knit me together in my mother's womb.

lines: I will thank you because I am marvelously made; *
your works are wonderful, and I know it well.
verses.text: I will thank you because I am marvelously made; * your works are wonderful, and I know it well.

lines: My body was not hidden from you, *
while I was being made in secret
and woven in the depths of the earth.
verses.text: My body was not hidden from you, * while I was being made in secret and woven in the depths of the earth.

lines: Your eyes beheld my limbs, yet unfinished in the womb;
all of them were written in your book; *
they were fashioned day by day,
when as yet there was none of them.
verses.text: Your eyes beheld my limbs, yet unfinished in the womb; all of them were written in your book; * they were fashioned day by day, when as yet there was none of them.

lines: How deep I find your thoughts, O God! *
how great is the sum of them!
verses.text: How deep I find your thoughts, O God! * how great is the sum of them!

lines: If I were to count them, they would be more in number
than the sand; *
to count them all, my life span would need to
be like yours.
verses.text: If I were to count them, they would be more in number than the sand; * to count them all, my life span would need to be like yours.

lines: Oh, that you would slay the wicked, O God! *
You that thirst for blood, depart from me.
verses.text: Oh, that you would slay the wicked, O God! * You that thirst for blood, depart from me.

lines: They speak despitefully against you; *
your enemies take your Name in vain.
verses.text: They speak despitefully against you; * your enemies take your Name in vain.

lines: Do I not hate those, O LORD, who hate you? *
and do I not loathe those who rise up against you?
verses.text: Do I not hate those, O LORD, who hate you? * and do I not loathe those who rise up against you?

lines: I hate them with a perfect hatred; *
they have become my own enemies.
verses.text: I hate them with a perfect hatred; * they have become my own enemies.

lines: Search me out, O God, and know my heart; *
try me and know my restless thoughts.
verses.text: Search me out, O God, and know my heart; * try me and know my restless thoughts.

lines: Look well whether there be any wickedness in me *
and lead me in the way that is everlasting.
verses.text: Look well whether there be any wickedness in me * and lead me in the way that is everlasting.

lines: Deliver me, O LORD, from evildoers; *
protect me from the violent,
verses.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from evildoers; * protect me from the violent,

lines: Who devise evil in their hearts *
and stir up strife all day long.
verses.text: Who devise evil in their hearts * and stir up strife all day long.

lines: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; *
adder's poison is under their lips.
verses.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; * adder's poison is under their lips.

lines: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; *
protect me from the violent,
who are determined to trip me up.
verses.text: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; * protect me from the violent, who are determined to trip me up.

lines: The proud have hidden a snare for me
and stretched out a net of cords; *
they have set traps for me along the path.
verses.text: The proud have hidden a snare for me and stretched out a net of cords; * they have set traps for me along the path.

lines: I have said to the LORD, "You are my God; *
listen, O LORD, to my supplication.
verses.text: I have said to the LORD, "You are my God; * listen, O LORD, to my supplication.

lines: O Lord GOD, the strength of my salvation, *
you have covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.text: O Lord GOD, the strength of my salvation, * you have covered my head in the day of battle.

lines: Do not grant the desires of the wicked, O LORD, *
nor let their evil plans prosper.
verses.text: Do not grant the desires of the wicked, O LORD, * nor let their evil plans prosper.

lines: Let not those who surround me lift up their heads; *
let the evil of their lips overwhelm them.
verses.text: Let not those who surround me lift up their heads; * let the evil of their lips overwhelm them.

lines: Let hot burning coals fall upon them; *
let them be cast into the mire, never to rise up again."
verses.text: Let hot burning coals fall upon them; * let them be cast into the mire, never to rise up again."

lines: A slanderer shall not be established on the earth, *
and evil shall hunt down the lawless.
verses.text: A slanderer shall not be established on the earth, * and evil shall hunt down the lawless.

lines: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the poor *
and render justice to the needy.
verses.text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the poor * and render justice to the needy.

lines: Surely, the righteous will give thanks to your Name, *
and the upright shall continue in your sight.
verses.text: Surely, the righteous will give thanks to your Name, * and the upright shall continue in your sight.

lines: O LORD, I call to you; come to me quickly; *
hear my voice when I cry to you.
verses.text: O LORD, I call to you; come to me quickly; * hear my voice when I cry to you.

lines: Let my prayer be set forth in your sight as incense, *
the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.text: Let my prayer be set forth in your sight as incense, * the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

lines: Set a watch before my mouth, O LORD,
and guard the door of my lips; *
let not my heart incline to any evil thing.
verses.text: Set a watch before my mouth, O LORD, and guard the door of my lips; * let not my heart incline to any evil thing.

lines: Let me not be occupied in wickedness with evildoers, *
nor eat of their choice foods.
verses.text: Let me not be occupied in wickedness with evildoers, * nor eat of their choice foods.

lines: Let the righteous smite me in friendly rebuke;
let not the oil of the unrighteous anoint my head; *
for my prayer is continually against their wicked deeds.
verses.text: Let the righteous smite me in friendly rebuke; let not the oil of the unrighteous anoint my head; * for my prayer is continually against their wicked deeds.

lines: Let their rulers be overthrown in stony places, *
that they may know my words are true.
verses.text: Let their rulers be overthrown in stony places, * that they may know my words are true.

lines: As when a plowman turns over the earth in furrows, *
let their bones be scattered at the mouth of the grave.
verses.text: As when a plowman turns over the earth in furrows, * let their bones be scattered at the mouth of the grave.

lines: But my eyes are turned to you, Lord GOD; *
in you I take refuge;
do not strip me of my life.
verses.text: But my eyes are turned to you, Lord GOD; * in you I take refuge; do not strip me of my life.

lines: Protect me from the snare which they have laid for me *
and from the traps of the evildoers.
verses.text: Protect me from the snare which they have laid for me * and from the traps of the evildoers.

lines: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, *
while I myself escape.
verses.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, * while I myself escape.

lines: I cry to the LORD with my voice; *
to the LORD I make loud supplication.
verses.text: I cry to the LORD with my voice; * to the LORD I make loud supplication.

lines: I pour out my complaint before him *
and tell him all my trouble.
verses.text: I pour out my complaint before him * and tell him all my trouble.

lines: When my spirit languishes within me, you know my path; *
in the way wherein I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
verses.text: When my spirit languishes within me, you know my path; * in the way wherein I walk they have hidden a trap for me.

lines: I look to my right hand and find no one who knows me; *
I have no place to flee to, and no one cares for me.
verses.text: I look to my right hand and find no one who knows me; * I have no place to flee to, and no one cares for me.

lines: I cry out to you, O LORD; *
I say, "You are my refuge,
my portion in the land of the living."
verses.text: I cry out to you, O LORD; * I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."

lines: Listen to my cry for help, for I have been brought very low; *
save me from those who pursue me,
for they are too strong for me.
verses.text: Listen to my cry for help, for I have been brought very low; * save me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

lines: Bring me out of prison, that I may give thanks to your Name; *
when you have dealt bountifully with me,
the righteous will gather around me.
verses.text: Bring me out of prison, that I may give thanks to your Name; * when you have dealt bountifully with me, the righteous will gather around me.

lines: LORD, hear my prayer,
and in your faithfulness heed my supplications; *
answer me in your righteousness.
verses.text: LORD, hear my prayer, and in your faithfulness heed my supplications; * answer me in your righteousness.

lines: Enter not into judgment with your servant, *
for in your sight shall no one living be justified.
verses.text: Enter not into judgment with your servant, * for in your sight shall no one living be justified.

lines: For my enemy has sought my life;
he has crushed me to the ground; *
he has made me live in dark places like those who
are long dead.
verses.text: For my enemy has sought my life; he has crushed me to the ground; * he has made me live in dark places like those who are long dead.

lines: My spirit faints within me; *
my heart within me is desolate.
verses.text: My spirit faints within me; * my heart within me is desolate.

lines: I remember the time past;
I muse upon all your deeds; *
I consider the works of your hands.
verses.text: I remember the time past; I muse upon all your deeds; * I consider the works of your hands.

lines: I spread out my hands to you; *
my soul gasps to you like a thirsty land.
verses.text: I spread out my hands to you; * my soul gasps to you like a thirsty land.

lines: O LORD, make haste to answer me; my spirit fails me; *
do not hide your face from me
or I shall be like those who go down to the Pit.
verses.text: O LORD, make haste to answer me; my spirit fails me; * do not hide your face from me or I shall be like those who go down to the Pit.

lines: Let me hear of your loving-kindness in the morning,
for I put my trust in you; *
show me the road that I must walk,
for I lift up my soul to you.
verses.text: Let me hear of your loving-kindness in the morning, for I put my trust in you; * show me the road that I must walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

lines: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD, *
for I flee to you for refuge.
verses.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD, * for I flee to you for refuge.

lines: Teach me to do what pleases you, for you are my God; *
let your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
verses.text: Teach me to do what pleases you, for you are my God; * let your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

lines: Revive me, O LORD, for your Name's sake; *
for your righteousness' sake, bring me out of trouble.
verses.text: Revive me, O LORD, for your Name's sake; * for your righteousness' sake, bring me out of trouble.

lines: Of your goodness, destroy my enemies
and bring all my foes to naught, *
for truly I am your servant.
verses.text: Of your goodness, destroy my enemies and bring all my foes to naught, * for truly I am your servant.

lines: Blessed be the LORD my rock! *
who trains my hands to fight and my fingers to battle;
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD my rock! * who trains my hands to fight and my fingers to battle;

lines: My help and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, *
my shield in whom I trust,
who subdues the peoples under me.
verses.text: My help and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, * my shield in whom I trust, who subdues the peoples under me.

lines: O LORD, what are we that you should care for us? *
mere mortals that you should think of us?
verses.text: O LORD, what are we that you should care for us? * mere mortals that you should think of us?

lines: We are like a puff of wind; *
our days are like a passing shadow.
verses.text: We are like a puff of wind; * our days are like a passing shadow.

lines: Bow your heavens, O LORD, and come down; *
touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.text: Bow your heavens, O LORD, and come down; * touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

lines: Hurl the lightning and scatter them; *
shoot out your arrows and rout them.
verses.text: Hurl the lightning and scatter them; * shoot out your arrows and rout them.

lines: Stretch out your hand from on high; *
rescue me and deliver me from the great waters,
from the hand of foreign peoples,
verses.text: Stretch out your hand from on high; * rescue me and deliver me from the great waters, from the hand of foreign peoples,

lines: Whose mouths speak deceitfully *
and whose right hand is raised in falsehood.
verses.text: Whose mouths speak deceitfully * and whose right hand is raised in falsehood.

lines: O God, I will sing to you a new song; *
I will play to you on a ten-stringed lyre.
verses.text: O God, I will sing to you a new song; * I will play to you on a ten-stringed lyre.

lines: You give victory to kings *
and have rescued David your servant.
verses.text: You give victory to kings * and have rescued David your servant.

lines: Rescue me from the hurtful sword *
and deliver me from the hand of foreign peoples,
verses.text: Rescue me from the hurtful sword * and deliver me from the hand of foreign peoples,

lines: Whose mouths speak deceitfully *
and whose right hand is raised in falsehood.
verses.text: Whose mouths speak deceitfully * and whose right hand is raised in falsehood.

lines: May our sons be like plants well nurtured from their youth, *
and our daughters like sculptured corners of a palace.
verses.text: May our sons be like plants well nurtured from their youth, * and our daughters like sculptured corners of a palace.

lines: May our barns be filled to overflowing with all manner
of crops; *
may the flocks in our pastures increase by thousands
and tens of thousands;
may our cattle be fat and sleek.
verses.text: May our barns be filled to overflowing with all manner of crops; * may the flocks in our pastures increase by thousands and tens of thousands; may our cattle be fat and sleek.

lines: May there be no breaching of the walls, no going into exile, *
no wailing in the public squares.
verses.text: May there be no breaching of the walls, no going into exile, * no wailing in the public squares.

lines: Happy are the people of whom this is so! *
happy are the people whose God is the LORD!
verses.text: Happy are the people of whom this is so! * happy are the people whose God is the LORD!

lines: I will exalt you, O God my King, *
and bless your Name for ever and ever.
verses.text: I will exalt you, O God my King, * and bless your Name for ever and ever.

lines: Every day will I bless you *
and praise your Name for ever and ever.
verses.text: Every day will I bless you * and praise your Name for ever and ever.

lines: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; *
there is no end to his greatness.
verses.text: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; * there is no end to his greatness.

lines: One generation shall praise your works to another *
and shall declare your power.
verses.text: One generation shall praise your works to another * and shall declare your power.

lines: I will ponder the glorious splendor of your majesty *
and all your marvelous works.
verses.text: I will ponder the glorious splendor of your majesty * and all your marvelous works.

lines: They shall speak of the might of your wondrous acts, *
and I will tell of your greatness.
verses.text: They shall speak of the might of your wondrous acts, * and I will tell of your greatness.

lines: They shall publish the remembrance of your great goodness; *
they shall sing of your righteous deeds.
verses.text: They shall publish the remembrance of your great goodness; * they shall sing of your righteous deeds.

lines: The LORD is gracious and full of compassion, *
slow to anger and of great kindness.
verses.text: The LORD is gracious and full of compassion, * slow to anger and of great kindness.

lines: The LORD is loving to everyone *
and his compassion is over all his works.
verses.text: The LORD is loving to everyone * and his compassion is over all his works.

lines: All your works praise you, O LORD, *
and your faithful servants bless you.
verses.text: All your works praise you, O LORD, * and your faithful servants bless you.

lines: They make known the glory of your kingdom *
and speak of your power;
verses.text: They make known the glory of your kingdom * and speak of your power;

lines: That the peoples may know of your power *
and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.
verses.text: That the peoples may know of your power * and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

lines: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom; *
your dominion endures throughout all ages.
verses.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom; * your dominion endures throughout all ages.

lines: The LORD is faithful in all his words *
and merciful in all his deeds.
verses.text: The LORD is faithful in all his words * and merciful in all his deeds.

lines: The LORD upholds all those who fall; *
he lifts up those who are bowed down.
verses.text: The LORD upholds all those who fall; * he lifts up those who are bowed down.

lines: The eyes of all wait upon you, O LORD, *
and you give them their food in due season.
verses.text: The eyes of all wait upon you, O LORD, * and you give them their food in due season.

lines: You open wide your hand *
and satisfy the needs of every living creature.
verses.text: You open wide your hand * and satisfy the needs of every living creature.

lines: The LORD is righteous in all his ways *
and loving in all his works.
verses.text: The LORD is righteous in all his ways * and loving in all his works.

lines: The LORD is near to those who call upon him, *
to all who call upon him faithfully.
verses.text: The LORD is near to those who call upon him, * to all who call upon him faithfully.

lines: He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; *
he hears their cry and helps them.
verses.text: He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; * he hears their cry and helps them.

lines: The LORD preserves all those who love him, *
but he destroys all the wicked.
verses.text: The LORD preserves all those who love him, * but he destroys all the wicked.

lines: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; *
let all flesh bless his holy Name for ever and ever.
verses.text: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; * let all flesh bless his holy Name for ever and ever.

lines: Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD, O my soul! *
I will praise the LORD as long as I live;
I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul! * I will praise the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.

lines: Put not your trust in rulers, nor in any child of earth, *
for there is no help in them.
verses.text: Put not your trust in rulers, nor in any child of earth, * for there is no help in them.

lines: When they breathe their last, they return to earth, *
and in that day their thoughts perish.
verses.text: When they breathe their last, they return to earth, * and in that day their thoughts perish.

lines: Happy are they who have the God of Jacob for their help! *
whose hope is in the LORD their God;
verses.text: Happy are they who have the God of Jacob for their help! * whose hope is in the LORD their God;

lines: Who made heaven and earth, the seas, and all that is in them; *
who keeps his promise for ever;
verses.text: Who made heaven and earth, the seas, and all that is in them; * who keeps his promise for ever;

lines: Who gives justice to those who are oppressed, *
and food to those who hunger.
verses.text: Who gives justice to those who are oppressed, * and food to those who hunger.

lines: The LORD sets the prisoners free;
the LORD opens the eyes of the blind; *
the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down;
verses.text: The LORD sets the prisoners free; the LORD opens the eyes of the blind; * the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down;

lines: The LORD loves the righteous;
the LORD cares for the stranger; *
he sustains the orphan and widow,
but frustrates the way of the wicked.
verses.text: The LORD loves the righteous; the LORD cares for the stranger; * he sustains the orphan and widow, but frustrates the way of the wicked.

lines: The LORD shall reign for ever, *
your God, O Zion, throughout all generations.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: The LORD shall reign for ever, * your God, O Zion, throughout all generations. Hallelujah!

lines: Hallelujah!
How good it is to sing praises to our God! *
how pleasant it is to honor him with praise!
verses.text: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God! * how pleasant it is to honor him with praise!

lines: The LORD rebuilds Jerusalem; *
he gathers the exiles of Israel.
verses.text: The LORD rebuilds Jerusalem; * he gathers the exiles of Israel.

lines: He heals the brokenhearted *
and binds up their wounds.
verses.text: He heals the brokenhearted * and binds up their wounds.

lines: He counts the number of the stars *
and calls them all by their names.
verses.text: He counts the number of the stars * and calls them all by their names.

lines: Great is our LORD and mighty in power; *
there is no limit to his wisdom.
verses.text: Great is our LORD and mighty in power; * there is no limit to his wisdom.

lines: The LORD lifts up the lowly, *
but casts the wicked to the ground.
verses.text: The LORD lifts up the lowly, * but casts the wicked to the ground.

lines: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; *
make music to our God upon the harp.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; * make music to our God upon the harp.

lines: He covers the heavens with clouds *
and prepares rain for the earth;
verses.text: He covers the heavens with clouds * and prepares rain for the earth;

lines: He makes grass to grow upon the mountains *
and green plants to serve mankind.
verses.text: He makes grass to grow upon the mountains * and green plants to serve mankind.

lines: He provides food for flocks and herds *
and for the young ravens when they cry.
verses.text: He provides food for flocks and herds * and for the young ravens when they cry.

lines: He is not impressed by the might of a horse; *
he has no pleasure in the strength of a man;
verses.text: He is not impressed by the might of a horse; * he has no pleasure in the strength of a man;

lines: But the LORD has pleasure in those who fear him, *
in those who await his gracious favor.
verses.text: But the LORD has pleasure in those who fear him, * in those who await his gracious favor.

lines: Worship the LORD, O Jerusalem; *
praise your God, O Zion;
verses.text: Worship the LORD, O Jerusalem; * praise your God, O Zion;

lines: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates; *
he has blessed your children within you.
verses.text: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates; * he has blessed your children within you.

lines: He has established peace on your borders; *
he satisfies you with the finest wheat.
verses.text: He has established peace on your borders; * he satisfies you with the finest wheat.

lines: He sends out his command to the earth, *
and his word runs very swiftly.
verses.text: He sends out his command to the earth, * and his word runs very swiftly.

lines: He gives snow like wool; *
he scatters hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.text: He gives snow like wool; * he scatters hoarfrost like ashes.

lines: He scatters his hail like bread crumbs; *
who can stand against his cold?
verses.text: He scatters his hail like bread crumbs; * who can stand against his cold?

lines: He sends forth his word and melts them; *
he blows with his wind, and the waters flow.
verses.text: He sends forth his word and melts them; * he blows with his wind, and the waters flow.

lines: He declares his word to Jacob, *
his statutes and his judgments to Israel.
verses.text: He declares his word to Jacob, * his statutes and his judgments to Israel.

lines: He has not done so to any other nation; *
to them he has not revealed his judgments.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: He has not done so to any other nation; * to them he has not revealed his judgments. Hallelujah!

lines: Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD from the heavens; *
praise him in the heights.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; * praise him in the heights.

lines: Praise him, all you angels of his; *
praise him, all his host.
verses.text: Praise him, all you angels of his; * praise him, all his host.

lines: Praise him, sun and moon; *
praise him, all you shining stars.
verses.text: Praise him, sun and moon; * praise him, all you shining stars.

lines: Praise him, heaven of heavens, *
and you waters above the heavens.
verses.text: Praise him, heaven of heavens, * and you waters above the heavens.

lines: Let them praise the Name of the LORD; *
for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.text: Let them praise the Name of the LORD; * for he commanded, and they were created.

lines: He made them stand fast for ever and ever; *
he gave them a law which shall not pass away.
verses.text: He made them stand fast for ever and ever; * he gave them a law which shall not pass away.

lines: Praise the LORD from the earth, *
you sea-monsters and all deeps;
verses.text: Praise the LORD from the earth, * you sea-monsters and all deeps;

lines: Fire and hail, snow and fog, *
tempestuous wind, doing his will;
verses.text: Fire and hail, snow and fog, * tempestuous wind, doing his will;

lines: Mountains and all hills, *
fruit trees and all cedars;
verses.text: Mountains and all hills, * fruit trees and all cedars;

lines: Wild beasts and all cattle, *
creeping things and wingèd birds;
verses.text: Wild beasts and all cattle, * creeping things and wingèd birds;

lines: Kings of the earth and all peoples, *
princes and all rulers of the world;
verses.text: Kings of the earth and all peoples, * princes and all rulers of the world;

lines: Young men and maidens, *
old and young together.
verses.text: Young men and maidens, * old and young together.

lines: Let them praise the Name of the LORD, *
for his Name only is exalted,
his splendor is over earth and heaven.
verses.text: Let them praise the Name of the LORD, * for his Name only is exalted, his splendor is over earth and heaven.

lines: He has raised up strength for his people
and praise for all his loyal servants, *
the children of Israel, a people who are near him.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: He has raised up strength for his people and praise for all his loyal servants, * the children of Israel, a people who are near him. Hallelujah!

lines: Hallelujah!
Sing to the LORD a new song; *
sing his praise in the congregation of the faithful.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song; * sing his praise in the congregation of the faithful.

lines: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; *
let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; * let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

lines: Let them praise his Name in the dance; *
let them sing praise to him with timbrel and harp.
verses.text: Let them praise his Name in the dance; * let them sing praise to him with timbrel and harp.

lines: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people *
and adorns the poor with victory.
verses.text: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people * and adorns the poor with victory.

lines: Let the faithful rejoice in triumph; *
let them be joyful on their beds.
verses.text: Let the faithful rejoice in triumph; * let them be joyful on their beds.

lines: Let the praises of God be in their throat *
and a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.text: Let the praises of God be in their throat * and a two-edged sword in their hand;

lines: To wreak vengeance on the nations *
and punishment on the peoples;
verses.text: To wreak vengeance on the nations * and punishment on the peoples;

lines: To bind their kings in chains *
and their nobles with links of iron;
verses.text: To bind their kings in chains * and their nobles with links of iron;

lines: To inflict on them the judgment decreed; *
this is glory for all his faithful people.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: To inflict on them the judgment decreed; * this is glory for all his faithful people. Hallelujah!

lines: Hallelujah!
Praise God in his holy temple; *
praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise God in his holy temple; * praise him in the firmament of his power.

lines: Praise him for his mighty acts; *
praise him for his excellent greatness.
verses.text: Praise him for his mighty acts; * praise him for his excellent greatness.

lines: Praise him with the blast of the ram's-horn; *
praise him with lyre and harp.
verses.text: Praise him with the blast of the ram's-horn; * praise him with lyre and harp.

lines: Praise him with timbrel and dance; *
praise him with strings and pipe.
verses.text: Praise him with timbrel and dance; * praise him with strings and pipe.

lines: Praise him with resounding cymbals; *
praise him with loud-clanging cymbals.
verses.text: Praise him with resounding cymbals; * praise him with loud-clanging cymbals.

lines: Let everything that has breath *
praise the Lord.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: Let everything that has breath * praise the Lord. Hallelujah!
